abathur.name: Abathur
abathur.description: A unique Hero that can manipulate the battle from anywhere on the map.

abilities.name: Symbiote
abilities.description: Spawn and attach a Symbiote to a target ally or Structure. While active, Abathur controls the Symbiote, gaining access to new Abilities. The Symbiote is able to gain XP from nearby enemy deaths.

abilities.name: Toxic Nest
abilities.description:
Spawn a mine that becomes active after a short time. Deals 153 (+4% per level) damage and reveals the enemy for 4 seconds. Lasts 90 seconds.

Stores up to 3 charges.

abilities.name: Evolve Monstrosity
abilities.description:
Turn an allied Minion or Locust into a Monstrosity. When enemy Minions near the Monstrosity die, it gains 2% Health and 2% Basic Attack damage, stacking up to 40 times. The Monstrosity can be healed by Carapace and has the ability to Burrow to a visible location every 80 seconds.

Using Symbiote on the Monstrosity allows Abathur to control it, in addition to Symbiote's normal benefits. This Ability can be reactivated to automatically cast Symbiote on his Monstrosity.

abilities.name: Ultimate Evolution
abilities.description: Clone target allied Hero and control it for 20 seconds. Abathur has perfected the clone, granting it 20% Spell Power, 20% bonus Attack Damage, and 10% bonus Movement Speed. Cannot use their Heroic Ability.

abilities.name: Locust Strain
abilities.description:
Spawns a Locust to attack down the nearest lane every 15 seconds.  Locusts heal for 20% of the damage they deal, and regain 20% of their Maximum health when a nearby minion dies.

Locusts lose health over 17 seconds, have 225 (+4% per level) health and deal 36 (+4% per level) damage with each Basic Attack, dealing 100% bonus damage to enemy non-Heroes.

abilities.name: Deep Tunnel
abilities.description: Quickly tunnel to a visible location.

1.name: Pressurized Glands
1.description: Increases the range of Symbiote's Spike Burst by 25% and decreases the cooldown by 1 second.

1.name: Envenomed Nest
1.description: Toxic Nests deal 75% more damage over 3 seconds and reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 15 for 4 seconds.

1.name: Reinforced Carapace
1.description: Increase the Shield amount of Carapace by 40%.

1.name: Locust Brood
1.description: Activate to spawn 3 Locusts at a nearby location.

4.name: Adrenal Overload
4.description: Heroic Symbiote hosts gain 25% increased Attack Speed.

4.name: Needlespine
4.description: Increases the damage and range of Symbiote's Stab by 20%.

4.name: Prolific Dispersal
4.description: Increase the duration of Toxic Nests by 45 seconds, reduce its cooldown by 2 seconds, and add 2 additional charges.

4.name: Slapathur
4.description:
Abathur’s Basic Attacks deal 350% additional damage and Stun non-Elite enemies and disable Structures for 1.5 seconds.

The same Hero or Structure can only be Stunned or disabled once every 6 seconds.

7.name: Vile Nest
7.description: Toxic Nests Slow enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 2.5 seconds.

7.name: Networked Carapace
7.description: Using Symbiote's Carapace also applies an untalented Carapace Shield to all nearby allied Heroes, Minions, and Mercenaries.

7.name: Calldown: MULE
7.description: Activate to calldown a Mule that repairs Structures, one at a time, near target point for 40 seconds, healing for 90 Health every 1 second.

10.name: Ultimate Evolution
10.description: Clone target allied Hero and control it for 20 seconds. Abathur has perfected the clone, granting it 20% Spell Power, 20% bonus Attack Damage, and 10% bonus Movement Speed. Cannot use their Heroic Ability.

10.name: Evolve Monstrosity
10.description:
Turn an allied Minion or Locust into a Monstrosity. When enemy Minions near the Monstrosity die, it gains 2% Health and 2% Basic Attack damage, stacking up to 40 times. The Monstrosity can be healed by Carapace and has the ability to Burrow to a visible location every 80 seconds.

Using Symbiote on the Monstrosity allows Abathur to control it, in addition to Symbiote's normal benefits. This Ability can be reactivated to automatically cast Symbiote on his Monstrosity.

13.name: Spatial Efficiency
13.description: Symbiote's Stab gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by .5 seconds.

13.name: Soma Transference
13.description: Symbiote's Spike Burst heals the host for 64 (+4% per level) Health per enemy Hero hit.

13.name: Bombard Strain
13.description: Locust's Basic Attacks become a long-range siege attack and they now lose health 40% more slowly.

16.name: Envenomed Spikes
16.description: Abathur's Symbiote's Spike Burst also Slows enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 2 seconds.

16.name: Adrenaline Boost
16.description: Symbiote's Carapace increases the Movement Speed of the target by 40% for 3.5 seconds.

16.name: Volatile Mutation
16.description: Ultimate Evolution clones and Monstrosities deal 137 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 3 seconds and when they die. Enemy Heroes hit heal the clone or Monstrosity for 100% of the damage dealt.

16.name: Survival Instincts
16.description: Reduce damage taken by Locusts from non-Heroes by 50% and increase their damage by 60%.

20.name: Evolutionary Link
20.description: Increase the duration of Ultimate Evolution by 50%. As long as the Ultimate Evolution is alive, the original target of the clone gains a Shield equal to 35% of their maximum Health. Refreshes every 5 seconds.

20.name: Evolution Complete
20.description: Increase Monstrosity's Basic Attack damage by 100%.

20.name: Hivemind
20.description: Symbiote creates an additional Symbiote on a nearby allied Hero.  This Symbiote mimics the commands of the first, but does half damage and Shielding.

20.name: Locust Nest
20.description: Activate to create a nest that periodically spawns Locusts. Only one Locust Nest can be active at a time.

alarak.name: Alarak
alarak.description: A combo Assassin that can move enemies around and punish mistakes.

abilities.name: Discord Strike
abilities.description: After a 0.5 second delay, enemies in front of Alarak take 165 (+4% per level) damage and are silenced for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Telekinesis
abilities.description:
Vector Targeting
Create a force, pushing Alarak and all enemies hit from the targeted point towards the targeted direction. Deals 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Lightning Surge
abilities.description: Deal 62 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy and an additional 100% damage to enemies between Alarak and the target. Restore 75 (+4% per level) health for each Hero hit.

abilities.name: Deadly Charge
abilities.description:
After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in his path. Distance is increased based on the amount of time channeled, up to 1.5 seconds.

Issuing a Move order while this is channeling will cancel it at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.

abilities.name: Counter-Strike
abilities.description: Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Sadism
abilities.description:
Alarak's Ability damage and self-healing are increased by 100% against enemy Heroes.

Repeatable Quest: Takedowns increase Sadism by 3%, up to 30%. Sadism gained from Takedowns is lost on death.

1.name: Overwhelming Power
1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 40% Attack Speed and causes Basic Attacks to heal for 15% of the damage dealt, increased by 50% of Sadism's bonus when hitting Heroes. These effects last for 4 seconds.

1.name: Ruthless Momentum
1.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Telekinesis from 30 to 20. Telekinesis's cooldown recharges 100% faster while above 80% Health.

1.name: Extended Lightning
1.description:
Reduce Sadism by 10%.

Quest: Hit Heroes with the center of Lightning Surge.

Reward: After hitting 5 Heroes, increase Lightning Surge's range by 20%.

Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, Lightning Surge's center also Slows enemies by 40% for 2 seconds.

Reward: After hitting 3 Heroes with the center of a single cast, increase Sadism by 10% and instantly gain all other Rewards.

4.name: Chaos Reigns
4.description:
Quest: Hit Heroes with Discord Strike.

Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, increase Discord Strike's damage by 60.

Reward: After hitting 2 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 60.

Reward: After hitting 3 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 100 and instantly gain all other Rewards.

4.name: Negatively Charged
4.description:
Increase the Lightning Surge damage bonus to enemies between Alarak and his victim to 175%.

Repeatable Quest: Each Hero hit by the center of Lightning Surge permanently increases the damage bonus by 5%.

4.name: Show of Force
4.description:
Heroes hit with 3 of Alarak's Abilities within 2 seconds take an additional 61 (+4% per level) damage and increase Sadism by 2%, stacking up to 20%. 

Sadism gained from Show of Force is lost on death.

7.name: Dissonance
7.description: Increase Discord Strike's Silence duration by 0.75 seconds.

7.name: Hindered Motion
7.description: Telekinesis Slows enemies by 30% for 3 seconds.

7.name: Applied Force
7.description: Reduce Sadism by 10%, but Telekinesis pushes 15% further and has 15% increased range.

10.name: Deadly Charge
10.description:
After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in his path. Distance is increased based on the amount of time channeled, up to 1.5 seconds.

Issuing a Move order while this is channeling will cancel it at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.

10.name: Counter-Strike
10.description: Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 (+4% per level) damage.

13.name: Blade of the Highlord
13.description:
Basic Attacks against Heroes increase Sadism by 2% stacking up to 40%.

Sadism gained from Blade of the Highlord is lost on death.

13.name: Pure Malice
13.description:
Increase Sadism by 10% any time an allied Hero dies, up to 40%.

Sadism gained from Pure Malice is lost on death.

13.name: Rite of Rak'Shir
13.description:
Activate to mark an enemy Hero for 300 seconds.

Hitting the marked Hero with Discord Strike increases Sadism by 3%. Killing the marked Hero increases Sadism by 5% and lowers the cooldown of Rite of Rak'Shir to 10 seconds.

Sadism gained from Rite of Rak'Shir is lost on death.

16.name: Lethal Onslaught
16.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 50% of Sadism's damage bonus to Alarak's Basic Attacks for 4 seconds. Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh this duration.

16.name: Lightning Barrage
16.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with the center of Lightning Surge allows it to be cast again for free on a different primary target within the next 3 seconds. This free cast cannot benefit from Lightning Barrage.

16.name: Mocking Strikes
16.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Alarak's Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds. This bonus is doubled against enemy Heroes who are Stunned, Silenced, Slowed, or Rooted.

20.name: Wrath of the Highlord
20.description:
If Deadly Charge was the selected Heroic, Heroes hit by Deadly Charge take bonus damage from Alarak's Abilities equal to 75% of Sadism's bonus damage for 4 seconds.

If Counter-Strike was the selected Heroic, its cooldown is reduced by 2.5 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by Alarak's Basic Abilities.

20.name: Might of the Highlord
20.description: Alarak gains access to both of his Heroic Abilities. This can be activated to change which Ability occupies the Heroic slot, with the other Ability using the Trait slot.

20.name: Last Laugh
20.description: Activate to teleport to the chosen location and remove all Roots, Slows, and damage over time effects. If Alarak fails to hit enemy Heroes 3 times with Basic Abilities within 4 seconds of using Last Laugh, his Health is reduced to 1.

20.name: Hasty Bargain
20.description: Activate to permanently reduce Alarak's Sadism by 4% and reset the cooldowns of his Basic Abilities.

alexstrasza.name: Alexstrasza
alexstrasza.description: A Healer who shares her Health with allies and can transform into a Dragon to empower her Abilities.

abilities.name: Gift of Life
abilities.description:
Sacrifice 15% of Alexstrasza's current Health, healing an allied Hero for 150% of that amount.

Passive: Increase Alexstrasza's Health regeneration by 150%.

Dragonqueen: Breath of Life
Cooldown greatly reduced and does not cost Health.

abilities.name: Abundance
abilities.description:
Plant a seed of healing that blooms after 3 seconds, healing nearby allied Heroes for 20% of their maximum Health.

Dragonqueen: Preservation
Heal area and amount greatly increased.

abilities.name: Flame Buffet
abilities.description:
Launch a fireball, Burning enemies hit for 75 (+4% per level) damage over 5.5 seconds.

Hitting enemies that are already Burning deals 125 (+4% per level) bonus damage upon impact, Slows them by 40% decaying over 2 seconds, and refunds the Mana cost.

Dragonqueen: Wing Buffet
Damage and Knockback enemies in an arc.

abilities.name: Life-Binder
abilities.description:
Bind Alexstrasza's life force with an allied Hero. Both her and her target are healed for 480 (+4% per level) Health over 2 seconds. Afterwards, the Hero with a lower percentage of Health is healed to the same Health percentage as the other Hero.

Dragonqueen: Cast range increased by 45%.

abilities.name: Cleansing Flame
abilities.description:
After 1.25 seconds, take to the sky and drop 5 fireballs over 6 seconds at the position of the mouse cursor. Fireballs deal 135 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and heal allied Heroes for 300 (+4% per level) Health.

2 seconds after dropping all fireballs, Alexstrasza lands at the position of the mouse cursor.

abilities.name: Dragonqueen
abilities.description:
After 1.25 seconds, transform into a dragon and gain 500 (+4% per level) Health.

While Dragonqueen is active, Alexstrasza's Abilities are empowered, and her Basic Attacks deal 143 (+4% per level) damage and heal allied Heroes for 43 (+4% per level) in an arc in front of her. Additionally, the duration of incoming Stuns, Roots, and Slows, is reduced by 50%.

Lasts 15 seconds.

1.name: Live and Let Live
1.description:
While above 75% Health, Gift of Life's cooldown recharges 125% faster.

Dragonqueen: While above 75% Health, Breath of Life's cooldown recharges 25% faster.

1.name: Circle of Life
1.description:
Quest: Collect Regeneration Globes.

Reward: After collecting 10 Regeneration Globes, Abundance heals for an additional 5% maximum Health.

Reward: After collecting 15 Regeneration Globes, Abundance's healing burst creates a Regeneration Globe.

1.name: Flames of Fury
1.description:
Reduce the Mana cost of Flame Buffet from 50 to 40.

Quest: Hit Burning enemy Heroes with Flame Buffet. 20 hits unlocks a Mythic Quest.

Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, hitting a Burning enemy Hero with Flame Buffet reduces Dragonqueen's cooldown by 6 seconds.

Mythic Quest: After hitting 30 more Heroes without dying, Dragonqueen damage against Heroes refreshes its duration.

4.name: Surge of Vitality
4.description: Abundance's healing burst grants allied Heroes 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

4.name: Heat Exhaustion
4.description: Increase Flame Buffet's Slow from 40% to 50% and cause it to no longer decay.

4.name: Exuberance
4.description: While above 75% Health, gain 15% Movement Speed.

7.name: Lifeblossom
7.description:
While above 75% Health, casting Gift of Life creates a Lifeblossom at the target's location, Breath of Life instead removes Slows and Roots from the target.

After collecting a Lifeblossom, the next Gift of Life costs no Health.

Passive: Reduces the cost of Gift of Life to 10% of Alexstrasza's current Health.

7.name: Verdant Flourish
7.description: Alexstrasza receives 40% more healing from Abundance and 100% more healing from Regeneration Globes.

7.name: Fire Within
7.description: Hitting a Burning Hero with Flame Buffet heals Alexstrasza for 10% of her maximum Health.

10.name: Life-Binder
10.description:
Bind Alexstrasza's life force with an allied Hero. Both her and her target are healed for 480 (+4% per level) Health over 2 seconds. Afterwards, the Hero with a lower percentage of Health is healed to the same Health percentage as the other Hero.

Dragonqueen: Cast range increased by 45%.

10.name: Cleansing Flame
10.description:
After 1.25 seconds, take to the sky and drop 5 fireballs over 6 seconds at the position of the mouse cursor. Fireballs deal 135 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and heal allied Heroes for 300 (+4% per level) Health.

2 seconds after dropping all fireballs, Alexstrasza lands at the position of the mouse cursor.

13.name: Dragon Scales
13.description: Gain 50 Armor while Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced, and for 2 seconds after. Can only trigger once every 10 seconds.

13.name: Pacify
13.description:
Activate to Slow and reduce an enemy Hero's damage by 50% for 3 seconds.

Healing a Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced ally reduces Pacify's cooldown by 30 seconds.

13.name: Life Unbound
13.description:
Activate to heal an allied Hero for 15% of their maximum Health and deal 200 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

Healing a Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced ally reduces Life Unbound's cooldown by 30 seconds.

Cannot be used on Alexstrasza.

16.name: Tough Love
16.description: Gift of Life grants its target 10 Armor for 2.5 seconds, increased to 30 while Alexstrasza is above 75% Health.

16.name: Overprotective
16.description: Heroes healed by Abundance gain a Shield for 6 seconds equal to 50% of the amount healed.

16.name: Draconic Discipline
16.description: Increase Dragonqueen Basic Attack healing by  50%. For each allied Hero healed with Dragonqueen Basic Attacks, reduce Preservation's cooldown by 1.25 seconds.

20.name: Ritual of Life
20.description: Life-Binder activates 3 times over 6 seconds.

20.name: On Ruby Wings
20.description: Healing or damaging 3 or more Heroes with a single Cleansing Flame fireball causes that fireball to not be consumed.

20.name: Ancient Flame
20.description:
While Dragonqueen is active, Alexstrasza's Basic Attacks apply Flame Buffet. This does not grant Quest stacks.

Passive: Dragonqueen grants 25% more maxium Health.

20.name: Blessing of the Red
20.description:
Activate to grant an allied Hero 500 bonus maximum Health until they die.

Cannot be used on Alexstrasza, or on a Hero who already has Blessing of the Red.

cassia.name: Cassia
cassia.description: An Assassin who specializes against Physical Attackers.

abilities.name: Lightning Fury
abilities.description: Hurl a lightning javelin that deals 158 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit and splits into two lightning bolts that deal 158 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in their path.

abilities.name: Blinding Light
abilities.description:
After 0.5 seconds, deal 50 (+4% per level) damage and Blind enemies in the target area for 2 seconds.

Passive: Cassia deals 15% increased damage to Blinded targets.

abilities.name: Fend
abilities.description: Charge at an enemy, and upon arriving Channel for up to 1.5 seconds, dealing 64 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in front of Cassia every 0.25 seconds. Deals 50% reduced damage to non-Heroes. Avoidance remains charged while Channeling.

abilities.name: Ball Lightning
abilities.description: Throw a ball of lightning at an enemy Hero that bounces up to 6 times between nearby enemy Heroes and Cassia, dealing 180 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit.

abilities.name: Valkyrie
abilities.description: Summon a Valkyrie that rushes to Cassia after 0.75 seconds, pulling the first enemy Hero hit, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds at the end of her path. The Valkyrie knocks back all other enemy Heroes in her way.

abilities.name: Avoidance
abilities.description:
While moving, Cassia gradually gains up to 30 Armor over 3 seconds. After being stationary for 0.75 seconds, the Armor is rapidly lost over .5 seconds. 

Avoidance remains charged while Fending.

1.name: Thunderstroke
1.description:
Increase the damage of Lightning Fury by 20.

Quest: Lightning Fury's damage is increased by 1.5 every time it hits a Hero.

1.name: Impale
1.description: Increase Fend's cast range and radius by 25%. It deals an additional 70% damage to enemies below 50% Health.

1.name: Charged Strikes
1.description: Gain 15% Attack Speed. Every 3rd Basic Attack deals 20% bonus damage and bounces to nearby enemy Heroes.

4.name: Plate of the Whale
4.description: Regenerate 6 (+4% per level) Health per second while Avoidance is active. If fully charged, gain an additional 12 (+4% per level) Health per second.

4.name: Ring of the Leech
4.description: Basic Attacks against your primary target heal for 20% of their damage. If an enemy is Blinded, this also affects Lightning Fury and Fend.

4.name: Inner Light
4.description: Activate to heal for 25% of your maximum Health over 5 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit with Lightning Fury lower the cooldown of this ability by 10 seconds.

7.name: Grounding Rod
7.description: Enemies hit by Lightning Fury or Fend are Slowed by 20% for 2 seconds.

7.name: Seraph's Hymn
7.description:
Basic Attacks against your primary enemy Hero grant 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Blinding Light by 2 seconds.

Passive: Increase the passive damage bonus of Blinding Light from 15% to 30%.

7.name: Surge of Light
7.description: After taking 650 (+4% per level) damage with Avoidance active, Cassia can activate Avoidance to deal 220 (+4% per level) damage to enemies around her.

10.name: Ball Lightning
10.description: Throw a ball of lightning at an enemy Hero that bounces up to 6 times between nearby enemy Heroes and Cassia, dealing 180 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit.

10.name: Valkyrie
10.description: Summon a Valkyrie that rushes to Cassia after 0.75 seconds, pulling the first enemy Hero hit, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds at the end of her path. The Valkyrie knocks back all other enemy Heroes in her way.

13.name: War Matron
13.description: Cassia becomes Protected while Channeling Fend and for an additional 1 second if the Channel is completed.

13.name: War Traveler
13.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. While Avoidance is fully charged, gain an additional 10% Movement Speed and Mounting is instant.

13.name: Gloves Of Alacrity
13.description: Gain 1 Basic Attack range. While Avoidance is fully charged, gain an additional 1 Basic Attack range.

16.name: Power Strike
16.description: Lightning Fury pierces but only splits on Heroes. Enemy Heroes hit reduce its cooldown by 1 second and become marked for 15 seconds. Upon reaching 3 marks, remove them and cast a Blinding Light at their feet.

16.name: Static Electricity
16.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Lightning Fury. Fend's impact launches a lightning bolt towards each nearby enemy Hero.

16.name: Martial Law
16.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Increase this to 3% if they are Stunned, Rooted, Slowed, or Blinded.

20.name: Infinite Lightning
20.description: Ball Lightning can now bounce indefinitely. Every bounce reduces its cooldown by 4 seconds.

20.name: Imprisoning Light
20.description: Upon impaling an enemy Hero, they are Blinded for 5 seconds and Cassia's Valkyrie creates a wave of light that deals 200 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. This wave Silences and Roots them for 3 seconds.

20.name: Titan's Revenge
20.description: Cassia's Basic Attacks now ignore Armor and while Avoidance is fully charged, they deal an additional 20% bonus damage.

20.name: Rockstopper
20.description:
Activate to fully charge Avoidance and increase its Armor value to 60 for 4 seconds.  

Losing Avoidance removes this bonus.

ana.name: Ana
ana.description: A burst Healer who uses precise skillshots to heal allies and can deny enemy healing.

abilities.name: Healing Dart
abilities.description: Fire a dart which heals the first allied Hero hit for 195 (+4% per level) Health. Does not affect full Health Heroes.

abilities.name: Biotic Grenade
abilities.description:
Toss a grenade at the target area. Allied Heroes hit are healed for 152 (+4% per level) Health and receive 25% increased healing from Ana for 4 seconds. Enemies hit take 60 (+4% per level) damage and receive 100% less healing for 1.75 seconds.

If Biotic Grenade does not hit any enemies, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds, and if Ana is the only target hit, reduce its cooldown by an additional 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Sleep Dart
abilities.description:
Fire a dart that puts the first enemy Hero hit to Sleep, Stunning them for 3 seconds. Sleep's effects end instantly if the target takes damage after the first 0.5 seconds.

Cannot be used on Vehicles.

abilities.name: Nano Boost
abilities.description:
Instantly boost an allied Hero, restoring 200 Mana. For the next 8 seconds, they gain 30% Spell Power and their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 150% faster.

Cannot be used on Ana.

abilities.name: Eye of Horus
abilities.description:
Assume a sniping position, gaining the ability to fire up to 6 specialized rounds with unlimited range. Rounds pierce allied and enemy Heroes but collide with enemy Structures in their path. Allies are healed for 225 (+4% per level) and enemies are damaged for 135 (+4% per level). Deals 50% less damage to Structures.

Ana is unable to move while Eye of Horus is active.

abilities.name: Shrike
abilities.description:
Basic Attacks apply a Dose to enemies, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds, plus additional damage equal to the current number of stacks on the target, stacking up to 5 times. Every 0.5 seconds, Ana is healed for 60% of the damage dealt by Shrike.

Aim Down Sights

Activating Shrike reduces your Movement Speed by 25%, but increases the Range of Healing Dart and Sleep Dart by 25% while also allowing them to pierce one Hero. Lasts until canceled.

1.name: Contact Healing
1.description: Hitting Heroes with Biotic Grenade increases its damage and healing by 30% per Hero hit.

1.name: Slumber Shells
1.description: Reduce the cooldown of Sleep Dart by 2 seconds. Upon waking, enemy Heroes are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds.

1.name: Vampiric Rounds
1.description:
Increase Shrike's healing by 15%.

Repeatable Quest: Stack 5 Doses to increase Shrike's healing by 1%.

Repeatable Quest: Basic Attack a Hero with 5 Doses to increase Shrike's healing by 0.25%.

4.name: Biotic Enhancements
4.description: Increase the bonus healing duration of Biotic Grenade by 50% and reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds.

4.name: Overdose
4.description: Sleep Dart applies 4 Doses. While Aim Down Sights is active, Sleep Dart pierces all enemy Heroes.

4.name: Debilitating Dart
4.description: Fire a dart which Slows the Movement Speed and reduces the damage dealt by the first enemy Hero it hits by 50% for 4 seconds. If no Heroes are hit, reduce this cooldown by 8 seconds.

7.name: Anti-Healer
7.description: Increase the area of Biotic Grenade by 25% and the duration of the healing reduction by 0.75 seconds.

7.name: Night Terrors
7.description: Gain 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds for every Hero hit by Sleep Dart. Upon waking, enemy Heroes take 8% of their Maximum Health in damage.

7.name: Mind-Numbing Agent
7.description: Every Dose a Hero has reduces their Spell Power by 10%.

10.name: Nano Boost
10.description:
Instantly boost an allied Hero, restoring 200 Mana. For the next 8 seconds, they gain 30% Spell Power and their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 150% faster.

Cannot be used on Ana.

10.name: Eye of Horus
10.description:
Assume a sniping position, gaining the ability to fire up to 6 specialized rounds with unlimited range. Rounds pierce allied and enemy Heroes but collide with enemy Structures in their path. Allies are healed for 225 (+4% per level) and enemies are damaged for 135 (+4% per level). Deals 50% less damage to Structures.

Ana is unable to move while Eye of Horus is active.

13.name: Speed Serum
13.description: Healing Dart grants 25% Movement Speed to affected Heroes for 2 seconds.

13.name: Purifying Darts
13.description: Healing Dart removes Roots and Slows from the target, and heals for 20% more when doing so.

13.name: Smelling Salts
13.description: Healing Dart removes Stuns from the target, and grants them 50 Armor for 2 seconds when doing so.

16.name: Sharpshooter
16.description: Healing Dart's healing is increased by 5% if it heals a Hero, up to 50%. At maximum bonus, further increase its healing by 35%. This bonus is reset if Healing Dart fails to hit a Hero.

16.name: Concentrated Doses
16.description: Increase Healing Dart's healing by 12% for each Dose active on enemy Heroes.

16.name: Active Reload
16.description: Activate to instantly gain 3 charges of Healing Dart.

20.name: Nano Infusion
20.description: Allies affected by Nano Boost heal for 50% of Spell Damage dealt.

20.name: Deadeye
20.description:
Eye of Horus cooldown reduced to 6 seconds, but it only regains new rounds every 10 seconds. Remaining cooldown is converted to rounds.

For every Hero Eye of Horus hits, increases its damage and healing by 5%. This bonus resets after leaving Eye of Horus or after 4 seconds.

20.name: Armored Stance
20.description: Increase Shrike's damage by 50%. While Aim Down Sights is active, gain 25 Armor.

20.name: Dynamic Optics
20.description: Basic Attacks increase Attack Speed by 10% for 3 seconds, up to 100%. While Aim Down Sights is active, increase your Basic Attack Range by 4.

anduin.name: Anduin
anduin.description: A ranged Healer with the ability to pluck an ally from danger.

abilities.name: Flash Heal
abilities.description: Cast for 0.75 seconds to heal an allied Hero for 280 (+4% per level).

abilities.name: Divine Star
abilities.description: Send light that deals 140 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and then returns to Anduin, healing allied Heroes for 130 (+4% per level) in a wider path. Healing increases by 25% per enemy Hero hit.

abilities.name: Chastise
abilities.description: Shove a swell of light forward, dealing 175 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit and Rooting them for 1.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Holy Word: Salvation
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, Channel to invoke the Light for 3 seconds. While nearby, allied Heroes heal for up to 30% of their max Health and are Protected.

abilities.name: Lightbomb
abilities.description:
Imbue an allied Hero with the Light. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

The target gains a Shield that absorbs 165 (+4% per level) damage per enemy Hero hit. Lasts for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Leap of Faith
abilities.description:
Faith instantly pulls an allied Hero to Anduin's location, granting them Unstoppable while they travel.

Pursued By Grace

Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes heal the lowest Health allied Hero near Anduin for 32 (+4% per level).

1.name: Evenhanded Blessings
1.description: If Flash Heal is cast on a different target from its last, increase its healing by 15% and refund 40% of its cooldown.

1.name: Power Word: Shield
1.description:
While Divine Star is traveling out, allies in its path gain a Shield that absorbs 128 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds.

If Divine Star hits an enemy Hero, Anduin gains a Shield that absorbs 185 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds.

1.name: Lightwell
1.description:
Summon a Lightwell that periodically heals a nearby allied Hero for 50 (+4% per level). The well only fades after healing 15 times or when recast.

This cooldown is reduced by 1 second each time Anduin heals an allied Hero.

4.name: Moral Compass
4.description:
Divine Star fires Basic Attacks at Heroes close to its apex.

Passive: Increase Attack Range by 1.1.

4.name: Surge of Light
4.description: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Chastise by 0.75 seconds. Basic Attacks against Heroes Rooted by Chastise launch an additional Basic Attack and restore 25 Mana.

4.name: Piercing Light
4.description:
Chastise pierces to hit an additional Hero.

Quest: Hitting two Heroes with a single Chastise permanently increases Spell Power by 1, to a maximum of 10.

7.name: Binding Heal
7.description: Casting Flash Heal on an ally heals Anduin for 135 (+4% per level).

7.name: Blessed Recovery
7.description:
If Anduin loses more than 8% of his maximum Health at once, recover 15% Health over 3 seconds. 

This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

Current Health required: 133 (+4% per level)

7.name: Desperate Prayer
7.description: Activate to instantly heal an allied Hero for 375 (+4% per level), but kneel for 2 seconds, unable to act.

10.name: Holy Word: Salvation
10.description: After 0.5 seconds, Channel to invoke the Light for 3 seconds. While nearby, allied Heroes heal for up to 30% of their max Health and are Protected.

10.name: Lightbomb
10.description:
Imbue an allied Hero with the Light. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

The target gains a Shield that absorbs 165 (+4% per level) damage per enemy Hero hit. Lasts for 5 seconds.

13.name: Speed of the Pious
13.description: While Divine Star is traveling, gain 30% Movement Speed. Each allied Hero healed by Divine Star on its return to Anduin reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

13.name: Push Forward!
13.description: Damaging an enemy Hero increases Movement Speed by 2.5% and the amount healed by Pursued By Grace by 5% for 6 seconds. These effects stack up to 8 times.

13.name: Enchant Boots - Lion's Speed
13.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. This bonus is quadrupled while Leap of Faith's cooldown is available. Allies pulled by Leap of Faith are healed for 280 (+4% per level) over 4 seconds.

16.name: Renew
16.description: Flash Heal heals an additional 180 (+4% per level) over 6 seconds. The duration of this heal is refreshed each time Anduin hits an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack.

16.name: Holy Nova
16.description: After Anduin catches Divine Star, it explodes, healing nearby allied Heroes for 105 (+4% per level) and damaging enemies for 150 (+4% per level).

16.name: Glyph of Faith
16.description: Leap of Faith gains a 2nd charge.

16.name: Inner Focus
16.description:
Activate to reset the cooldown of Flash Heal and its next cast heals for 25% more.

Damaging enemy Heroes reduces this cooldown by 1 second.

20.name: Light of Stormwind
20.description:
Holy Word: Salvation grants allied Heroes Invulnerability instead of Protected. This does not affect Anduin. 

Channeling Holy Word: Salvation for its full duration reduces its cooldown by 60 seconds.

20.name: Inner Fire
20.description: The target of Light Bomb gains 40% Move Speed and 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

20.name: Censure
20.description: Chastise Stuns for 0.75 seconds and its Root duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

20.name: Varian's Legacy
20.description: Basic Attacks burn enemies for 87 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds and Anduin heals for 50% of the damage dealt.

anubarak.name: Anub'arak
anubarak.description: A Tank who specializes against Mages.

abilities.name: Impale
abilities.description: Deals 90 (+4% per level) damage. Stuns for 1 second.

abilities.name: Harden Carapace
abilities.description: Gain a Shield that grants 40 Spell Armor and absorbs 340 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Burrow Charge
abilities.description:
Burrow to the target location, dealing 91 (+4% per level) damage and briefly stunning enemies in a small area upon surfacing, slowing them by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

Burrow Charge can be reactivated to surface early.

abilities.name: Locust Swarm
abilities.description: Deal 68 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Each enemy damaged restores 24 (+4% per level) Health. Lasts 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Cocoon
abilities.description: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

abilities.name: Scarab Host
abilities.description: Using an Ability spawns a Beetle which loses Health over 10 seconds, attacking nearby enemies for 20 (+4% per level) damage.

1.name: Nerubian Armor
1.description: Increase Harden Carapace's Spell Armor by 25.

1.name: Legion of Beetles
1.description: Beetles have 30 Spell Armor. Automatically spawn a Beetle every 12 seconds. Can be toggled on and off.

1.name: Regeneration Master
1.description:
Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases your Health Regeneration by 1 per second, up to 30. 

Reward: After gathering 25 Regeneration Globes, you also gain 500 Health.

4.name: Bed of Barbs
4.description: Create a bed of spikes along Impale's path that Slows enemies by 25% and deals 21 (+4% per level) damage per second. Spikes persist for 3.5 seconds.

4.name: Shed Exoskeleton
4.description: Harden Carapace grants 30% increased Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

4.name: Underking
4.description: Increases Burrow Charge range by 20% and damage by 100%.

7.name: Chitinous Plating
7.description: While Harden Carapace is active, taking damage from enemy Abilities reduces its cooldown by 1 second, up to 3 seconds.

7.name: Subterranean Shield
7.description: Burrow Charge also grants a 400 (+4% per level) point Shield for 5 seconds.

7.name: Leeching Scarabs
7.description: Beetles attacks deal 30% more damage and heal Anub'arak 50% of damage dealt if he is nearby.

10.name: Locust Swarm
10.description: Deal 68 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Each enemy damaged restores 24 (+4% per level) Health. Lasts 6 seconds.

10.name: Cocoon
10.description: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

13.name: Urticating Spines
13.description: Casting Harden Carapace will also deal 90 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Deals double damage against Heroes.

13.name: Burning Beetles
13.description: Deal 21 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Beetles deal 6 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

13.name: Acid-Drenched Mandibles
13.description: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases Anub'arak's Basic Attack damage by 80% for 4 seconds.

16.name: Epicenter
16.description: Increases Burrow Charge impact area by 60% and lowers the cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.

16.name: Debilitation
16.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Burrow Charge or Impale have their Spell Power reduced by 50% for 4 seconds.

16.name: Beetle, Juiced
16.description:
Passive: Beetles gain 30% increased health.

Every 4th Basic Attack spawns a Beetle.

20.name: Hive Master
20.description: Gain a permanent Vampire Locust that attacks a nearby enemy every 3 seconds. The Vampire Locust deals 165 (+4% per level) damage and returns to heal Anub'arak for 80 (+4% per level) health.

20.name: Cryptweave
20.description: Staying near the Cocoon allows Anub'arak to extend the duration by up to 6 seconds per Cocoon. Upon exiting the Cocoon, enemies take 60 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% for each second that they were inside.

20.name: The Traitor King
20.description:
Gain 10% bonus maximum Health and 20 Spell Armor.

Activate to gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds.

20.name: Rewind
20.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.

artanis.name: Artanis
artanis.description: A tough Bruiser that deals high damage if the enemy team is unable to shut him down.

abilities.name: Blade Dash
abilities.description: Dash forward and deal 63 (+4% per level) damage to enemies, then return and deal 171 (+4% per level) damage. Every enemy hit reduces the cooldown on Shield Overload by 1 second, and Heroes by 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Twin Blades
abilities.description: Artanis's next Basic Attack immediately causes him to charge a short distance and strike the enemy 2 times.

abilities.name: Phase Prism
abilities.description: Fire a Phase Prism that deals 66 (+4% per level) damage to the first Hero hit and swaps Artanis's position with theirs. Hitting a Hero also grants Artanis Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds. Can be used during Blade Dash.

abilities.name: Purifier Beam
abilities.description: Target an enemy Hero with an orbital beam from the Spear of Adun, dealing 184 (+4% per level) damage per second for 8 seconds. The beam will chase the target as they move. Unlimited range.

abilities.name: Suppression Pulse
abilities.description: Fire a large area pulse from the Spear of Adun, dealing 114 (+4% per level) damage and Blinding enemies for 4 seconds. Unlimited range.

abilities.name: Shield Overload
abilities.description: After taking damage while below 75% Health, Artanis gains a 365 (+4% per level) Shield for 5 seconds. Basic Attacks lower the cooldown of Shield Overload by 4 seconds.

1.name: Reactive Parry
1.description:
Damaging enemy Heroes with Twin Blades or Blade Dash grants Artanis 50 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing its damage by 50%.

Stores up to 2 charges.

1.name: Amateur Opponent
1.description: Twin Blades attacks deal 150% bonus damage to non-Heroes.

1.name: Protector Of Aiur
1.description: Quest: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase Artanis's Attack damage by 0.1%. Takedowns grant 1% bonus damage.

4.name: Psionic Synergy
4.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Phase Prism grants 30 Armor for 5 seconds.

4.name: Shield Battery
4.description:
Shield Overload's cooldown recharges 125% faster while its Shield is active. 

Passive: Reduce Shield Overload's cooldown by 4 seconds.

4.name: Shield Surge
4.description: Increases Shield Overload's Shields by 80% while below 25% Health.

7.name: Solarite Reaper
7.description: Increases the damage of the first dash of Blade Dash by 175%.

7.name: Chrono Surge
7.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Phase Prism grants 40% bonus Attack Speed for 5 seconds and Slows the enemy's Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds.

7.name: Final Cut
7.description: After using an Ability, your next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 40% additional damage. While under 25% Health, this damage bonus is increased to 60%.

10.name: Suppression Pulse
10.description: Fire a large area pulse from the Spear of Adun, dealing 114 (+4% per level) damage and Blinding enemies for 4 seconds. Unlimited range.

10.name: Purifier Beam
10.description: Target an enemy Hero with an orbital beam from the Spear of Adun, dealing 184 (+4% per level) damage per second for 8 seconds. The beam will chase the target as they move. Unlimited range.

13.name: Templar's Zeal
13.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Blade Dash from 50 to 25. Each time that Shield Overload activates, reduce the cooldown of Blade Dash by 6 seconds.

13.name: Triple Strike
13.description: Increases Twin Blades's number of Basic Attacks to 3, but increase its cooldown by 1 second.

13.name: Graviton Vortex
13.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Phase Prism from 50 to 25. Hitting an enemy Hero with Basic Attacks or Blade Dash reduces the cooldown of Phase Prism by 2 seconds.

13.name: Phase Bulwark
13.description: Shield Overload grants 50 Spell Armor while active and for 2 seconds after it expires.

16.name: Titan Killer
16.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 0.5% of the target's maximum Health in damage, increased to 1.5% when empowered by Twin Blades.

16.name: Force of Will
16.description: Casting Basic Abilities reduces the cooldown of Shield Overload by 5 seconds.

16.name: Blades of a Templar
16.description: Increase Attack Speed by 20%. Basic Attacks Slow by 20% for 1.25 seconds.

20.name: Orbital Bombardment
20.description: Suppression Pulse gains an additional charge.  There is a 10 second cooldown between uses.

20.name: Target Purified
20.description: Increase the speed of Purifier Beam by 15%. If the target of Purifier Beam dies, it automatically recasts on the nearest visible enemy Hero.

20.name: Zealot Charge
20.description: Increase Twin Blades' charge distance by 75%.

20.name: Plasma Burn
20.description: While Shield Overload is active, deal 70 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

arthas.name: Arthas
arthas.description: A Tank who is proficient against melee Physical Attackers, slowing them.

abilities.name: Death Coil
abilities.description:
Deals 164 (+4% per level) damage to target enemy.

Can be self-cast to heal for 275 (+4% per level) Health.

abilities.name: Howling Blast
abilities.description: Root enemies within the target area for 1.25 seconds and deals 68 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Frozen Tempest
abilities.description: Deal 36 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies and Slow them by 10% per second, stacking up to 40%. Heroes hit also have their Attack Speed reduced by 10% per second, stacking up to 40%. Frozen Tempest's effects last for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Army of the Dead
abilities.description:
Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that lose Health over 20 seconds and attack for 20 (+4% per level) damage. Reactivate to sacrifice a ghoul, healing Arthas for 240 (+4% per level) Health. Stores up to 6 charges.

Whenever a nearby enemy Minion dies, reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 1 second. Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Summon Sindragosa
abilities.description: Deals 230 (+4% per level) damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.

abilities.name: Frostmourne Hungers
abilities.description:
Activate to make Arthas's next Basic Attack strike immediately and deal 71 (+4% per level) bonus damage. Dealing damage restores 40 Mana.

Quest: Killing a Minion or hitting a Hero with Frostmourne Hungers permanently increases its bonus damage by 3 and Arthas's Basic Attack damage by 0.75.

1.name: Frost Presence
1.description:
Increase the area of Howling Blast by 20%.

Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Howling Blast.

Reward: After Hitting 15 Heroes, Howling Blast's range is increased by 20% and it hits enemies in its path.

Reward: After Hitting 30 Heroes, Death Coil Slows Heroes hit by 50% for 1.25 seconds.

1.name: Borean Winds
1.description:
After Frozen Tempest has been active for 2 seconds, Arthas gains 10% Movement Speed.

Passive: Frozen Tempest's Slowing effects last an additional 0.5 seconds and its Mana cost is reduced by 4 per second.

1.name: Rime
1.description:
Every 5 seconds, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Stores up to 3 charges.

Passive: Arthas heals for 24 (+4% per level) Health per second while Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned.

4.name: Shattered Armor
4.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Howling Blast have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.

4.name: Icy Talons
4.description: Gain 3% Attack Speed for 2 seconds every time a Hero is damaged by Frozen Tempest, up to a maximum of 60%.

4.name: Frost Strike
4.description: Frostmourne Hungers deals an additional 115 (+4% per level) Spell Damage in an area and Slows enemy Heroes hit by 20% for 2 seconds.

7.name: Immortal Coil
7.description: Gain the healing effect of Death Coil even when used on enemies. If Death Coil is used on Arthas, it heals for an additional 75% bonus healing and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

7.name: Rune Tap
7.description:
Every 3rd Basic Attack heals Arthas for 5% of his max Health.

Passive: Each stack of Frostmourne Hungers increases Arthas's maximum Health by 10.

7.name: Icebound Fortitude
7.description:
Activate to instantly remove all Roots and Slows. Gain 25 Armor and reduce the duration of Stuns, Slows, and Roots against Arthas by 75% for 3 seconds.

Each Hero Rooted by Howling Blast reduces the cooldown of this ability by 2 seconds.

10.name: Army of the Dead
10.description:
Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that lose Health over 20 seconds and attack for 20 (+4% per level) damage. Reactivate to sacrifice a ghoul, healing Arthas for 240 (+4% per level) Health. Stores up to 6 charges.

Whenever a nearby enemy Minion dies, reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 1 second. Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds.

10.name: Summon Sindragosa
10.description: Deals 230 (+4% per level) damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.

13.name: Deathlord
13.description:
If Death Coil is used on an enemy Hero, launch an additional Death Coil at a nearby enemy Hero.

Passive: Death Coil deals more damage the lower Arthas's current Health is, up to a maximum of 50% bonus damage.

13.name: Deathchill
13.description:
Howling Blast's damage is increased by 2 for each stack of Frostmourne Hungers. 

Howling Blast deals 100% additional damage and Roots for an additional 0.25 seconds against Heroes under 50% Health.

13.name: Biting Cold
13.description: Each second an enemy is damaged by Frozen Tempest, it deals 15% bonus damage, up to a 75% bonus.

16.name: Remorseless Winter
16.description: Enemy Heroes that remain within Frozen Tempest for 2.5 seconds are Rooted for 1.25 seconds and heal Arthas for 3% of his maximum Health. This effect has an 8 second cooldown per target.

16.name: Frostmourne Feeds
16.description: Reduce the cooldown of Frostmourne Hungers by 6 seconds. Arthas heals for 75% of the Basic Attack damage dealt by Frostmourne Hungers.

16.name: Anti-Magic Shell
16.description: Activate to make Arthas immune to Spell Damage for 4 seconds and heal Arthas for 25% of the damage prevented.

20.name: Legion of Northrend
20.description:
Reduce Army of the Dead's charge cooldown by 5 seconds.

Each charge consumed spawns an additional Ghoul to attack nearby enemies. These Ghouls cannot be sacrificed.

20.name: Absolute Zero
20.description: Sindragosa flies twice as far. Enemy Heroes are Rooted for 2.5 seconds, and then Slowed by 60% for 4 seconds.

20.name: Death Pact
20.description:
Instantly double your stacks of Frostmourne Hungers, but it no longer gains stacks from hitting Heroes or killing Minions.

Passive: Takedowns grant 2 stacks of Frostmourne Hungers.

20.name: Path of Frost
20.description:
Activate to instantly mount with 140% minimum Movement Speed. Taking damage does not dismount Arthas from this Mount. Lasts up to 5 seconds.

When Arthas dismounts, Slow all nearby enemies by 30% for 2 seconds and deal 66 (+4% per level) damage.

auriel.name: Auriel
auriel.description: A Healer that excels when paired with a high-octane damage dealer.

abilities.name: Sacred Sweep
abilities.description: Sweep the area with sacred power, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and an additional 160 (+4% per level) damage to enemies caught in the center.

abilities.name: Ray of Heaven
abilities.description: Consume Auriel's stored energy and heal allied Heroes in the area for the amount of energy consumed.

abilities.name: Detainment Strike
abilities.description: Deal 55 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit and knock them back. If they collide with terrain, they are also stunned for 1.25 seconds and take an additional 165 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Resurrect
abilities.description:
Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 3 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.

Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

abilities.name: Crystal Aegis
abilities.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Bestow Hope
abilities.description:
Passive: 70% of the damage Auriel deals to Heroes and 35% dealt to non-Heroes is stored as energy.

Bestow an allied Hero with Hope. While they remain near Auriel, 30% of their damage to Heroes and 10% of their damage to non-Heroes is converted to energy. Auriel can only have Bestow Hope on 1 ally at a time.

Auriel can store up to 475 (+4% per level) energy.

1.name: Increasing Clarity
1.description:
Quest: Every time Sacred Sweep hits a Hero in the center, increase the center damage by 2, up to 50. 

Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, this center damage bonus is increased to 180.

1.name: Righteous Assault
1.description: Reduces the cooldown of Sacred Sweep by 3 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by its center.

1.name: Searing Light
1.description: Ray of Heaven also deals damage to enemy Heroes in the area equal to 30% of the energy consumed.

4.name: Majestic Span
4.description: Increases the radius of Sacred Sweep by 15%.

4.name: Heavy Burden
4.description:
Detainment Strike Slows enemy Heroes by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Slow amount and duration doubled on enemies it Stuns.

Passive: Increase Detainment Strikes' Stun duration by 0.25 seconds.

4.name: Repeated Offense
4.description:
Enemies hit by Detainment Strike are knocked back 30% farther.

Quest: Every time Detainment Strike stuns a Hero, increase the stun damage by 10, up to 60.

Reward: After stunning 6 Heroes, increase this damage bonus to 250.

7.name: Glimmer of Hope
7.description: Collecting a Regeneration Globe reduces the cost of Auriel's next Ray of Heaven by 75%.

7.name: Empathic Link
7.description: Auriel stores 25% of damage taken by allies with Bestow Hope.

7.name: Energized Cord
7.description:
Increases the energy stored from Auriel's Basic Attacks to 130% of the damage against Heroes and 70% of the damage against non-Heroes.

Does not affect Auriel's Bestow Hope ally.

Passive: Increase Basic Attack Range by 1.1.

10.name: Resurrect
10.description:
Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 3 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.

Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

10.name: Crystal Aegis
10.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

13.name: Blinding Flash
13.description: Enemies hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep are blinded for 2 seconds.

13.name: Converging Force
13.description: Enemies hit by the outer area are pushed slightly toward the center.

13.name: Piercing Lash
13.description: Detainment Strike now pierces and hits all enemy Heroes in a line, reducing the cooldown by 2 seconds for each Hero hit.

16.name: Reservoir of Hope
16.description: Quest: Each maximum energy Ray of Heaven Auriel casts increases the maximum amount of energy that can be stored by 55.

16.name: Will of Heaven
16.description:
Allies with Bestow Hope gain 20% Attack Speed.

Passive: Auriel gains 10% increased Basic Attack Damage.

16.name: Wrath of Heaven
16.description:
Allies with Bestow Hope gain 15% Spell Power.

Enemy Heroes hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep or the terrain collision of Detainment Strike have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 3 seconds.

20.name: Light Speed
20.description: Resurrected allies gain 200% increased Movement Speed, decaying over 4 seconds. While a resurrected ally remains alive, Resurrect's next cooldown recharges 100% faster.

20.name: Diamond Resolve
20.description: When Crystal Aegis expires, it grants the target 75 Armor for 5 seconds, reducing damage taken by 75%.

20.name: Angelic Flight
20.description: After 2 seconds, fly to a target location.

20.name: Shield of Hope
20.description: Activate to grant all nearby allied Heroes a shield for 3 seconds equal to 50% of the amount of Health they are missing.

azmodan.name: Azmodan
azmodan.description: A Summoner that can also deal high damage from far away.

abilities.name: Globe of Annihilation
abilities.description:
Shoot a globe of destruction, dealing 176 (+4% per level) damage on impact.  Deals 50% damage to non-Heroes.

Quest: Hitting a Hero or killing a Minion within 3 seconds of being hit by Globe Of Annihilation grants 2 stacks of Annihilation.  Each stack increases its damage by 1. 

Mythic Reward: After gaining 450 Annihilation, the area of Globe of Annihilation is increased by 15% and it deals 150 additional damage.

abilities.name: Summon Demon Warrior
abilities.description:
Spawn a Demon Warrior that marches forward. Warriors deal 53 (+4% per level) damage per Attack. Loses Health over 17 seconds. Deals 100% bonus damage to Minions and Mercenaries.

Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

abilities.name: All Shall Burn
abilities.description:
Channel a beam of death on an enemy, dealing 128 (+4% per level) damage per second for 2.5 seconds. If the Channel lasts its full duration, deal an extra 340 (+4% per level) damage to the target.

Azmodan's Movement Speed is reduced by 30% while Channeling.

abilities.name: Demonic Invasion
abilities.description:
Rain a small army of Demonic Grunts down on enemies, dealing 85 (+4% per level) damage per impact. Grunts deal 30 (+4% per level) damage, have 750 (+4% per level) Health and last up to 20 seconds. When Grunts die they explode, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, doubled against enemy Heroes.

Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

abilities.name: Tide of Sin
abilities.description:
Activate to make the next Globe of Annihilation cost no Mana and deal 50% more damage.

Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

abilities.name: Demon Lieutenant
abilities.description:
Summon a Demon Lieutenant at any allied Mercenary, Minion, or Azmodan Demon. The Lieutenant will cast Demonic Smite every 7 seconds, instantly killing an enemy Minion. Loses Health over 21 seconds.

Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

1.name: Greed
1.description:
Globe of Annihilation deals 15% more damage to non-Heroic targets.

Quest: After gaining 225 Annihilation, increase the range of All Shall Burn by 25% and Demon Warriors gain 20% Attack Speed and Movement Speed. Globe of Annihilation's damage penalty against Minions and Mercenaries is removed.

1.name: Gluttony
1.description:
Increase the number of stacks of Annihilation gained by hitting Heroes with Globe of Annihilation from 2 to 4.

Quest: After gaining 225 Annihilation, each enemy hit by Globe of Annihilation reduces its cooldown by 0.25 seconds, doubled against Heroes. Globe of Annihilation's damage penalty against Minions and Mercenaries is removed.

1.name: Wrath
1.description:
Every other Basic Attack against Heroes or Structures grant Annihilation. 

Quest: After gaining 225 Annihilation, hitting a Hero with Globe of Annihilation increases the damage of Azmodan's next Basic Attack against them within 3 seconds by 85% the amount of Annihilation he has. Globe of Annihilation's damage penalty against Minions and Mercenaries is removed.

4.name: Army of Hell
4.description: Summon Demon Warrior spawns an additional Demon, but its cooldown is increased by 10 seconds.

4.name: Hellforged Armor
4.description: Demon Warriors and Lieutenants gain 20 Armor and lose 25% less health per second.

4.name: Battleborn
4.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Summon Demon Warrior from 25 to 20. Azmodan's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Summon Demon Warrior by 0.75 seconds and Demon Lieutenant by 1.5 seconds.

7.name: Art of Chaos
7.description: If Globe of Annihilation hits 2 or more Heroes, restore 40 Mana and gain an extra 2 Annihilation.

7.name: Bombardment
7.description: After casting Globe of Annihilation, Azmodan's Basic Attacks within the next 3 seconds have an additional 1.5 range and can hit 3 additional targets. Hitting Heroes with Basic Attacks empowered by Bombardment grant 1 Annihilation.

7.name: Master of Destruction
7.description: If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration, All Shall Burn's final damage applies to all enemies in an area around the target and grants 1 Annihilation per Hero hit.

10.name: Demonic Invasion
10.description:
Rain a small army of Demonic Grunts down on enemies, dealing 85 (+4% per level) damage per impact. Grunts deal 30 (+4% per level) damage, have 750 (+4% per level) Health and last up to 20 seconds. When Grunts die they explode, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, doubled against enemy Heroes.

Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

10.name: Tide of Sin
10.description:
Activate to make the next Globe of Annihilation cost no Mana and deal 50% more damage.

Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

13.name: Brutish Vanguard
13.description: Demon Warriors and Lieutenants gain 25% increased Health. Demon Warriors Slow attacked targets by 30%.

13.name: Cydaea's Kiss
13.description: Reduces the Channel time of All Shall Burn by 0.5 seconds. If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration against a Hero, Azmodan is healed for 8% of his maximum Health.

13.name: Chain of Command
13.description: The cooldown of Demon Lieutenants' Demonic Smite is reduced by 2 seconds and they grant 25% increased damage to nearby friendly Minions, Mercenaries, and Azmodan's summoned Demons.

16.name: Total Annihilation
16.description: Globe of Annihilation damages Heroes for an additional 4% of their maximum Health.

16.name: Hell Rift
16.description: If All Shall Burn Channels for its full duration or kills the target, a Demon Warrior is summoned at the target's location and all Demon Warriors deal 35% increased damage for 5 seconds.

16.name: Trample
16.description:
Activate to charge a short distance, dealing 275 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies caught in the path by 60% for 1.25 second.

After hitting an enemy Hero with Trample, reduce the cooldown of Azmodan's Heroic Ability by 25%.

20.name: Siegebreaker
20.description: Azmodan's Demons deal 40% increased damage to Structures.

20.name: Black Pool
20.description: Globes of Annihilation empowered by Tide of Sin also leave a Black Pool at their impact location for 5 seconds. Enemies within the pool lose 8 Armor per second, up to 15, and take 56 (+4% per level) damage per second.

20.name: Inescapable Annihilation
20.description: Globe of Annihilation can now be cast globally.

20.name: Sin's Grasp
20.description:
All Shall Burn Slows enemy Heroes. While active, the target is Slowed by 15%, and if it lasts its full duration, they are Slowed by 50% for 2.5 seconds.

If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration against a Hero, reduce its cooldown by 50%.

sonya.name: Sonya
sonya.description: A Bruiser that's great at capturing Mercenary camps and likes to dive into the enemy team.

abilities.name: Ancient Spear
abilities.description: Throw out a spear that pulls Sonya to the first enemy hit, dealing 173 (+4% per level) damage and briefly stunning them. If this hits an enemy, generate 40 Fury.

abilities.name: Seismic Slam
abilities.description: Deals 176 (+4% per level) damage to the target enemy, and 44 (+4% per level) to enemies behind the target.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.description: Deals 138 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies for 3 seconds, healing for 25% of damage dealt. Healing tripled versus Heroes.

abilities.name: Leap
abilities.description: Leap into the air, dealing 135 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Berserker
abilities.description: Increase damage dealt by 40%. Reduce the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows against Sonya by 50%. Lasts 15 seconds, and extends by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.

abilities.name: Fury
abilities.description: Use Fury instead of Mana, which is gained by taking damage or dealing Basic Attack damage. Using a Basic or Heroic Ability grants 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

1.name: Furious Blow
1.description: Every 4th cast of Seismic Slam deals 40% more damage to the primary target and costs no Fury.

1.name: War Paint
1.description: Sonya's Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

1.name: Tough As Nails
1.description:
Every 16 seconds, gain 60 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 60%.

Stores up to 3 charges. Charges refresh 200% faster while Fury's Movement Speed bonus is active.

4.name: Shattered Ground
4.description: Increase Seismic Slam's splash damage by 250%. Targeting a Hero with Seismic Slam further increases its splash damage by 250%, while targeting other enemies increases the length of its splash by 66%.

4.name: Hurricane
4.description: Reduce the cooldown of Whirlwind by 2 seconds. Casting Whirlwind removes all Slows and Roots from Sonya.

4.name: Shot Of Fury
4.description:
Activate to gain 50 Fury. Usable while Whirlwinding.

Passive: After casting Seismic Slam, your next Basic Attack deals 40% more damage.

7.name: Poisoned Spear
7.description: Ancient Spear deals an additional 100% damage over 6 seconds.

7.name: Life Funnel
7.description: Increases the healing of Whirlwind to 35% of damage dealt.

7.name: Battle Rage
7.description:
Activate to instantly restore 10% of Sonya's maximum Health. Stores up to 2 charges. Usable while Whirlwinding.

Passive: Sonya deals 25% more damage to Mercenaries.

10.name: Leap
10.description: Leap into the air, dealing 135 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

10.name: Wrath of the Berserker
10.description: Increase damage dealt by 40%. Reduce the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows against Sonya by 50%. Lasts 15 seconds, and extends by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.

13.name: Mystical Spear
13.description: Ancient Spear always pulls Sonya to the target location even if it doesn't hit an enemy. When used this way, Ancient Spear's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds.

13.name: Ruthless
13.description: Whirlwind deals an additional 50 (+4% per level) damage per second to Heroes below 50% Health. Does not generate additional healing.

13.name: No Escape
13.description: Increases the Movement Speed bonus from using Basic and Heroic Abilities to 20%.

16.name: Giant Slammer
16.description: Basic Attacks and Seismic Slam deal an additional 1.5% of Heroes' maximum Health as damage and heal Sonya for 60% of the damage dealt.

16.name: Rampage
16.description: Increase Basic Attack damage by 25%. Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Ancient Spear by 1.5 seconds.

16.name: Nerves of Steel
16.description: Activate to gain 25% of your maximum Health as a Shield for 3 seconds. Usable while Whirlwinding.

20.name: Arreat Crater
20.description: Leap leaves behind an impassable crater for 5 seconds.  Reduces Leap's cooldown by 20 seconds.

20.name: Striding Giant
20.description: Wrath of the Berserker increases maximum Health by 10% and grants Striding Giant, which can be activated to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds. 30 second cooldown.

20.name: Composite Spear
20.description: Increases Ancient Spear's range by 50%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Ancient Spear grants 25 Armor for 4 seconds.

20.name: Ignore Pain
20.description: Activate to gain 60 Armor for 4 seconds, taking 60% less damage. Usable while Whirlwinding.

thebutcher.name: The Butcher
thebutcher.description: An Assassin who starts slow, but deals extreme damage after collecting enough Meat.

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.description: Deal 110 (+4% per level) damage and Slow enemies by 50%, decaying over 2 seconds. The Butcher's next Basic Attack will strike immediately.

abilities.name: Butcher's Brand
abilities.description:
Deal 37 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy and Brand them for 4 seconds. The Butcher's Basic Attacks against the Branded target heal him for 75% of the damage done.

Basic Attacks against Branded Heroes heal for double and extend the duration of the Brand by 0.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Ruthless Onslaught
abilities.description: Charge at an enemy, becoming Unstoppable and gaining Movement Speed. If The Butcher reaches the target, they are stunned for 1 second and take 119 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Furnace Blast
abilities.description:
After a 3 second delay, fire explodes around The Butcher dealing 500 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.

Can be cast while using Ruthless Onslaught.

abilities.name: Lamb to the Slaughter
abilities.description: Throw a hitching post that attaches to the nearest enemy Hero after a 1 second delay. This deals 171 (+4% per level) damage and causes the enemy to be chained to the post and Silenced for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Fresh Meat
abilities.description:
Upon dying, nearby enemy Minions drop 1 Fresh Meat and enemy Heroes drop 20 Fresh Meat. Fresh Meat can be picked up to gain 0.5 Attack Damage per Meat. The Butcher loses 15 Fresh Meat upon dying.

Quest: Collect 200 Fresh Meat.

Reward: Gain an additional 125 Attack Damage and 25% increased Attack Speed. Heroes continue to drop 10 Fresh Meat, Minions no longer drop Fresh Meat, and Fresh Meat is no longer lost on death.

1.name: Invigoration
1.description: If Hamstring hits a Hero, half of the Mana cost is refunded and the cooldown is reduced by 1 second.

1.name: Chop Meat
1.description: Increases Hamstring damage by 100% to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

1.name: Block
1.description:
Every 5 seconds, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

Stores up to 2 charges.

4.name: Flail Axe
4.description: Increases the length of Hamstring by 40%.

4.name: Cheap Shot
4.description: Hamstring does 100% more damage to targets affected by a Slow, Root, or Stun.

4.name: Unrelenting Pursuit
4.description: Reduces the cooldown of Ruthless Onslaught by 33% upon impact.

7.name: Insatiable Blade
7.description: While facing a branded enemy, The Butcher's Movement Speed is increased by 25%.

7.name: Meat Shield
7.description: When Ruthless Onslaught impacts an enemy Hero, The Butcher gains 50 Spell Armor for 2.5 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 50%.

7.name: Victuals
7.description: Every time a nearby enemy minion dies, The Butcher heals 5% of his maximum health.

10.name: Furnace Blast
10.description:
After a 3 second delay, fire explodes around The Butcher dealing 500 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.

Can be cast while using Ruthless Onslaught.

10.name: Lamb to the Slaughter
10.description: Throw a hitching post that attaches to the nearest enemy Hero after a 1 second delay. This deals 171 (+4% per level) damage and causes the enemy to be chained to the post and Silenced for 3 seconds.

13.name: Brutal Strike
13.description: After using Hamstring, The Butcher's next 3 Basic Attacks within 5 seconds deal an additional 15% damage.

13.name: Savage Charge
13.description: Ruthless Onslaught deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 10% of their maximum Health.

13.name: Cleaver
13.description: Basic Attacks deal 35% of The Butcher's Basic Attack Damage in an area around the target.

16.name: Crippling Slam
16.description: Hamstring's Slow no longer decays, and its duration is increased by 30%.

16.name: Enraged
16.description:
While below 50% of his maximum Health, taking damage causes The Butcher to become Enraged for 10 seconds, gaining 40% Attack Speed and 25 Armor, reducing damage taken by 25%.

This effect has a 25 second cooldown.

16.name: Blood Frenzy
16.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant 5% increased Attack and Movement Speed for 3 seconds, up to 25%.

20.name: Fires of Hell
20.description: Furnace Blast explodes a second time 3 seconds after the initial explosion.

20.name: Slaughterhouse
20.description: Lamb to the Slaughter now chains all enemy Heroes in range.

20.name: Nexus Blades
20.description: Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage and Slow enemy Movement Speed by 20% for 1 second.

20.name: Bolt of the Storm
20.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.

chen.name: Chen
chen.description: A potent Bruiser that wears downs enemies and is resistant to burst damage.

abilities.name: Flying Kick
abilities.description: Kick through target enemy, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Keg Smash
abilities.description:
Deal 50 (+4% per level) damage and soak enemies in Brew for 3 seconds, Slowing them by 10%. After 1.25 seconds, the Slow is increased to 40%.

After being used, this Ability becomes Breath of Fire.

Breath of Fire
Deal damage and Ignite Brew-soaked enemies.

abilities.name: Stagger
abilities.description: Damage taken over the next 3 seconds is prevented.  Once this effect ends, Chen receives 75% of the damage taken over 5 seconds. This damage cannot be modified.

abilities.name: Storm, Earth, Fire
abilities.description:
After 1 second, Chen splits into three elemental spirits for 12 seconds, each with 70% of Chen's maximum Health and a unique Ability.  The last spirit Ability that is cast is empowered. If all three spirits are killed, Chen will die as well.

Storm can grant the spirits a Shield. 
Earth can leap to an area and Slow enemies. 
Fire can grant the spirits Attack Speed, damage.

abilities.name: Wandering Keg
abilities.description: Roll around inside an Unstoppable barrel with 70% increased Movement Speed and 25 Armor, dealing 59 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the way and knocking them back. Lasts for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Fortifying Brew
abilities.description: Chen drinks from his keg, gaining 50 Brew and 190 (+4% per level) temporary Shields per second, up to a maximum of 570 (+4% per level) while drinking. Shields persist for 4 seconds after he stops drinking.

1.name: Accumulating Flame
1.description:
Reward: Damage enemy Heroes with Breath of Fire to permanently increase periodic damage by 0.25. Kills grant 2.

Reward: After gaining 25 damage, increase the range of Keg Smash.

Mythic Reward: Upon gaining 80 damage, Breath of Fire reduces enemy Armor by 20 and its duration is increased by 0.75 seconds each time Chen attacks the Hero.

1.name: Freshest Ingredients
1.description:
Increase the healing duration of Regeneration Globes by 150%.

Quest: Gather 15 Regeneration Globes.

Reward: Reduce Fortifying Brew's cooldown by 2 seconds, and 50% of its Shield persists indefinitely after drinking.

1.name: Stormstout Secret Recipe
1.description: Chen heals for 3.5% of his maximum Health when his Basic Abilities hit an enemy Hero.

4.name: Deadly Strike
4.description: Flying Kick no longer costs Brew. Additionally, its damage is increased by 125% while Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew.

4.name: Eye of the Tiger
4.description: Basic Attacks against Brew-soaked enemy Heroes deal 50% more damage and heal Chen for 60% of the damage done.

4.name: Withering Flames
4.description: Igniting an enemy Hero reduces their Spell Power by 60% for 4 seconds.

7.name: Gift of the Ox
7.description: Increase the duration of Stagger's damage prevention by 2 seconds, and reduce the amount of damage taken over time to 50% of damage taken.

7.name: Brewmaster's Balance
7.description: While at or below 50 Brew, gain 20% Movement Speed. While at or above 50 Brew, regenerate an additional 18 (+4% per level) Health per second.

7.name: Elusive Brawler
7.description: Activate to gain 20% Movement Speed and Evade enemy Basic Attacks for 2 seconds. Chen's Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 2 seconds.

10.name: Wandering Keg
10.description: Roll around inside an Unstoppable barrel with 70% increased Movement Speed and 25 Armor, dealing 59 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the way and knocking them back. Lasts for 5 seconds.

10.name: Storm, Earth, Fire
10.description:
After 1 second, Chen splits into three elemental spirits for 12 seconds, each with 70% of Chen's maximum Health and a unique Ability.  The last spirit Ability that is cast is empowered. If all three spirits are killed, Chen will die as well.

Storm can grant the spirits a Shield. 
Earth can leap to an area and Slow enemies. 
Fire can grant the spirits Attack Speed, damage.

13.name: Pressure Point
13.description: Flying Kick Slows the target enemy by 40% for 1.5 seconds, or by 80% if Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew.

13.name: A Touch of Honey
13.description: Increase the Slows from Keg Smash by 20% and its duration by 0.5 seconds.

13.name: Ring of Fire
13.description: After Igniting an enemy, become bathed in a fiery aura, dealing 60 (+4% per level) damage every second to nearby enemies for 6 seconds.

13.name: Enough to Share
13.description: Fortifying Brew instantly grants Chen a Shield that absorbs 190 (+4% per level) damage, and each second grants nearby allied Heroes a Shield that absorbs 140 (+4% per level) damage, up to 420 (+4% per level).

16.name: Flying Leap
16.description: Increase Flying Kick's range by 15% and reduce its cooldown by 0.5 seconds each time an enemy Hero takes damage from being Ignited.

16.name: Celerity
16.description: Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Stagger by 2 seconds and grant Chen 30 Armor for 3 seconds.

16.name: Combo Strikes
16.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same target deals 75% bonus damage. While Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew and for 2 seconds after, he gains 35% Attack Speed.

20.name: Untapped Potential
20.description: Increase Wandering Keg's Movement Speed bonus from 70% to 125%, and its Armor bonus to 75 for its duration and 5 seconds afterwards.

20.name: Elemental Conduit
20.description: Increase the spirits' Health to 100% of Chen's maximum Health and all of their Abilities are empowered.

20.name: Purifying Brew
20.description: Casting Fortifying Brew grants Chen Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

20.name: Energizing Brew
20.description: If Chen Channels Fortifying Brew for its full duration, then he gains 20% bonus Health and 20% bonus damage for 25 seconds.

cho.name: Cho
cho.description: Head 1 of a 2 Headed Hero, Cho controls the body of Cho'gall.

abilities.name: Surging Fist
abilities.description: Activate to begin charging Surging Fist. Activate again to dash forward, knocking aside enemies and dealing 46 (+4% per level) damage. The dash range increases by up to 250%, depending on how long it is charged.

abilities.name: Consuming Blaze
abilities.description: Ignite nearby enemies, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds. Basic Attacking burning enemies re-Ignites them. Cho is healed for 40 (+4% per level) when an enemy is Ignited.

abilities.name: Rune Bomb
abilities.description: Roll a bomb dealing 91 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in its path. Gall can use Runic Blast to detonate it to deal 210 (+4% per level) damage in an area.

abilities.name: Upheaval
abilities.description: After 1 second, pull enemies towards Cho'gall, Slowing them by 25% for 3 seconds and dealing 175 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Hammer of Twilight
abilities.description:
Activate to swing the Hammer of Twilight, dealing 150 (+4.5% per level) damage, pushing enemies away, and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

Passive: Cho's Basic Attacks deal 25% increased damage.

abilities.name: Ogre Hide
abilities.description: Activate to gain 25 Armor, but reduce Gall's damage by 25%.

1.name: Consuming Fire
1.description: Consuming Blaze restores 75 (+4% per level) more Health when a Hero is Ignited.

1.name: Calloused Hide
1.description: While under 50% maximum Health, Cho gains 15% increased Movement Speed and healing received.

1.name: The Will of Cho
1.description:
