abilities.description: Summon a Cloud Serpent on an allied Hero that attacks nearby enemies every second. Each attack deals 26 (+4% per level) damage and heals the ally for 20 (+4% per level). Lasts for 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Blinding Wind
abilities.description: Throw a cloud of wind at the 2 nearest enemies (prioritizing Heroes), dealing 133 (+4% per level) damage. Heroes hit are Blinded and Slowed by 15% for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Jug of 1,000 Cups
abilities.description: Channel for up to 6 seconds. Every 0.25 seconds, increase the cooldown of Jug of 1,000 Cups by 2 seconds, up to 50 additional seconds, and heal the lowest Health nearby allied Hero for 75 (+4% per level) Health.

abilities.name: Water Dragon
abilities.description: Li Li channels for 2 seconds, summoning a Water Dragon that hits the nearest enemy Hero within 12 range and all enemies near them, dealing 300 (+4% per level) damage and slowing their Movement Speed by 70% for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Fast Feet
abilities.description: Upon taking damage, your Basic Ability cooldowns refresh 50% faster and you gain 10% Movement Speed for 1 second.

1.name: Free Drinks
1.description: When Healing Brew heals a Hero under 50% Health, its cooldown is reduced by 1 second, and its Mana cost is refunded.

1.name: Serpent Sidekick
1.description: Cloud Serpent no longer costs Mana and while Fast Feet is active its cooldown refreshes an additional 75% faster.

1.name: Eager Adventurer
1.description: Increase Fast Feet's duration by 150% and increase Mana regeneration by 150% while Fast Feet is active.

4.name: Wind Serpent
4.description:
Cloud Serpent grants its bearer 10% increased Movement Speed. Casting Blinding Wind increases this bonus to 20% for 3 seconds. 

Passive: Cloud Serpent attacks 25% faster.

4.name: Surging Winds
4.description: If Blinding Wind targets 2 or more Heroes, its cooldown is instantly reduced by 2 seconds and Li Li gains 10% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

4.name: Safety Sprint
4.description:
Activate to gain Fast Feet, 30 Armor, and 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

Passive: While Fast Feet is active, Li Li gains 10 Armor.

7.name: The Good Stuff
7.description: Healing Brew heals for an additional 42 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds. While Fast Feet is active, this heal amount is increased by 100%.

7.name: Mass Vortex
7.description: Increase the number of enemies hit by Blinding Wind from 2 to 3. Blinding Wind deals 75% more damage when it targets 3 Heroes.

7.name: Let's Go!
7.description:
Activate to heal an allied Hero for 160 (+4% per level) and make them Unstoppable for 1 second. Let's Go's cooldown is affected by Fast Feet.

Cannot be used on Li Li.

10.name: Jug of 1,000 Cups
10.description: Channel for up to 6 seconds. Every 0.25 seconds, increase the cooldown of Jug of 1,000 Cups by 2 seconds, up to 50 additional seconds, and heal the lowest Health nearby allied Hero for 75 (+4% per level) Health.

10.name: Water Dragon
10.description: Li Li channels for 2 seconds, summoning a Water Dragon that hits the nearest enemy Hero within 12 range and all enemies near them, dealing 300 (+4% per level) damage and slowing their Movement Speed by 70% for 4 seconds.

13.name: Lightning Serpent
13.description: Cloud Serpent attacks bounce to hit 2 additional targets for 13 (+4% per level) damage and 10 (+4% per level) healing.

13.name: Gale Force
13.description: Increase Blinding Wind's Blind duration by 0.75 seconds. Li Li's Basic Attacks against Blinded Heroes deal 100% increased damage.

13.name: Hindering Winds
13.description: Increase Blinding Wind's Slow amount to 30% and its duration to 2 seconds.

16.name: Two For One
16.description: Increases the number of allies healed by Healing Brew to 2, but increases the cooldown by 1 second.

16.name: Pick Me Up
16.description: Healing Brew heals for 33% more when the target is under 50% Health.

16.name: Blessings Of Yu’lon
16.description: Cloud Serpent grants its bearer 10% increased healing received and heals them for an additional 0.5% of their maximum Health each time it attacks.

20.name: Jug of 1,000,000 Cups
20.description: Jug of 1,000 Cups heals two allies at a time.

20.name: Double Dragon
20.description: After hitting a target with Water Dragon, another Water Dragon is summoned at the point of impact.

20.name: Mistweaver
20.description: Activate to heal nearby allied Heroes for 149 (+4% per level). Basic Attacks and Cloud Serpent attacks reduce the cooldown of Mistweaver by 1 second.

20.name: Shake It Off
20.description:
While Stunned, Silenced, or Rooted and for 2 seconds afterwards, Li Li gains 35 Armor.

Passive: Increase Fast Feet's cooldown refresh rate to 75%.

thelostvikings.name: The Lost Vikings
thelostvikings.description: Three Heroes in one! Can gather experience from multiple locations.

abilities.name: Longboat Raid!
abilities.description:
Hop into an Unstoppable Longboat that fires at nearby enemies for 128 (+4% per level) damage per second and can fire a mortar that deals 228 (+4% per level) damage in an area.  The boat has increased Health for each Viking inside. If the boat is destroyed by enemies, all Vikings are Stunned for 1 second. Lasts 15 seconds.

Requires all surviving Vikings to be nearby.

abilities.name: Play Again!
abilities.description:
Summon, fully heal, and revive all Lost Vikings at target location after a Viking channels for 2 seconds. 

Only one Viking may attempt to summon at a time.

abilities.name: Viking Hoard
abilities.description:
Gathering a Regeneration Globe with a Viking permanently increases all their Health Regeneration by 0.5 per second.

Current Bonus: 0 Regen per second

abilities.name: Go Go Go!
abilities.description: The Vikings gain 30% increased Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Select Olaf
abilities.description:
Olaf can charge enemies and slow their Movement Speed by 30% for 3 seconds by right-clicking on them. 8 second cooldown. 

Olaf gains increased Health Regeneration when out of combat for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Select Baleog
abilities.description: Baleog's Basic Attacks deal 50% damage to enemies behind his attack target.

abilities.name: Select Erik
abilities.description: Erik moves faster than the other Vikings and has increased Basic Attack range.

abilities.name: Select All Vikings
abilities.description: The Lost Vikings can be controlled individually or as a group. Each Viking has particular strengths.

1.name: Olaf the Stout
1.description:
Passive: Olaf gains 20% bonus maximum Health.

Every 5 seconds, Olaf gains 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

Stores up to 2 charges.

1.name: Spy Games
1.description: After standing still for 3 seconds, Erik gains Stealth and his Sight Radius is increased by 75%. The Stealth persists for 3 seconds after moving and once removed, Erik gains 75% bonus Basic Attack damage for 6 seconds.

1.name: Explosive Attacks
1.description: Baleog's Basic Attack splash damage against non-Heroes is no longer reduced by 50%.

1.name: Viking Bribery
1.description: Enemy Minions or captured Mercenaries killed near The Lost Vikings grant stacks of Bribe. Use 40 stacks to bribe target Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries. Maximum stacks available: 200.

4.name: Pain Don't Hurt
4.description: Baleog's Basic Attacks and splash damage heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Healing is doubled against Heroes.

4.name: Erik the Swift
4.description: Permanently increases Erik's base Movement Speed by 10%, and as long as Erik is moving he heals 34 (+4% per level) Health per second.

4.name: It's a Sabotage!
4.description: Erik's Basic Attacks against Structures light them on fire for 3 seconds, causing 225 (+4% per level) damage.

4.name: Mercenary Lord
4.description: Friendly non-Boss Mercenaries near your Hero deal 50% more damage. Gain 50 Armor against Minions and Mercenaries, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

7.name: Baleog the Fierce
7.description: Increase Baleog's attack range by 2.5. While near Olaf and Erik, he becomes inspired by the power of teamwork and his Attack Speed is increased by 50%.

7.name: Spin To Win!
7.description: Activate to have each Viking deal 85 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.  Deals 100% bonus damage to enemy Heroes.

7.name: Norse Force!
7.description: All Vikings gain a 140 (+4% per level) to 308 (+4% per level) point Shield, increasing in strength for each Viking alive. Lasts 4 seconds.

10.name: Longboat Raid!
10.description:
Hop into an Unstoppable Longboat that fires at nearby enemies for 128 (+4% per level) damage per second and can fire a mortar that deals 228 (+4% per level) damage in an area.  The boat has increased Health for each Viking inside. If the boat is destroyed by enemies, all Vikings are Stunned for 1 second. Lasts 15 seconds.

Requires all surviving Vikings to be nearby.

10.name: Play Again!
10.description:
Summon, fully heal, and revive all Lost Vikings at target location after a Viking channels for 2 seconds. 

Only one Viking may attempt to summon at a time.

13.name: Hunka' Burning Olaf
13.description: Olaf deals 34 (+4% per level) damage every second to nearby enemies.

13.name: Jump!
13.description: Makes all Vikings Invulnerable and able to pass over enemies for 1.5 seconds.

13.name: Nordic Attack Squad
13.description: While Olaf, Baleog, and Erik are near each of the other two Vikings, their Basic Attacks deal bonus damage equal to 1.25% maximum Health to enemy Heroes.

16.name: Large and In Charge
16.description: When Olaf charges enemies, they are stunned for 1 second.

16.name: Impatience Is a Virtue
16.description: Enemies damaged by a Viking's Basic Attack reduce the cooldown of all Viking Abilities by 0.3125 seconds.

16.name: 64 KB Marathon
16.description: Activating Go Go Go! grants an additional 40% Movement Speed and breaks the Vikings out of Roots and Slows.

16.name: Executioner
16.description: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases your Basic Attack damage by 30% for 3 seconds.

20.name: Ragnarok 'n' Roll!
20.description: The Longboat can attack two targets at once and the range of its Mortar is increased by 100%. Reduce Longboat Raid!'s cooldown by 30 seconds.

20.name: Checkpoint Reached
20.description: 10 seconds after using Play Again!, any dead Vikings are revived and summoned again, and all are healed to full.

20.name: The Sequel!
20.description: Reduces the Lost Vikings's death timer by 50%.

20.name: Fury of the Storm
20.description: Every 5 seconds, the next Basic Attack will deal an additional 41 (+4% per level) damage to the target, and 105 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby Minions, Mercenaries and Monsters. Each Viking has their own cooldown.

lcio.name: Lúcio
lcio.description: A sustained Healer who gives his team mobility and peels enemies off allies.

abilities.name: Soundwave
abilities.description: Deal 105 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in an area and knock them back.

abilities.name: Crossfade
abilities.description:
Currently playing Speed Boost, increasing the Movement Speed of Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes by 10%.

Toggle to play Healing Boost instead.

abilities.name: Amp It Up
abilities.description: Raise Lúcio's Crossfade track volume for 3 seconds, amping Healing Boost to 112 (+4% per level) Health per second and Speed Boost to 30% increased Movement Speed.

abilities.name: Sound Barrier
abilities.description: After 1 second, Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes gain a 1296 (+4% per level) point Shield that rapidly decays over 6 seconds.

abilities.name: High Five
abilities.description: Quickly skate to an allied Hero. Upon arrival the ally is healed for 230 (+4% per level), Lúcio is healed for 80 (+4% per level), and both gain Unstoppable for 1 second.

abilities.name: Push Off
abilities.description: While moving alongside terrain, activate to slide towards a targeted location. Enemies hit take 100 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 75% for 1 second.

abilities.name: Wall Ride
abilities.description: When moving alongside terrain, Lúcio begins to Wall Ride for 2 seconds. While Wall Ride is active, Lúcio can walk through units and gains 20% Movement Speed that stacks with other bonuses.

1.name: Party Mix
1.description:
Quest: Play Lúcio's Crossfade tracks to nearby allies. Multiple allies provide additional time.

Reward: For every 1 Minute played, permanently increase Lúcio's maximum Mana by 10. 
Reward: Once you have played for 8 minutes or more, permanently increase Crossfade's radius by 20%.

1.name: Accelerando
1.description: Wall Ride's Movement Speed bonus gradually increases to 40% over 6 seconds while Lúcio maintains its effect.

1.name: Smooth Moves
1.description:
While Wall Ride is active, Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt and restore 0.5 Mana.

Passive: Increase Wall Ride duration by 1 second.

4.name: Subwoofer
4.description:
Enemies within the first half of Soundwave's range are knocked back 75% further.

Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single Soundwave.

Reward: Increase Soundwave's arc by 50% and its range by 20%.

4.name: Off the Wall
4.description: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave while Wall Ride is active sets its cooldown to 5 seconds and refunds 15 Mana.

4.name: Supersonic
4.description: While Wall Ride is active, Push Off's cooldown recharges 100% faster.

7.name: Good Vibrations
7.description: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave grants Lúcio a 38 (+4% per level) Shield for 8 seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes grants 3 times this amount.

7.name: Reverse Amp
7.description:
Blast Lúcio's active Crossfade track at enemy Heroes. While Amp It Up is active, Healing Boost deals 50 (+4% per level) damage per second and Speed Boost Slows by 20%.

This ability is unaffected by Crossfade talents.

7.name: Boombox
7.description:
Place a boombox that plays Lúcio's active Crossfade track. Its volume adjusts with Amp It Up. Allied Heroes near the boombox gain 5 Armor.

Crossfade tracks from Lúcio and the Boombox do not stack.

10.name: Sound Barrier
10.description: After 1 second, Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes gain a 1296 (+4% per level) point Shield that rapidly decays over 6 seconds.

10.name: High Five
10.description: Quickly skate to an allied Hero. Upon arrival the ally is healed for 230 (+4% per level), Lúcio is healed for 80 (+4% per level), and both gain Unstoppable for 1 second.

13.name: All Together
13.description: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 5% Movement Speed that stacks with other bonuses.

13.name: Heavy Casters
13.description: Push Off no longer Slows the first Hero hit, and instead Stuns them for 0.5 seconds.

13.name: Slip
13.description: While Wall Ride is active, passing near an enemy Hero increases its Movement Speed bonus to 40%, and grants 15 Armor, for 1 second.

16.name: Rejuvenescência
16.description: While Amp It Up is active, Crossfade's Healing Boost heals for an additional 2.5% of the target's maximum Health each second.

16.name: Up the Frequency
16.description:
Hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Amp It Up by 0.3 seconds.

Passive: Wall Ride increases Basic Attack range by 2.2.

16.name: Up To Eleven
16.description:
Hitting an enemy Hero with Soundwave or Push Off increases the duration of Amp It Up.

Soundwave grants 0.5 seconds and Push Off grants 1 second. If Amp It Up is not active, these bonuses are granted to its next activation, up to 3 seconds.

Passive: Increase the duration of Amp It Up by 1 second.

20.name: Bossa Nova
20.description: Reduce the cooldown of Sound Barrier to 30 seconds, but the Shield now decays over 4 seconds.

20.name: Mixing Fire
20.description:
High Five can now be cast on enemy Heroes, dealing 160 (+4% per level) damage and reducing all healing received by 50% for 3 seconds.

Passive: Reduce the cost and cooldown of High Five by 30%.

20.name: House Party
20.description: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 8% increased healing.

20.name: Summer Anthem
20.description: Activate for allies affected by Crossfade to become Unkillable for 1.5 seconds.

maiev.name: Maiev
maiev.description: A mobile Assassin that excels against clustered enemies and prevents their escape.

abilities.name: Fan of Knives
abilities.description:
Deal 152 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a crescent area.

Hitting at least 2 enemy Heroes with Fan of Knives reduces its cooldown to 0.5 seconds, and refunds its Mana cost.

abilities.name: Umbral Bind
abilities.description: Maiev's next Basic Attack cleaves and applies a tether to enemy Heroes hit for 2.5 seconds. If a tethered Hero moves too far from Maiev, they are pulled toward her, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage and breaking the tether.

abilities.name: Spirit of Vengeance
abilities.description: Send a shadow of Maiev outward that will return to its cast location, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies along both paths. If an enemy Hero is hit, reduce the cooldown by 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Containment Disc
abilities.description:
Throw a glaive in the target direction. If an enemy Hero is hit, Containment Disc can be reactivated to remove their vision and Time Stop them for 4 seconds. Leaving Containment Silences the enemy Hero for 1.5 seconds.

Containment Disc automatically activates 6 seconds after hitting a Hero.

abilities.name: Warden's Cage
abilities.description: Summon 8 Warden Avatars as a cage around Maiev. After 1.5 seconds, enemy Heroes that come in contact with an Avatar consume it and are knocked to the center of the cage. Warden Avatars last 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Vault of the Wardens
abilities.description:
Leap into the air, becoming Immune to all hostile effects for 0.75 seconds.

After reaching Level 20, Vault of the Wardens gains an additional charge.

1.name: Bonds of Justice
1.description:
Quest: Each tether applied to a secondary target of Umbral Bind permanently increases Umbral Bind's pull damage by 15.

Reward: After applying 5 tethers to secondary targets, increase Umbral Bind's pull damage by 75.

Reward: After applying 10 tethers to secondary targets, increase Umbral Bind's cleave damage by 30%.

1.name: Pursuit of Vengeance
1.description: Each Hero tethered by Umbral Bind reduces the cooldown of Spirit of Vengeance by 2.5 seconds and each Hero hit by Spirit of Vengeance reduces the cooldown of Umbral Bind by 1 second.

1.name: Naisha's Memento
1.description:
Activate to make primary Basic Attacks bounce between nearby enemies up to 2 times. Lasts 8 seconds.

Recharge Naisha's Memento by hitting at least 2 Heroes with a single Fan of Knives.

4.name: Pin Down
4.description:
Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single Fan of Knives.

Reward: Increase Fan of Knives damage by 35%.

Reward: Each additional time 3 enemy Heroes are hit by a single Fan of Knives, gain an additional 5% damage, up to 50%.

Reward: Hit 4 enemy Heroes with a single Fan of Knives to instantly gain all Rewards.

4.name: Blade Dance
4.description: Using Fan of Knives deals 50 (+4% per level) Physical Damage to enemies around Maiev.

4.name: Sudden Vengeance
4.description: After blinking with Spirit of Vengeance, the shadow explodes, damaging all nearby enemy Heroes for 6% of their maximum Health.

7.name: Elune's Wrath
7.description: Hitting at least 2 Heroes with a single Fan of Knives causes the next Fan of Knives to drop a star on targets that deals 77 (+4% per level) damage when it impacts.

7.name: Bonds of Corruption
7.description: Enemy Heroes pulled by Umbral Bind have their Armor reduced by 15 and are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds

7.name: Ruthless Spirit
7.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Spirit of Vengeance increases all damage Maiev deals by 15% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 30%.

10.name: Containment Disc
10.description:
Throw a glaive in the target direction. If an enemy Hero is hit, Containment Disc can be reactivated to remove their vision and Time Stop them for 4 seconds. Leaving Containment Silences the enemy Hero for 1.5 seconds.

Containment Disc automatically activates 6 seconds after hitting a Hero.

10.name: Warden's Cage
10.description: Summon 8 Warden Avatars as a cage around Maiev. After 1.5 seconds, enemy Heroes that come in contact with an Avatar consume it and are knocked to the center of the cage. Warden Avatars last 5 seconds.

13.name: Bladed Armor
13.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Fan of Knives grants 5 Armor for 5 seconds, up to 20 Armor.

13.name: Chain Gang
13.description: Tethering at least 2 enemy Heroes with Umbral Bind grants 35 Armor for 4 seconds.

13.name: Shadow Armor
13.description: Blink grants 20 Armor for 3.5 seconds. Maiev's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes refresh this duration.

16.name: Vengeful Knives
16.description: Dealing damage to enemy Heroes causes the next cast of Fan of Knives that hits enemy Heroes to deal 1% maximum Health as bonus damage, up to 5%.

16.name: Cruel Chain
16.description: Umbral Bind grants 25% Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds. In addition, each time Maiev deals damage to tethered targets, Umbral Bind's pull damage to all targets is increased by 30%, up to 150%.

16.name: Armored Assault
16.description: While Maiev has positive Armor of any kind, all Physical Damage dealt is increased by 25%.

20.name: Shadow Orb: Vengeance
20.description:
Activate to reset the cooldown of Spirit of Vengeance.

Recharge Shadow Orb by damaging enemy Heroes with Spirit of Vengeance 5 times.

20.name: Shadow Orb: Huntress
20.description:
Activate to increase Movement Speed and Attack Speed by 40% for 5 seconds.

Recharge Shadow Orb by dealing Physical Damage to enemy Heroes 10 times.

20.name: Shadow Orb: Shadow Strike
20.description:
Activate to deal 75 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy Hero, Slowing them by 30% and reducing their Armor by 20 for 4 seconds.

Recharge Shadow Orb by dealing Spell Damage to enemy Heroes 10 times.

malfurion.name: Malfurion
malfurion.description: A strong sustained Healer who can help lockdown enemies to secure takedowns.

abilities.name: Regrowth
abilities.description: Heal an allied Hero for 380 (+4% per level) Health over 20 seconds.

abilities.name: Moonfire
abilities.description:
Deal 90 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in an area and reveal them for 2 seconds.

Allies with an active Regrowth are healed for 130 (+4% per level) Health for each enemy Hero hit by Moonfire.

abilities.name: Entangling Roots
abilities.description: Root enemy Heroes in an area for 1.25 seconds, and deal 117 (+4% per level) damage over the duration. Affected area grows over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Tranquility
abilities.description: Heal nearby allied Heroes for 80 (+4% per level) Health per second for 8 seconds. Allies affected by Regrowth within Tranquility's area gain 10 Armor.

abilities.name: Twilight Dream
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 310 (+4% per level) damage in a large area around Malfurion, Silencing enemies making them unable to use Abilities for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Innervate
abilities.description:
Grant an allied Hero 20% of their maximum Mana over 5 seconds. While affected by Innervate, their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 50% faster.

Cannot be used on Heroes that do not use Mana.

1.name: Deep Roots
1.description:
Entangling Roots grows 25% larger, and persist on the ground 40% longer.

Repeatable Quest: Every time an enemy Hero becomes Rooted, gain 14 Mana permanently.

1.name: Vengeful Roots
1.description:
Entangling Roots spawns a Treant that deals 58 damage per second and loses Health over 11 seconds.

Repeatable Quest: Hitting enemy Heroes with Entangling Roots permanently increases the Treant's Basic Attack damage by 7.

1.name: Emerald Dreams
1.description: Entangling Roots Sleeps enemy Heroes for 2 seconds after its Root expires.

4.name: Rejuvenation
4.description: Casting Regrowth on an ally also grants Malfurion its effect for 50% normal duration.

4.name: Celestial Alignment
4.description: Increase Moonfire's reveal duration by 3 seconds. Malfurion's Basic Attacks against Heroes revealed by Moonfire deal 85% more damage.

4.name: Shan'do's Clarity
4.description: Gain a second charge of Innervate. Its cooldown recharges 25% faster per ally affected by Regrowth.

7.name: Wild Growth
7.description: Each Hero hit by Moonfire extends the duration of currently active Regrowths by 1 second.

7.name: Tenacious Roots
7.description: Increase the Root duration of Entangling Roots by 25%. When Malfurion is Stunned, the cooldown of Entangling Roots is instantly reset. This can only occur every 10 seconds.

7.name: Nature's Cure
7.description: Activate to remove all Stuns, Roots, and Slows from allies affected by Regrowth.

10.name: Tranquility
10.description: Heal nearby allied Heroes for 80 (+4% per level) Health per second for 8 seconds. Allies affected by Regrowth within Tranquility's area gain 10 Armor.

10.name: Twilight Dream
10.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 310 (+4% per level) damage in a large area around Malfurion, Silencing enemies making them unable to use Abilities for 3 seconds.

13.name: Nature's Swiftness
13.description: Malfurion gains 6% Movement Speed for every active Regrowth.

13.name: Hindering Moonfire
13.description: Moonfire Slows Heroes hit by 25% for 3 seconds.

13.name: Revitalize
13.description: Using Innervate also grants Malfurion 15% of his max Mana and causes his Basic Ability cooldowns to refresh 50% faster for 5 seconds.

16.name: Ysera's Gift
16.description: While Malfurion is above 75% Health, Regrowth's healing-over-time is increased by 75%.

16.name: Nature's Balance
16.description: Increase Moonfire's area by 25% and Regrowth's duration by 5 seconds.

16.name: Moonlit Harmony
16.description: Increase Moonfire's heal by 20%, and 15% per ally affected by Regrowth.

20.name: Serenity
20.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Moonfire reduces the cooldown of Tranquility by 3 seconds. Increase Tranquility's healing by 25% and 10% per ally affected by Regrowth.

20.name: Astral Communion
20.description:
Activate to Channel for 1 second, and then instantly teleport and cast Twilight Dream at the targeted location. Cooldown is shared with Twilight Dream.

Passive: Increase Twilight Dream's Silence duration to 5 seconds.

20.name: Lifebloom
20.description: Casting Regrowth instantly heals its target for 10% of their missing Health.

20.name: Lunar Shower
20.description: If Moonfire hits a Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 1 second and the next Moonfire within 6 seconds deals 20% more damage. This damage bonus stacks up to 60%.

malganis.name: Mal'Ganis
malganis.description: A self-sustaining Tank that peels for allies and disrupts enemies.

abilities.name: Fel Claws
abilities.description:
Violently slash in the chosen direction, dealing 66 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.

Reactivate to slash up to 2 more times. The third slash Stuns enemies for 0.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Necrotic Embrace
abilities.description:
Desecrate the air, dealing 121 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and gaining 15 Spell Armor for 3 Seconds.

This ability's base damage provides double healing from Vampiric Touch.

abilities.name: Night Rush
abilities.description: After 0.62 seconds, gain 50% Movement Speed for 2 seconds. While active, Mal'Ganis can move through enemy Heroes and put them to Sleep for 2.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Dark Conversion
abilities.description: Channel on an enemy Hero for 0.75 seconds, then swap Health percentages with the target over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Carrion Swarm
abilities.description:
After 1 second, disperse into an Invulnerable swarm of bats for 3 seconds, dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies.

Vampiric Touch heals for 75% of Carrion Swarm's damage to Heroes.

abilities.name: Vampiric Touch
abilities.description: Mal'Ganis heals for 50% of damage dealt to enemy Heroes and 15% of damage dealt to non-Heroes.

1.name: Will of Tichondrius
1.description:
Quest: Hit Heroes with Fel Claws to permanently increase Fel Claw's damage by 0.25.
Quest: Hit 4 Heroes in the first 2 slashes to cause the final slash to increase damage by 1.

Reward: Upon gaining 20 bonus damage, the final Stun is increased by 0.25 seconds and the final slash steals 4% of enemy Hero Health.

1.name: Winged Guard
1.description:
Each time Necrotic Embrace hits an enemy Hero, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack.

If Winged Guard has no charges, Mal'Ganis will gain 1 charge after 5 seconds.

1.name: Time to Feed
1.description: Mal'Ganis heals for 70 (+4% per level) when damaging a nearby enemy Hero. This can occur once every 6 seconds against each enemy Hero, but is also refreshed when they are Slept by Night Rush.

4.name: Might of Sargeras
4.description: Necrotic Embrace now provides 35 Armor for 3 seconds.

4.name: Echo of Doom
4.description:
When Necrotic Embrace expires, it explodes again for 68 (+4% per level) damage. For each enemy Hero hit, gain 5 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Necrotic Embrace by 0.75 seconds.

Does not wake Sleeping targets.

4.name: Vampiric Aura
4.description: Mal'Ganis heals for 40% of Physical Damage dealt, and nearby allied Heroes heal for 20% of Physical Damage dealt.

7.name: Black Claws
7.description: After Mal'Ganis hits an enemy Hero with Fel Claws, his next Basic Attack deals 60% more damage and reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes by 15 for 2 seconds.

7.name: Fueled by Torment
7.description: Necrotic Embrace now Slows nearby enemies by 25% for 3 seconds.

7.name: Spreading Plague
7.description:
After casting Night Rush, deal 33 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. This effect lasts for 5 seconds and Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh its duration.

Does not wake Sleeping targets.

10.name: Carrion Swarm
10.description:
After 1 second, disperse into an Invulnerable swarm of bats for 3 seconds, dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies.

Vampiric Touch heals for 75% of Carrion Swarm's damage to Heroes.

10.name: Dark Conversion
10.description: Channel on an enemy Hero for 0.75 seconds, then swap Health percentages with the target over 3 seconds.

13.name: Deep Sleep
13.description: Increase Night Rush's Sleep duration by 0.75 seconds and its Movement Speed bonus by 15%.

13.name: The Night Beckons
13.description: Basic Attacks deal 200% bonus damage to Sleeping enemies. After Night Rush's Sleep ends, targets are Slowed by 30% for 3 seconds.

13.name: Blood Rush
13.description: When Mal'Ganis is healed by a Hero, he gains 1% Movement Speed for 6 seconds, up to 15%.

16.name: Plague Bats
16.description: Necrotic Embrace unleashes a wave of bats in front of Mal'Ganis, dealing 81 (+4% per level) damage.

16.name: Frenzied Assault
16.description:
Basic Attacks against Heroes with a higher Health percentage heal for an additional 50% of damage dealt.

Basic Attacks against Heroes with a lower Health percentage grant 35% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

16.name: Blind as a Bat
16.description:
Activate to erupt with blind rage, removing the cooldown and Mana cost of Fel Claws, but losing all vision. Lasts 5.5 seconds. 

Enemy Heroes hit by the final slash of Fel Claws reduces the cooldown of this Ability by 4 seconds.

Does not provide quest stacks while active.

20.name: Seeker Swarm
20.description: Upon expiring, Carrion Swarm's bats seek nearby enemy Heroes, dealing 132 (+4% per level) damage and Sleeping them for 2.5 seconds.

20.name: Wrath of Nathreza
20.description:
Enemy Heroes near the target suffer 85% of the transferred Health as damage over 3 seconds.

Does not benefit from Vampiric Touch.

20.name: Vanquish the Weak
20.description: Damage from Fel Claws and Basic Attacks Slows enemies by 25% for 1.5 seconds, and Vampiric Touch converts 10% more damage into healing versus Slowed Heroes.

20.name: Alone in the Dark
20.description: Reduce the cooldown of Night Rush by 4 seconds. Enemy Heroes put to Sleep by Night Rush have their vision greatly reduced during the Sleep and for 2 seconds after.

malthael.name: Malthael
malthael.description: A Bruiser who marks his enemies, shredding away high Health enemies.

abilities.name: Soul Rip
abilities.description: Extract the souls of nearby enemies afflicted by Reaper's Mark, dealing 100 (+4% per level) damage and healing Malthael for 25 (+4% per level) per target hit. Heroic targets heal Malthael for an additional 4% of the Hero's maximum Health.

abilities.name: Wraith Strike
abilities.description: Instantly teleport through an enemy afflicted by Reaper's Mark, dealing 59 (+4% per level) damage and refreshing Reaper's Mark.

abilities.name: Death Shroud
abilities.description: After 0.25 seconds, unleash a wave of dark mist that applies Reaper's Mark to enemies it hits.

abilities.name: Tormented Souls
abilities.description:
Unleash a torrent of souls, continually applying Reaper's Mark to nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

Tormented Souls resets the cooldown of Wraith Strike when activated, and while active, Wraith Strike costs no Mana its cooldown is reduced to 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Last Rites
abilities.description:
Apply a death sentence to an enemy Hero that, after 2 seconds, deals damage equal to 50% of their missing Health.

Quest: Enemies killed between the application of Last Rites and within 1.5 seconds of it dealing damage permanently reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds, to a minimum of 20 seconds.

abilities.name: Reaper's Mark
abilities.description: Basic Attacks cleave in an area in front of Malthael and afflict non-Structure targets with Reaper's Mark for 4 seconds. Marked enemies are revealed and take damage equal to 2% of their maximum Health every 1 second.

1.name: Death's Reach
1.description: Increase Wraith Strike's range by 35%.

1.name: On a Pale Horse
1.description: Gain an additional 20% Movement Speed while mounted.

1.name: Fear the Reaper
1.description: Activate to increase Movement Speed by 25% and pass through other units for 4 seconds.

4.name: Die Alone
4.description: Soul Rip deals 50% more damage to Heroes if it hits only one Hero.

4.name: Throwing Shade
4.description:
Increase Death Shroud's range by 33%, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds, and reduce its Mana cost from 50 to 30.

Death Shroud's initial impact deals 2% maximum Health as damage to non-Structure enemies.

4.name: Black Harvest
4.description:
Quest: Apply Reaper's Mark to Heroes for a total of 150 seconds.

Reward: Permanently increase Reaper's Mark's duration by 2 seconds.

7.name: Cold Hand
7.description: Soul Rip Slows enemies by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

7.name: Massacre
7.description: Wraith Strike now damages and applies Reaper's Mark to enemies around its target.

7.name: Touch of Death
7.description: Activate to reduce healing received by Heroes afflicted by Reaper's Mark by 50% for 4 seconds.

10.name: Tormented Souls
10.description:
Unleash a torrent of souls, continually applying Reaper's Mark to nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

Tormented Souls resets the cooldown of Wraith Strike when activated, and while active, Wraith Strike costs no Mana its cooldown is reduced to 2 seconds.

10.name: Last Rites
10.description:
Apply a death sentence to an enemy Hero that, after 2 seconds, deals damage equal to 50% of their missing Health.

Quest: Enemies killed between the application of Last Rites and within 1.5 seconds of it dealing damage permanently reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds, to a minimum of 20 seconds.

13.name: Soul Siphon
13.description: Increase Soul Rip's bonus healing from Heroes to 4.75% of the Hero's maximum Health.

13.name: Ethereal Existence
13.description: Gain 10 Physical Armor per enemy Hero afflicted by Reaper's Mark, up to a maximum of 30.

13.name: Inevitable End
13.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds, but remove all active Reaper's Marks.

13.name: Shroud of Wisdom
13.description: After 2 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor for 4 seconds.

16.name: Soul Collector
16.description: Reduce Soul Rip's cooldown by 0.5 seconds and increase its range by 25%.

16.name: Mortality
16.description: When damaging a Hero, Wraith Strike deals bonus damage equal to 8% of the Hero's maximum Health.

16.name: Memento Mori
16.description: Reaper's Mark deals 60% increased damage after afflicting an enemy for more than 4 seconds.

20.name: Reaper of Souls
20.description:
Increase the duration of Tormented Souls to 6 seconds, and while Tormented Souls is active, Hero Takedowns refresh its duration.

If 2 or more enemy Heroes are in Tormented Souls' radius, it does not decay.

20.name: Angel of Death
20.description: Last Rites heals for 100% of the damage dealt, and its current and future cooldown reduction bonuses are doubled.

20.name: Final Curtain
20.description: Death Shroud leaves a trail in its wake for 4 seconds, applying Reaper's Mark to enemies in its area.

20.name: No One Can Stop Death
20.description: Activate while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms but increase Malthael's next respawn time by 25%.

ltmorales.name: Lt. Morales
ltmorales.description: A strong, sustained Healer who's unbeatable if left alone by her enemies.

abilities.name: Healing Beam
abilities.description:
Heal target allied Hero or Minion for 172 (+4% per level) Health per second as long as they are in range. After not channeling Healing Beam for 2 seconds, regenerate 6 Energy per second.

Reactivate to switch targets, or self-cast to cancel channeling.

abilities.name: Safeguard
abilities.description: Grant target ally Hero 35 Armor for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Displacement Grenade
abilities.description: Fire a grenade that can be manually detonated, dealing 208 (+4% per level) to nearby enemies and knocking them away.

abilities.name: Stim Drone
abilities.description: Grant an allied Hero 75% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Medivac Dropship
abilities.description: Target a location for a Medivac transport. For up to 10 seconds before takeoff, allies can right-click to enter the Medivac.

abilities.name: Caduceus Reactor
abilities.description: While channeling Healing Beam, Lt. Morales regenerates 2% of her maximum Health per second.

1.name: Caduceus Feedback
1.description: Increases Attack Range by 1.1 and Basic Attacks against Heroes generate 4 Energy.

1.name: Life Support
1.description:
During the first 2 seconds of Energy regeneration, Healing Beam regenerates 100% more Energy.

Passive: Increase your maximum Energy by 10.

1.name: Clear!
1.description:
Quest: Each enemy Hero hit with Displacement Grenade restores 3 Energy.

Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, reduce the cooldown of Displacement Grenade from 12 seconds to 9 seconds.

Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, increase the detonation area of Displacement Grenade by 25%.

4.name: Cellular Reactor
4.description:
Consume 30 Energy to heal Lt. Morales for 30% of her maximum Health over 3 seconds. Caduceus Reactor is disabled while this is active.

Passive: Generate 2 Energy each time Safeguard reduces damage, up to a maximum of 10 Energy per use.

4.name: Trauma Trigger
4.description:
Taking damage while below 40% Health grants 40 Armor for 3 seconds. This effect has a 30 second cooldown.

Passive: Increase the healing provided by Caduceus Reactor from 2% to 4% of Lt. Morales's maximum Health per second.

4.name: Blast Shield
4.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Displacement Grenade are Slowed by 50% for 1 second after being knocked away and grant Lt. Morales a Shield equal to 6% of her maximum Health. This shield stacks up to 5 times.

7.name: Physical Therapy
7.description: Safeguard removes all Slows from its target and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

7.name: Vanadium Plating
7.description:
While an ally affected by Safeguard is Stunned or Rooted, Safeguard grants an additional 20 Armor.

Passive: Increase the duration of Safeguard by 1 second.

7.name: Medi-Drone
7.description: Allies with Safeguard receive 75% of the healing done by Healing Beam on another ally.

10.name: Stim Drone
10.description: Grant an allied Hero 75% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 10 seconds.

10.name: Medivac Dropships
10.description:
Unlock the Medivac Dropship and Reinforcements abilities. These abilities share a cooldown.

Medivac Dropship
Target a location for a Medivac transport. For up to 10 seconds before takeoff, allies can right-click to enter the Medivac.

Reinforcements
Call down a Medivac Dropship at your Hall of Storms for your allies. After 10 seconds, or when the Ability is activated again, the Medivac will travel to the original cast location to unload its passengers.

13.name: EMP Grenade
13.description: Displacement Grenade deals an additional 96 (+4% per level) damage over 2 seconds, and up to 400 (+4% per level) bonus damage to Heroes' Shields.

13.name: System Shock
13.description: Heroes hit by Displacement Grenade deal 30% less damage for 3 seconds.

13.name: Bedside Manner
13.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Hitting an enemy Hero with Displacement Grenade increases the next instance of this damage against them to 6% for 6 seconds.

16.name: Extended Care
16.description:
Channeling Healing Beam on a Hero for at least 3 seconds causes them to be healed for 258 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds when Healing Beam ends. 

Passive: Increase the range of Healing Beam by 30%.

16.name: First Responder
16.description: While above 60 Energy, Healing Beam's healing is increased by 20% and both Lt. Morales and her Healing Beam target gain 15% Movement Speed.

16.name: Shield Sequencer
16.description: Safeguard gains a second charge and its range is increased by 60%.

20.name: Hyperactivity
20.description: Reduce the cooldown of Stim Drone from 70 seconds to 35 seconds, and increase the Movement Speed bonus from 25% to 50%.

20.name: Safe Zone
20.description:
After exiting the Medivac, allies are Protected from all damage for 3 seconds.

Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Medivac Dropship abilities by 15 seconds.

20.name: Hospice Care
20.description: Safeguard grants its target Unkillable for 1 second. If the target is under 50% maximum Health when the Unkillable effect ends, they are healed for 8% of their maximum Health.

20.name: Second Opinion
20.description: Hitting 2 or more Heroes with Displacement Grenade reduces its cooldown to 2 seconds.

medivh.name: Medivh
medivh.description: A Support who can negate burst damage and allow his allies to teleport.

abilities.name: Arcane Rift
abilities.description:
Launch a rift that deals 170 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in its path. If an enemy Hero is hit, reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds and refund 50 Mana.

Quest: Hit 40 enemy Heroes with Arcane Rift without dying.

Reward: Permanently increase the damage dealt by 75 and cooldown reduction for hitting a Hero by 1 second.

abilities.name: Force of Will
abilities.description: Protect an allied Hero from all damage for 1.5 seconds. Upon expiration, Force of Will heals the target for 20% of the damage it absorbed.

abilities.name: Portal
abilities.description: Create a set of portals between Medivh and the target location, allowing allies to teleport between both. The portals last 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Poly Bomb
abilities.description: Polymorph an enemy Hero for 2 seconds, Silencing them and making them unable to attack. On expiration, Poly Bomb spreads to other nearby enemy Heroes.

abilities.name: Ley Line Seal
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, unleash a wave of energy that places enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Raven Form
abilities.description: Instead of mounting, Medivh can transform into a raven, increasing Movement Speed by 20%. While transformed, Medivh can see and fly over all terrain and is immune to all effects.

abilities.name: Raven Form
abilities.description: Transform into a raven, increasing Movement Speed by 20%. While transformed, Medivh can see and fly over terrain and is immune to all effects.

1.name: Winds of Celerity
1.description: Increases Raven Form's Movement Speed bonus by 100%.

1.name: Raven’s Intellect
1.description: Raven Form increases Medivh's Mana and Health Regeneration by 200%.

1.name: Portal Mastery
1.description:
Medivh can manually place both Portal locations and it no longer breaks Raven Form. 

Activate Medivh's Trait to cancel an unlinked Portal.

4.name: Mage Armor
4.description: The first time an ally uses a Portal, they gain 40 Armor for 5 seconds, reducing their damage taken by 40%.

4.name: Raven Familiar
4.description: A Raven Familiar joins allies each time they use a Portal. The Raven will dive at the ally's next Basic Attack against a Hero within 5 seconds, dealing 114 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing them by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

4.name: Dust of Appearance
4.description:
Activate to greatly increase sight range for 5 seconds and reveal enemy Heroes in the area for 8 seconds. Does not cancel Raven Form.

Passive: Increase Medivh's sight range while in Raven Form by 25%.

7.name: Mystic Assault
7.description: If Arcane Rift hits an enemy Hero, Medivh's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 50% more damage and heals for 50% of the damage dealt.

7.name: Arcane Explosion
7.description: When Force of Will expires, it deals 80 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, plus 50% of the damage it prevented, up to 315 (+4% per level) additional damage.

7.name: Force of Magic
7.description: Preventing at least 268 (+4% per level) damage with a single cast of Force of Will grants 35% Spell Power for 15 seconds. Stacks up to 2 times.

10.name: Poly Bomb
10.description: Polymorph an enemy Hero for 2 seconds, Silencing them and making them unable to attack. On expiration, Poly Bomb spreads to other nearby enemy Heroes.

10.name: Ley Line Seal
10.description: After 0.5 seconds, unleash a wave of energy that places enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 3 seconds.

13.name: Circle of Protection
13.description: Force of Will also applies to allies near the target.

13.name: Enduring Will
13.description: Preventing at least 268 (+4% per level) damage with Force of Will reduces its cooldown to 4 seconds.

13.name: Reabsorption
13.description: Increase the amount of healing from Force of Will to 70% of the damage it absorbed.

16.name: Arcane Charge
16.description: When Arcane Rift damages an enemy Hero, the next Arcane Rift deals 15% more damage.

16.name: Temporal Flux
16.description: Basic Attacks reduce Medivh's Heroic Ability cooldown by 3%. Each enemy Hero hit by Arcane Rift reduces Medivh's Heroic Ability cooldown by 9%.

16.name: Stable Portal
16.description: Decrease Portal cooldown by 25% and increase Portal duration by 50%.

20.name: Glyph Of Poly Bomb
20.description:
Poly Bomb now hits an area, instantly Polymorphing enemy Heroes, hitting the same area again 1 second later.

Poly Bomb's duration is reduced to 1 second, and the spread radius is increased by 25%.

20.name: Medivh Cheats!
20.description: Increase the duration of the Time Stop by 33% and gain the ability to redirect the wave once while it's active.

20.name: Guardian of Tirisfal
20.description: Minions and Catapults hit by Arcane Rift are instantly killed.  Range is increased by 50%.

20.name: Arcane Brilliance
20.description: Activate to instantly restore 200 mana to all nearby allied Heroes and grant them 15% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

20.name: Dust of Disappearance
20.description:
Stealth an allied Hero for 40 seconds, they are Unrevealable for the first 0.5 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

Stores up to 2 charges.

mei.name: Mei
mei.description: A mobile Tank who controls and disrupts the battlefield with weather-altering technology

abilities.name: Snow Blind
abilities.description: Throw a snowball that hits all enemies in an area. Enemies hit take 70 (+4% per level) damage, are Slowed by 35%, and are Blinded for 1.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.description: Command Snowball to create a Blizzard at the target location for 2 seconds. Enemies within the blizzard take 13 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds and are Slowed by 7%, stacking up to 35%. When the Blizzard ends, enemies within its area take an additional 75 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 1.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Icing
abilities.description:
Slide quickly in the targeted direction. When this effect ends, enemies near Mei are knocked back, take 52 (+4% per level) damage, and are Slowed by 80%, rapidly decaying over 1.5 seconds.

Can be canceled during sliding.

abilities.name: Avalanche
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, roll a massive snowball that consumes enemy Heroes in its path. At the end of its path, the snowball crumbles, releasing the consumed Heroes, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds per Hero consumed.

abilities.name: Ice Wall
abilities.description:
Vector Targeting
After a 0.75 second delay, create an impassable wall that traps enemy Heroes hit for 2.5 seconds. When the wall expires, trapped Heroes are Slowed by 75%, decaying over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Cryo-Freeze
abilities.description: Become encased in ice for 3 seconds, gaining a rapidly decaying Shield that absorbs up to 1104 (+4% per level) damage. While active, this Shield grants Unstoppable and restores up to 35% of Mei's maximum Health.

1.name: Heavy Pack
1.description: Increases the duration of Snow Blind's Slow by 1.5 seconds. Each time Blizzard damages an enemy Hero, reduce the cooldown of Snow Blind by 0.5 seconds and gain 3 Mana.

1.name: Ice Storm
1.description: Every 3rd hit of Blizzard against enemy Heroes deals an additional 42 (+4% per level) damage. Blizzard's final Stun damage is increased by 150% against all enemies.

1.name: Heat Transfer
1.description: Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed Heroes deal 33% more damage. Each time Mei Stuns or Slows an enemy Hero she heals for 16 (+4% per level) Health.

4.name: Slushball
4.description: Snow Blind deals 75% increased damage and Structures hit are disabled for 3 seconds.

4.name: Cold Front
4.description: Reduce the cooldown of Icing by 3 seconds. If Mei enters her own Blizzard while Icing is active, the cooldown of Icing is reduced by 5 seconds and she gains 80 Mana.

4.name: Crystallize
4.description: Reduce the cooldown of Cryo-Freeze by 10 seconds. Mei gains 40 Spell Armor while Cryo-Freeze is active and for 1 second after.

7.name: Induce Hibernation
7.description:
Blizzard reduces the damage dealt by enemy Heroes inside of its area by 40%. 

When Blizzard ends, enemy Heroes still within its area gain this effect for an additional 4 seconds.

7.name: Skating Away
7.description: When Icing ends, Mei and all nearby allied Heroes gain 20% Movement Speed and 50 Physical Armor for 3 seconds.

7.name: Backup Battery
7.description: Activate to remove all Roots and Slows and regenerate 20% of maximum Health over 2 seconds. The cooldown of this ability is reduced by 10 seconds each time Mei picks up a Regeneration Globe.

10.name: Avalanche
10.description: After 0.5 seconds, roll a massive snowball that consumes enemy Heroes in its path. At the end of its path, the snowball crumbles, releasing the consumed Heroes, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds per Hero consumed.

10.name: Ice Wall
10.description:
Vector Targeting
After a 0.75 second delay, create an impassable wall that traps enemy Heroes hit for 2.5 seconds. When the wall expires, trapped Heroes are Slowed by 75%, decaying over 3 seconds.

13.name: Flurry
13.description: While in her own Blizzard, Mei gains 50% increased Attack Speed and Blizzard's cooldown refreshes 125% faster. If Mei is in her own Blizzard when it ends, gain these bonuses for 3 additional seconds.

13.name: Cooling Servos
13.description:
While Cryo-Freeze is active, Mei's Basic Ability cooldowns recover 200% faster.

Passive: Basic Attacks Slow by 20% for 1.5 seconds.

13.name: Polar Vortex
13.description: Using an ability causes Mei to deal 24 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies for 4 seconds. Enemy Heroes damaged by this effect also have their Movement Speed and Attack Speed Slowed by 20%.

16.name: Fresh Powder
16.description: Snow Blind gains an additional charge and its range is increased by 33%.

16.name: Black Ice
16.description: Icing's Slow effect no longer decays over its duration. Icing deals 300% more damage to enemies very close to Mei.

16.name: Acclimation
16.description: Each time Mei Stuns or Slows an enemy Hero, the damage she deals and healing she receives is increased by 1%, stacking up to 20 times. While at maximum stacks, Mei also gains 10 Armor. Lasts 8 seconds.

20.name: Cascade
20.description:
While traveling, Avalanche constantly launches a volley of untalented Snow Blind snowballs ahead of itself.

Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Avalanche by 30 seconds.

20.name: Shatter
20.description: When Ice Wall expires, trapped enemy Heroes hit take 210 (+4% per level) damage and have their Armor reduced by 25 for 5 seconds.

20.name: The Big One
20.description: Every 15 seconds, the next Snow Blind you cast has 67% increased area and 200% increased damage.

20.name: Flash Freeze
20.description: When Mei takes fatal damage she instantly gains Cryo-Freeze. This effect has a 180 second cooldown.

mephisto.name: Mephisto
mephisto.description: A sustained Assassin who thrives in battle against groups of enemies.

abilities.name: Skull Missile
abilities.description: Conjure a skull that travels in the target direction after 0.625 seconds, dealing 127 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and Slowing Heroes hit by 25% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Lightning Nova
abilities.description:
A ring of lightning appears around Mephisto for 2.5 seconds. Enemies within the ring take 43 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds.

Each time a cast of Lightning Nova hits a Hero, its damage is increased by 3%, up to 30%.

abilities.name: Shade of Mephisto
abilities.description:
Teleport to a location, dealing 78 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and leaving behind a Shade of Mephisto at Mephisto's original location. 

After 2.5 seconds, Mephisto is teleported back to the Shade's location.

abilities.name: Consume Souls
abilities.description: Channel for 2.5 seconds, revealing all enemy Heroes. After the Channel completes, all enemy Heroes take 357 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Durance of Hate
abilities.description:
After 1 second, unleash a wave of evil spirits that Root the first enemy Hero hit for 2.5 seconds and deal 250 (+4% per level) damage to them over the same duration.

Durance of Hate spreads outwards from its initial target, Rooting and damaging additional nearby enemy Heroes.

abilities.name: Lord Of Hatred
abilities.description:
Hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Abilities reduces Mephisto's Basic Ability cooldowns.

Skull Missile and Shade of Mephisto grant 1.5 seconds of cooldown reduction per Hero hit, and Lightning Nova grants 0.3 seconds per Hero hit.

1.name: Unyielding Power
1.description:
Quest: Hit Heroes with Skull Missile.

Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, increase Skull Missile's damage by 100.

Reward: After hitting 40 Heroes, Skull Missile gains an additional charge.

1.name: Furious Spark
1.description: Every 3rd hit from Lightning Nova against the same target deals 65 (+4% per level) bonus damage and grants Mephisto 2 Mana.

1.name: Malicious Intent
1.description:
Shade of Mephisto grants 25% Spell Power while active and for 2.5 seconds after ending.

If Mephisto hits enemy Heroes at least 18 times with his Basic Abilities while Shade of Mephisto is active, then increase the duration of the Spell Power bonus to 10 seconds after it ends.

4.name: Hateful Mending
4.description: Skull Missile grants 10 Mana and heals Mephisto for 70% of the damage it deals to Heroes.

4.name: Static Barrier
4.description: At the end of its duration, Lightning Nova grants Mephisto a Shield equal to 40% of the damage it dealt to Heroes. Lasts 5 seconds.

4.name: Spite
4.description: Increase Regeneration Globe healing duration by 100%. Every tick of Regeneration Globe healing activates Lord of Hatred, reducing Basic Ability cooldowns by 1 second.

7.name: Ghastly Armor
7.description: Shade of Mephisto grants 25 Armor while active and for 2.5 seconds after it ends.

7.name: Frost Storm
7.description: While Shade of Mephisto is active, enemies who are hit by Lightning Nova are Slowed by 15% for 1 second and the Slow from Skull Missile is increased to 50%.

7.name: Trickery
7.description:
Shade of Mephisto grants 20% Movement Speed while active and for 2.5 seconds after it ends.

If Mephisto hits enemy Heroes at least 18 times with his Basic Abilities while Shade of Mephisto is active, then reset the cooldown of Shade of Mephisto.

10.name: Consume Souls
10.description: Channel for 2.5 seconds, revealing all enemy Heroes. After the Channel completes, all enemy Heroes take 357 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

10.name: Durance of Hate
10.description:
After 1 second, unleash a wave of evil spirits that Root the first enemy Hero hit for 2.5 seconds and deal 250 (+4% per level) damage to them over the same duration.

Durance of Hate spreads outwards from its initial target, Rooting and damaging additional nearby enemy Heroes.

13.name: Abhorred Skull
13.description: Hitting a Hero with Skull Missile grants 25% Spell Power for 6 seconds. Skull Missile deals 40% more damage to Heroes under 50% Health.

13.name: Hysteria
13.description: Lord of Hatred also reduces the cooldown of Mephisto's Heroic Ability. Mephisto is healed for 15% of his maximum Health and Mana when he casts his Heroic Ability.

13.name: Shard of Hate
13.description: Basic Attacks hit enemies near the primary target and activate Lord of Hatred against enemy Heroes, reducing Basic Ability cooldowns by 1 second per Hero hit.

16.name: Lightning Reaction
16.description: Skull Missile explodes on contact with Lightning Nova, dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

16.name: Static Field
16.description: When Lightning Nova's damage bonus reaches 30%, enemy Heroes within its radius take damage equal to 10% of their maximum Health.

16.name: Animosity
16.description: Increase the duration of Lightning Nova by 1 second and the maximum amount of bonus damage it can deal from 30% to 42%.

20.name: Consumed by Hatred
20.description: Consume Souls deals bonus damage equal to 10% of the target's missing Health. If Consume Souls initial cast kills a Hero it will cast 1 additional time.

20.name: Unspeakable Horror
20.description: Durance of Hate Silences enemies while they are Rooted and for 3 seconds after its Root expires.

20.name: Mimic
20.description: While both Shade of Mephisto and Lightning Nova are active, Lightning Nova also casts from the Shade's location.

20.name: Shade Lord
20.description:
Activate to swap locations with Shade of Mephisto and refresh its duration.

Passive: Shade of Mephisto benefits from all of Mephisto's level 7 Talents.

kharazim.name: Kharazim
kharazim.description: A flexible Healer that pairs well with Melee allies who like to dive into the enemy team.

abilities.name: Radiant Dash
abilities.description:
Jump to an allied or enemy unit. Enemies are immediately hit with a Basic Attack.

Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Breath of Heaven
abilities.description: Heal nearby Heroes for 295 (+4% per level) and give them 15% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Deadly Reach
abilities.description: Kharazim's next Basic Attack increases his Attack Speed and Attack Range by 100% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Seven-Sided Strike
abilities.description: Become Invulnerable and strike 7 times over 2 seconds. Each strike hits the highest Health nearby Hero for 7% of their maximum Health.

abilities.name: Divine Palm
abilities.description: Protect an allied Hero from death, causing them to be healed for 1200 (+4% per level) if they take fatal damage in the next 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Pick Your Trait
abilities.description: Choose between Transcendence, Iron Fists, and Insight from the Talents panel.

1.name: Transcendence
1.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack heals the lowest nearby allied Hero for 104 (+4% per level) and gives 25% increased Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

1.name: Iron Fists
1.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack deals 110% bonus damage and gives 25% increased Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

1.name: Insight
1.description:
Quest: Every 3rd Basic Attack restores 14 (+4% per level) Mana, grants a stack of Insight, and gives 25% increased Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds.

Reward: Upon getting 100 stacks of Insight, every 3rd attack also reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 1.75 seconds.

4.name: Spirit Ally
4.description: Place a Spirit Ally that heals allied Heroes in a large area around it for 2% of their maximum Health every second. Has 150 (+4% per level) Health and lasts 10 seconds. Kharazim can Radiant Dash to Spirit Allies.

4.name: Earth Ally
4.description: Place an Earth Ally that grants nearby allied Heroes 50 Physical Armor against Heroic Basic Attacks, reducing damage taken by 50%. Has 400 (+4% per level) Health and lasts 10 seconds. Kharazim can Radiant Dash to Earth Allies.

4.name: Air Ally
4.description: Place an Air Ally that gives allied Heroes 20% Spell Power, grants vision, and reveals a large area around it. Has 300 (+4% per level) Health and lasts 10 seconds. Kharazim can Radiant Dash to Air Allies.

7.name: Blinding Speed
7.description: Decreases Radiant Dash's cooldown by 2 seconds and increases the maximum number of charges by 1.

7.name: Heavenly Zeal
7.description: Increases Breath of Heaven's Movement Speed bonus to 30%. Radiant Dashing to an ally increases the healing they receive from Breath of Heaven by 50% for 3.5 seconds.

7.name: Blazing Fists
7.description: Increase the duration of Deadly Reach by 100%. Every 3rd Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Deadly Reach by 0.75 seconds.

10.name: Divine Palm
10.description: Protect an allied Hero from death, causing them to be healed for 1200 (+4% per level) if they take fatal damage in the next 4 seconds.

10.name: Seven-Sided Strike
10.description: Become Invulnerable and strike 7 times over 2 seconds. Each strike hits the highest Health nearby Hero for 7% of their maximum Health.

13.name: Quicksilver
13.description: Radiant Dashing to an ally gives Kharazim and the target 30% bonus Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

13.name: Spell Shield
13.description:
Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

13.name: Sixth Sense
13.description: While Stunned or Rooted, gain 75 Physical Armor against Hero Basic Attacks for 4 seconds, reducing their damage by 75%.

16.name: Cleansing Touch
16.description: Radiant Dashing to an ally makes them Unstoppable for 1 second.

16.name: Way of the Hundred Fists
16.description: Radiant Dashing to an enemy launches a rapid volley of 6 Basic Attacks dealing 45% damage each.

16.name: Echo of Heaven
16.description: Breath of Heaven heals 75% of its normal amount, but heals a second time 3 seconds later.

20.name: Peaceful Repose
20.description: Divine Palm's healing amount is increased by 75% and its cooldown is set to 5 seconds if the Hero does not die.

20.name: Transgression
20.description: Seven-Sided Strike hits 4 additional times.

20.name: Fists of Legend
20.description: Gain 50% of the benefit from both level 1 talents that were not chosen.

20.name: Storm Shield
20.description: Activate to give all nearby allied Heroes a Shield for 20% of their max Health for 3 seconds.

20.name: Epiphany
20.description: Activate to restore 70% of Kharazim's maximum Mana and refill 2 charges of Radiant Dash.

muradin.name: Muradin
muradin.description: A sturdy Tank that can do well in a multitude of situations.

abilities.name: Storm Bolt
abilities.description:
Throw a hammer, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds

Quest: Basic Attack Heroes affected by Stuns, Slows, or Roots. Slowed or Rooted enemies grant 1 stack. Stunned enemies provide 2 stacks.  If the Hero dies within 3 seconds, gain 5 stacks.

Reward: Upon hitting 45 targets, Storm Bolt pierces to hit an additional target, and Muradin's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Storm Bolt by 0.5 seconds and restore 3 Mana.

<Mythic Reward: Upon hitting 160 targets, Storm Bolt's range is increased by 50%, width increased by 100%, and now pierces all targets.

abilities.name: Thunder Clap
abilities.description: Blast nearby enemies for 96 (+4% per level) damage and Slow them by 30% for 2.5 seconds. Heroes hit also have their Attack Speed reduced by 30% for the duration.

abilities.name: Dwarf Toss
abilities.description: Leap to target location, dealing 59 (+4% per level) damage to enemies on landing. Upon leaping, gain 30 Armor for 2 seconds, reducing damage taken by 30%.

abilities.name: Avatar
abilities.description: Transform for 20 seconds, gaining 1000 (+4% per level) Health.

abilities.name: Haymaker
abilities.description: Stun target enemy Hero, and wind up a punch dealing 319 (+4% per level) damage and knocking the target back, hitting enemies in the way for 319 (+4% per level) damage and knocking them aside.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: Muradin restores 55 (+4% per level) Health per second when he has not taken damage for 4 seconds. When below 40% Health, increased to 111 (+4% per level) Health per second.

1.name: Dwarf Block
1.description: Casting Dwarf Toss grants 3 charges of Block. Each Block charge grants 75 Physical Armor against a single enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

1.name: Third Wind
1.description: Increases Health Restoration rate to 90 (+4% per level) per second, and raises Health threshold to 60% Health for improved 180 (+4% per level) per second Restoration.

1.name: Give 'em the Axe!
1.description: Attacking a Hero that is Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed increases Muradin's Basic Attack damage by 40% for 3 seconds.

4.name: Sledgehammer
4.description: Storm Bolt deals 500% damage to non-Heroic enemies.  Stormbolt cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds.

4.name: Reverberation
4.description: Increases the Attack Speed Slow of Thunder Clap from 30% to 50% and the duration from 2.5 seconds to 3.5 seconds. Each enemy Hero hit reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 5%.

4.name: Thunder Burn
4.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Thunder Clap triggers a second Thunder Clap explosion 2 seconds later in the same location that deals 72 (+4% per level) damage.

7.name: Perfect Storm
7.description: Storm Bolt's cooldown is reset and 25 Mana is refunded if an enemy dies within 3 seconds of being hit by it. This effect has an 8.5 second cooldown.

7.name: Heavy Impact
7.description: Enemies hit by Dwarf Toss are Slowed by 80% for 1.5 seconds.

7.name: Skullcracker
7.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same enemy deals 90% bonus damage and Stuns them for 0.25 seconds.

10.name: Avatar
10.description: Transform for 20 seconds, gaining 1000 (+4% per level) Health.

10.name: Haymaker
10.description: Stun target enemy Hero, and wind up a punch dealing 319 (+4% per level) damage and knocking the target back, hitting enemies in the way for 319 (+4% per level) damage and knocking them aside.

13.name: Bronzebeard Rage
13.description: Deal 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies and heal for 75% of the damage dealt. Hitting an enemy Hero with Storm Bolt increase this damage by 200% for 3 seconds.

13.name: Healing Static
13.description: Muradin heals for 6% of his maximum Health for each Hero hit by Thunder Clap.

13.name: Thunder Strike
13.description:
Thunder Clap deals 200% more damage if only one target is hit.

Passive: Increase the duration of Dwarf Toss's Armor by 2 seconds.

16.name: Dwarf Launch
16.description: Increase the range of Dwarf Toss by 30%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Dwarf Toss reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

16.name: Stoneform
16.description: Activate to heal Muradin for 30% of his maximum Health over 10 seconds. Second Wind is disabled during this time.

16.name: Imposing Presence
16.description:
Activate to reduce the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of nearby Heroes and Summons for 2.5 seconds.

Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack your Hero have their Attack Speed Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

20.name: Unstoppable Force
20.description: While active, Avatar grants 20 Armor and causes Muradin's Basic Attacks to reduce the cooldowns of Thunder Clap and Dwarf Toss by 0.75 seconds.

20.name: Grand Slam
20.description: Haymaker gains a 2nd charge and its damage is increased by 25%. If a Hero dies within 3 seconds of being hit by Haymaker, instantly gain 1 charge.

20.name: Mountain King
20.description: Thunder Clap and Dwarf Toss each gain a 2nd charge.

20.name: Hardened Shield
20.description: Activate to gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds, taking 75% less damage.

murky.name: Murky
murky.description: Not quite a full Hero, Murky can place an Egg to respawn quickly back into battle.

abilities.name: Slime
abilities.description:
Deal 86 (+4% per level) damage and apply Slime on nearby enemies for 6 seconds, Slowing them by 20%. 

Deal 210 (+4% per level) damage to enemies who are already Slimed. Structures take 50% damage.

abilities.name: Pufferfish
abilities.description:
Spit out a Pufferfish with 225 (+5.5% per level) health at the target point. After 2.75 seconds, the fish will blow up for 330 (+4% per level) damage. Deals 50% less damage to Structures.

Quest: Kill Slimed Enemies or hit them with Pufferfish. Heroes and Structures award 4 bonus stacks.

Reward: After obtaining 200 stacks, Murky's Basic Abilities no longer deal reduced damage to structures.

Mythic Reward: After obtaining 400 stacks, Murky's health is increased by 50%.

abilities.name: Safety Bubble
abilities.description: Becomes Invulnerable for 2 seconds. While active, Murky cannot attack or use abilities.

abilities.name: March of the Murlocs
abilities.description: After 0.75 seconds, Murky commands a legion of Murlocs to march in a target direction, each one leaping onto the first enemy Hero or Structure they find. Each Murloc deals 130 (+4% per level) damage and slows its target by 15% for 5 seconds. Murlocs deal 50% damage to Structures.

abilities.name: Octo-Grab
abilities.description: Murky becomes Unstoppable and Stuns target enemy Hero for 3 seconds while he hits them for 1 damage a second.

abilities.name: Spawn Egg
abilities.description:
Place an Egg at target location, revealing the nearby area. Upon dying, Murky respawns at the Egg after 8 seconds. Murky only grants 25% of a real Hero's experience upon dying.

If Murky's Egg is killed, he is revealed to enemies for 15 seconds, and Spawn Egg is placed on cooldown.

1.name: Fish Eye
1.description:
Spawning from his Egg increases Murky's mount speed to 45% for 5 seconds.

Passive: Increase the Egg's Health by 100%, its sight radius by 300%, and it reveals all enemies in its sight radius.

1.name: Shell Game
1.description: Murky can now place 2 Eggs and will randomly revive from them, however, the cooldown of placing an Egg is increased by 15 seconds.

1.name: A Fishy Deal
1.description:
Killing a Minion with Pufferfish grants a stack of Bribe. Use 8 stacks to bribe a Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries.

Maximum of 32 stacks of Bribe.

4.name: Slime Time
4.description:
Quest: Slime enemy Heroes that are already Slimed.

Reward: After Sliming 10 Heroes, increase Slime's bonus damage by 125.

Reward: After Sliming 20 Heroes, increase Slime's slow amount to 30%.

4.name: Tufferfish
4.description: Pufferfish gains 50 Spell Armor and deals 50% more damage to Slimed targets.

4.name: Living the Dream
4.description: Quest: Every 15 seconds Murky is alive, he gains 5% Spell Power, up to 25%. This bonus is reset upon his death.

7.name: Black Lagoon
7.description: Increase Slime's radius by 30%.

7.name: Slippery When Wet
7.description: Gain 50% Movement Speed and move through units while in Safety Bubble. Additionally, Safety Bubble's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

7.name: Time to Krill
7.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal an additional 7 (+4% per level) damage a second and slow the target by 7% for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 5 times.

10.name: March of the Murlocs
10.description: After 0.75 seconds, Murky commands a legion of Murlocs to march in a target direction, each one leaping onto the first enemy Hero or Structure they find. Each Murloc deals 130 (+4% per level) damage and slows its target by 15% for 5 seconds. Murlocs deal 50% damage to Structures.

10.name: Octo-Grab
10.description: Murky becomes Unstoppable and Stuns target enemy Hero for 3 seconds while he hits them for 1 damage a second.

13.name: Rejuvenating Bubble
13.description: Safety Bubble restores 40% of Murky's maximum Health.

13.name: Egg Shell
13.description: Upon casting Spawn Egg, or when one of his eggs is killed, Murky gains a Shield for an amount equal to 50% of Murky's current Health.

13.name: Fish Tank
13.description: Murky is healed for 20% of the damage he deals with Basic Attacks and Basic Abilities.

16.name: Toxic Buildup
16.description: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack against an enemy Hero causes a free Slime to be cast upon them.

16.name: Fish Oil
16.description: The Pufferfish casts Slime at its location upon landing.

16.name: Wrath of Cod
16.description: Heroes hit by Pufferfish take additional damage equal to 16% of their maximum Health over 4 seconds.

20.name: Never-Ending Murlocs
20.description:
March of the Murlocs can be channeled indefinitely, and will always last its base duration when canceled early. 

In addition, it no longer deals reduced damage to Structures.

20.name: ... And a Shark Too!
20.description: Increase the damage of Octo-Grab by 13700% (+4% per level).

20.name: Making Inky
20.description: Reduces the cooldown of Slime by 1.5 seconds.

20.name: Faster Fish
20.description: Pufferfish explodes 1.5 seconds faster.

xul.name: Xul
xul.description: A Summoner who can push multiple lanes with ease.

abilities.name: Spectral Scythe
abilities.description: Summon a scythe that travels to Xul after 1 second, dealing 190 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and spawning a Skeletal Warrior when hitting enemy Heroes.  These do not count towards Xul's Raise Skeleton maximum.

abilities.name: Cursed Strikes
abilities.description: Xul's Basic Attacks deal damage in a wide area and reduce the Attack Speed of Heroes and Summons by 40% for 2 seconds. Lasts 4 seconds once triggered.

abilities.name: Bone Prison
abilities.description: After a 2 second delay, deal 80 (+4% per level) damage and Root the target enemy Hero for 1.75 seconds.  All nearby Skeletal Warriors will fixate on the target for their duration.

abilities.name: Skeletal Mages
abilities.description:
Vector Targeting
Summon 4 Frost Mages in a line that attack nearby enemies for 47 (+4% per level) damage a second and Slow them by 30% for 2 seconds. Last up to 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Poison Nova
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, release poisonous missiles that deal 630 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies hit over 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Raise Skeleton
abilities.description: When a nearby enemy Minion dies, it becomes a Skeletal Warrior with 240 (+4% per level) Health that attacks for 21 (+4% per level) damage and lasts up to 12 seconds. Upon death, Skeletal Warriors deal 40 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.  Up to 3 Skeletal Warriors can be active at once when spawned in this way.

abilities.name: Bone Armor
abilities.description: Activate to gain a Shield equal to 25% of Xul's maximum Health for 3 seconds.

1.name: Backlash
1.description: When Bone Armor expires, nearby enemy Heroes take damage equal to 12% of their maximum Health.

1.name: Shackler
1.description: While Bone Armor is active, nearby enemies are Slowed by 35% for 1 second. Basic Attacks against Heroes that are Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed reduce the cooldown of Bone Armor by 2 seconds.

1.name: Shade
1.description: While Bone Armor is active, Xul evades all Basic Attacks, but increases the cooldown of Bone Armor by 10 seconds.

4.name: Reaper's Toll
4.description: Reduce the cooldown of Spectral Scythe by 2 seconds and its Mana cost by 15.

4.name: Grim Scythe
4.description: Increase Xul's Basic Attack damage by 15%.  Each enemy hit by Cursed Strikes reduces its cooldown by 1 second, up to 12 seconds.

4.name: Jailors
4.description:
Bone Prison spawns 2 Skeletal Warriors.  These do not count towards Xul's Raise Skeleton maximum.

Quest: Spawn 80 Skeletal Warriors.

Reward: While fixating on an enemy, Skeletal Warriors gain 25% Movement and Attack Speed.

7.name: Harvest Vitality
7.description: Cursed Strikes heals for 70% of the damage dealt to Heroes.

7.name: Trag'Oul's Essence
7.description: Every time a Skeletal Warrior attacks an enemy, restore 0.5% of Xul's maximum Health and 0.2% of his maximum Mana.

7.name: Wall Of Bones
7.description: Increase the Shield amount of Bone Armor to 35% of Xul's maximum Health, and Xul gains 20 Spell Armor for its duration.

10.name: Poison Nova
10.description: After 0.5 seconds, release poisonous missiles that deal 630 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies hit over 10 seconds.

10.name: Skeletal Mages
10.description:
Vector Targeting
Summon 4 Frost Mages in a line that attack nearby enemies for 47 (+4% per level) damage a second and Slow them by 30% for 2 seconds. Last up to 15 seconds.

13.name: Echoes of Death
13.description: Spectral Scythe spawns 2 additional scythes next to the first after 1.5 seconds, dealing 40% damage.

13.name: Rapid Harvest
13.description: Gain 5% Attack Speed for 3 seconds each time Cursed Strikes hits an enemy, up to 75%.

13.name: Amplify Damage
13.description: Increase the Root duration of Bone Prison by 0.25 seconds.  Enemies Rooted by Bone Prison lose 25 Armor for 2 seconds.

16.name: Decrepify
16.description: Enemy Heroes that are damaged by Spectral Scythe or Skeletal Warriors are Slowed by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

16.name: Weaken
16.description: Enemy Heroes who are damaged by Cursed Strikes or Skeletal Warriors deal 35% less damage for 3 seconds.

16.name: Bone Spear
16.description: Deal 230 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line.

20.name: Andariel's Visage
20.description: Poison Nova heals for 50% of the damage dealt and its duration is increased by 50%.

20.name: Cold Hand of Death
20.description:
Increase the Slow of Frost Mages by 20%.  

Every 5th Spectral Scythe that hits enemy Heroes spawns a Frost Mage instead of a Skeletal Warrior at their location.

20.name: Mortal Wound
20.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Spectral Scythe receive 75% less healing for 4 seconds.

20.name: Kalan's Edict
20.description: Each time Skeletal Warriors deal damage, reduce the cooldown of Bone Armor and Xul's Heroic Ability by 1.5%.

qhira.name: Qhira
qhira.description: A brutal Melee Assassin who is adept at both beginning and ending fights.

abilities.name: Carnage
abilities.description: Unleash your sword in the target direction, continuously dealing 30 (+4% per level) damage to enemies caught in its path.

abilities.name: Blood Rage
abilities.description:
