Qhira deals 32 (+4% per level) damage and heals for 90 (+4% per level) Health per enemy Hero affected. Damage and healing is increased by 50% per each additional stack on that Hero.

Passive: Basic Attack and Ability damage cause enemies to bleed for 28 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. Stacks 5 times.

Quest: Damage enemy Heroes with Blood Rage's bleed damage to permanently increase its damage by 0.2%. 

Reward: After damaging Heroes with Blood Rage's bleed damage 150 times, Blood Rage's duration is increased by 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Revolving Sweep
abilities.description:
Attach your sword on the first enemy Hero hit, dealing 96 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.25 seconds. Once attached, Qhira becomes Immune to all effects, swinging around the target for 2.75 seconds and dealing 105 (+4% per level) damage to enemies between you and the target.

Re-activate to send you to the target's location knocking them away, dealing 108 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Unrelenting Strikes
abilities.description: Deal 44 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 2.5 seconds as your sword grows outward. Upon expiring, deal 160 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemy Heroes and Stun them for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Final Strike
abilities.description: After 1 second, deal 410 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line. This damage is increased by 25% against enemy Heroes who are below 50% Health.

abilities.name: Grappling Hook
abilities.description:
Qhira fires a grappling hook that pulls her to terrain it contacts. If an enemy Hero is hit, they take 35 (+4% per level) damage and Qhira launches at them, kicking them for an additional 108 (+4% per level) damage.

Can be used while Revolving Sweep is active.

1.name: Maximum Effort
1.description: If Carnage damages the same enemy Hero 3 times it deals an additional 108 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

1.name: Fatal Wounds
1.description: While at maximum stacks, Blood Rage's bleed deals 70% additional damage to enemy Heroes under 50% Health.

1.name: Finishing Touch
1.description: Gain 20% Basic Attack damage. When Qhira Basic Attacks an enemy Hero below 50% Health it deals 20% additional damage, and she gains 35% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

4.name: Upstage
4.description: Damaging at least 2 Heroes with Blood Rage causes Qhira to Evade the next 4 Heroic Basic Attacks within 12 seconds.

4.name: Ensnaring Swing
4.description: The primary target of Revolving Sweep is Slowed by 60% while Qhira is attached to them. Secondary targets hit by Revolving Sweep's swing are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds.

4.name: Your Pain, My Gain
4.description: Basic Attacking an enemy Hero causes Qhira to gain 10 Armor for 3 seconds. Stacks 3 times.

7.name: The Thirst
7.description: Carnage heals for 50% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes. Anytime Carnage damages an enemy Hero, Qhira's next Basic Attack within 4 seconds against an enemy Hero deals 15% additional damage, stacking up to 10 times.

7.name: Healmonger
7.description: If Blood Rage damages an enemy Hero below 50% Health, it heals for an additional 210 (+4% per level) Health.

7.name: Siphoning Link
7.description:
Damaging an enemy Hero with Revolving Sweep's initial impact or swing causes Qhira to regenerate 96 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.

Passive: Basic Attacks heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

10.name: Unrelenting Strikes
10.description: Deal 44 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 2.5 seconds as your sword grows outward. Upon expiring, deal 160 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemy Heroes and Stun them for 1.5 seconds.

10.name: Final Strike
10.description: After 1 second, deal 410 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line. This damage is increased by 25% against enemy Heroes who are below 50% Health.

13.name: Chainsaw
13.description: Carnage's cooldown recharges 100% faster while an enemy Hero has maximum Blood Rage stacks.

13.name: Pulsing Pain
13.description: Each additional enemy Hero hit by Revolving Sweep causes the primary target to take an additional 150 (+4% per level) damage.

13.name: The Hunted
13.description: Basic Attacking an enemy Hero increases your Basic Attack damage against that Hero by 25%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 4 seconds. Bonus is reset if a different Hero is attacked.

16.name: Booming Kick
16.description: Increase the Stun duration of Revolving Sweep's re-activation by 0.25 seconds. Enemy Heroes around the primary target are also affected by Revolving Sweep's re-activation.

16.name: Lingering Ailment
16.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Revolving Sweep or by Grappling Hook have their Armor reduced by 25 for 4 seconds.

16.name: Swing Life Away
16.description: Revolving Sweep's cooldown recharges 250% faster while Qhira is swinging around her target. She also gains 60 Spell Armor for 5 seconds after the re-activation impact.

20.name: Silent Killer
20.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Unrelenting Strikes Silences them for 0.5 seconds and reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

20.name: Unleashed Potential
20.description:
Increase the damage to enemy Heroes under 50% Health from 25% to 50%.

If an enemy Hero dies within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Final Strike, then reset the cooldowns of Final Strike and all of Qhira's Basic Abilities.

20.name: Utility Belt
20.description: Grappling Hook's cooldown is reset when hitting an enemy Hero with the initial impact of Revolving Sweep and recharges 900% faster if Qhira hasn't taken damage within the last 2 seconds.

20.name: No Sanctuary
20.description:
Nearby enemy Heroes below 50% Health are revealed and you gain 20% Movement Speed while an enemy Hero is revealed by you in this way.

Additionally, you deal 20% increased damage to these revealed enemies.

nova.name: Nova
nova.description: A burst damage Mage who can ambush enemies from Stealth.

abilities.name: Snipe
abilities.description:
Deal 230 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit.

Passive: Hitting an enemy Hero with Snipe permanently increases the damage of Snipe by 6%, stacking up to 30%. Gain an additional 25% damage bonus at maximum stacks. All stacks are lost if Snipe fails to hit an enemy.

abilities.name: Pinning Shot
abilities.description: Deal 100 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy and Slow them by 40% for 2.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Holo Decoy
abilities.description:
Create a Decoy for 5 seconds with 100% of Nova's current Health that attacks enemies, dealing 10% of Nova's base damage. Whenever a Decoy takes damage, it deals that amount of damage to itself, effectively doubling the damage it takes.

Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

abilities.name: Triple Tap
abilities.description: Locks in on the target Hero, then fires 3 shots that hit the first Hero or Structure they come in contact with for 372 (+4% per level) damage each.

abilities.name: Precision Strike
abilities.description: After a 1.5 second delay, deals 435 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within an area. Unlimited range.

abilities.name: Permanent Cloak
abilities.description:
Gain Stealth when out of combat for 3 seconds. Taking damage, attacking, using Abilities, or Channeling ends Stealth. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

Passive: Gain 15% Movement Speed while Stealthed.

abilities.name: Ghost Protocol
abilities.description: Activate to instantly grant Stealth to Nova and spawn a Holo Decoy at her location. Nova is Unrevealable for the first 0.5 seconds when Stealthed by Ghost Protocol.

1.name: Longshot
1.description: Increases the cast range of Pinning Shot by 30%. Pinning Shot also increases the range of Nova's next Basic Attack by 2.3.

1.name: Covert Ops
1.description: After being Stealthed for 2 seconds, Pinning Shot's Slow is increased to 60% and costs no Mana. Bonus is lost after losing Stealth for 1 second.

1.name: Advanced Cloaking
1.description: After being Stealthed for 1 second, gain an additional 10% Movement Speed. While Stealthed, regenerate 6 Mana per second.

4.name: Rapid Projection
4.description: Reduces Holo Decoy's cooldown and Mana cost by 60%.

4.name: Holo Stability
4.description:
Increase the cast range of Holo Decoy by 100% and its duration by 120%.

Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Ghost Protocol by 15 seconds.

4.name: Covert Mission
4.description: Enemy Minions killed near Nova grant a stack of Bribe. Hero Takedowns grant 10 stacks of Bribe. Use 25 stacks to bribe a Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries. Maximum of 100 stacks. If a camp is defeated entirely with Bribe, the camp respawns 50% faster.

7.name: Perfect Shot
7.description: Hitting an enemy with Snipe reduces its cooldown by 2 seconds and refunds half its Mana cost, doubled against enemy Heroes.

7.name: One in the Chamber
7.description: After using an Ability, Nova's next Basic Attack within 3 seconds deals 65% additional damage.

7.name: Anti-Armor Shells
7.description: Nova's Basic Attacks deal 250% damage and decrease the Physical Armor of Heroic targets by 15 for 4 seconds, but her Attack Speed is proportionally slower.

10.name: Triple Tap
10.description: Locks in on the target Hero, then fires 3 shots that hit the first Hero or Structure they come in contact with for 372 (+4% per level) damage each.

10.name: Precision Strike
10.description: After a 1.5 second delay, deals 435 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within an area. Unlimited range.

13.name: Psionic Efficiency
13.description: Snipe's range is increased by 15% and hitting a Hero grants an additional stack of Precision Sniper.

13.name: Double Tap
13.description: Pinning Shot now has 2 charges, but its cooldown is increased by 2 seconds.

13.name: Ionic Force Field
13.description: Gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds after losing Stealth.

16.name: Explosive Round
16.description: Snipe also deals 90% damage to enemies near the impact.

16.name: Crippling Shot
16.description: Pinning Shot lowers a Hero's Armor by 20 for the duration of the Slow, causing them to take 20% increased damage.

16.name: Lethal Decoy
16.description: Increases the damage Holo Decoy deals to 30% of Nova's damage.

20.name: Fast Reload
20.description: Triple Tap's cooldown is reset if it kills an enemy Hero.

20.name: Precision Barrage
20.description: Precision Strike gains a 2nd charge and its cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds.

20.name: Apollo Suit
20.description: Reduce the cooldown of Permanent Cloak by 2 seconds.

20.name: Rewind
20.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.

orphea.name: Orphea
orphea.description: A ranged Assassin who dances around her enemies while using spells to empower her attacks.

abilities.name: Shadow Waltz
abilities.description:
After 0.5 seconds, deal 165 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line. 

Hitting a Hero with Shadow Waltz sets its cooldown to 2 seconds, refunds 35 Mana, and causes Orphea to dash a short distance upon moving.

abilities.name: Chomp
abilities.description: After 0.625 seconds, deal 305 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies in front of Orphea.

abilities.name: Dread
abilities.description: Release a wave of dread that deals 85 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit. Dread erupts 0.75 seconds after reaching the end of its path, dealing 175 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies hit by Dread's wave or eruption are Slowed by 25% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Crushing Jaws
abilities.description: After 1.25 seconds, pull enemies in an area towards the center, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Eternal Feast
abilities.description: After 1.5 seconds, deal 210 (+4% per level) damage in an area. Eternal Feast repeats every 1 second as long as it hits an enemy Hero.

abilities.name: Overflowing Chaos
abilities.description:
Hitting an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability grants 1 Chaos. Chaos can stack up to 3 times.

While Orphea has Chaos, her Basic Attacks against Heroes consume all Chaos, dealing 50% increased damage per stack, and healing for 100% of the damage dealt.

1.name: En Pointe
1.description: Shadow Waltz deals an increased 90% damage to enemies hit by its end and grants 1 additional Chaos.

1.name: Growing Nightmare
1.description:
Increase Dread's damage by 50%. 

Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single cast of Dread's eruption.

Reward: Permanently increase Dread's eruption damage by 50% and increase the Slow amount of Dread's eruption by 15%.

1.name: Ancestral Strength
1.description: Non-Heroic Abilities deal 15% more damage to Stunned, Rooted, Silenced or Slowed enemies. Enemy Heroes who are hit with Overflowing Chaos are Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

4.name: Allegrissimo
4.description:
Reduce the cooldown of Shadow Waltz by 1 second.

Hitting Heroes with the end of Shadow Waltz sets its cooldown to 0.75 seconds.

4.name: Backbiter
4.description:
If Chomp hits a Hero, Orphea immediately dashes a short distance backwards.

Passive: Gain 15% maximum Health.

4.name: Chaotic Assault
4.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes while having 3 stacks of Chaos deal an additional 75% bonus damage.

7.name: Insatiable
7.description: Hitting a Hero with Chomp sets its cooldown to 2 seconds.

7.name: Ravenous Hunger
7.description:
Quest: Minions that die within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Chomp permanently increase its damage by 2 and heal Orphea for 60 (+4% per level). 

Heroes that die increase its damage by 40 and heal Orphea for 25% of her maximum Health.

7.name: Mind Devourer
7.description:
Quest: Hitting Heroes with Dread increases its damage by 5, up to 150.

Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, hitting an enemy Hero with Dread's eruption sets its cooldown to 6 seconds and refunds 50 Mana.

10.name: Eternal Feast
10.description: After 1.5 seconds, deal 210 (+4% per level) damage in an area. Eternal Feast repeats every 1 second as long as it hits an enemy Hero.

10.name: Crushing Jaws
10.description: After 1.25 seconds, pull enemies in an area towards the center, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

13.name: Determination
13.description: After dashing with Shadow Waltz, Orphea gains 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability, stacking up to 2 times. While Orphea has Determination, her Physical damage is increased by 15%.

13.name: Abyssal Symbiosis
13.description: Hitting a Hero with Chomp instantly grants Orphea maximum Chaos and a 170 (+4% per level) Shield for 3 seconds.

13.name: Invasive Miasma
13.description: Activate to deal 150 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies after 2 seconds. For each Hero hit, heal for 182 (+4% per level) and gain 1 Chaos.

16.name: Bond of Anguish
16.description: Shadow Waltz deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 3% of their maximum Health, healing Orphea for 50% of damage dealt.

16.name: Dead Magic
16.description: Basic Attacks that consume Chaos ignore Armor and deal 90 (+4% per level) Spell Damage to the target and all enemies around them.

16.name: Lurking Terror
16.description: After Dread erupts and for 2 seconds after, activate to cast Chomp from the eruption area. Enemy Heroes hit by this Chomp are Slowed by 70% for 1.5 seconds.

20.name: Monster Within
20.description: Eternal Feast grants 1 Chaos each time it hits a Hero. While Eternal Feast is active and for 5 seconds afterwards, Orphea's Basic Abilities recharge 150% faster.

20.name: Engulfing Oblivion
20.description: Crushing Jaws reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 50 for 3 seconds. Takedowns set its cooldown to 5 seconds.

20.name: Eldritch Conduit
20.description: Each Chaos consumed increases Orphea's Spell Power by 3%, up to 30%. After reaching the maximum bonus, the Spell Power is increased by an additional 30%. Lasts 10 seconds.

20.name: Final Toccata
20.description: Activate to instantly reset the cooldown of Shadow Waltz. For the next 5 seconds, dashing with Shadow Waltz resets its cooldown and increases the duration of Final Toccata by 1 second.

probius.name: Probius
probius.description: A high damage Summoner that must stay near Pylons to be effective.

abilities.name: Disruption Pulse
abilities.description:
Fire a burst of energy forward, dealing 142 (+5% per level) damage to all enemies it passes through.

Hitting the center of a Warp Rift will cause it to explode, dealing additional damage.

abilities.name: Warp Rift
abilities.description:
Open an unstable Warp Rift at a location that takes 1.25 seconds to arm, which then Slows nearby enemies by 25% lasting 3 seconds.

Armed Warp Rifts explode when they expire or when hit by Disruption Pulse, dealing 261 (+5% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Photon Cannon
abilities.description:
Warp in a Photon Cannon that deals 105 (+4% per level) damage. Lasts for 13 seconds.

While within a Pylon's Power Field, Photon Cannons gain 40% Attack Speed over 4 seconds and reveal nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Pylon Overcharge
abilities.description: For 8 seconds, increase the size of Pylon power fields and allow them to attack enemy Heroes within it for 96 (+4% per level) damage per second. Pylons are Invulnerable for the duration.

abilities.name: Null Gate
abilities.description:
Vector Targeting
Project a barrier of negative energy in the target direction that lasts 4 seconds. Enemies who touch the barrier take 76 (+4% per level) damage per second and are Slowed by 80% for as long as they remain in contact with it.

abilities.name: Warp In Pylon
abilities.description:
Warp in a Pylon that generates a Power Field and grants vision of the surrounding area. Probius only regenerates mana while inside a Power Field. Enemy Heroes and Minions drop Minerals when killed. Gather Minerals to reduce the cooldown of Warp In Pylon by 0.75 seconds.

Up to 2 Pylons can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Worker Rush
abilities.description:
Activate to gain an additional 60% Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Taking damage ends this effect early. Worker Rush is always active while at the Hall of Storms.

Passive: Probius moves 10% faster by hovering over the ground.

1.name: Echo Pulse
1.description: Disruption Pulse now returns to Probius 1.25 seconds after reaching its target, dealing 100% damage on the return trip.

1.name: Warp Resonance
1.description:
Quest: Hit Heroes with Warp Rift explosions.

Reward: After hitting 8 Heroes with Warp Rift explosions, increase the explosion damage by 120.

Reward: After hitting 16 Heroes with Warp Rift explosions, Warp Rift gains 1 additional charge.

1.name: Gather Minerals
1.description:
Quest: Gather Minerals to increase the Health of Photon Cannons by 8, up to 560. 

Reward: After collecting 70 Minerals, Photon Cannons deal 35% more damage.

4.name: Photon Barrier
4.description: While a Photon Cannon is alive and powered, Probius gains 40 Spell Armor.

4.name: Turbo Charged
4.description: Worker Rush grants an additional 10% passive Movement Speed while in a Power Field, and its cooldown is reduced by 14 seconds.

4.name: Shield Capacitor
4.description: Probius gains permanent Shields equal to 10% of his max Health. Shields regenerate quickly as long as he hasn't taken damage recently.

7.name: Particle Accelerator
7.description:
After hitting 3 Heroes with Disruption Pulse, the next Warp Rift detonated by a Disruption Pulse fires 4 additional pulses that deal 78 (+5% per level) damage from the impact location in different directions.

Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Disruption Pulse by 0.5 seconds.

7.name: Rift Shock
7.description: Hitting a Warp Rift with Disruption Pulse within 1 second of it arming deals 105 (+5% per level) damage over 3 seconds.

7.name: Tower Defense
7.description: Reduce Photon Cannon's cooldown by 3.5 seconds when Disruption Pulse or Warp Rift damages an enemy Hero.

10.name: Pylon Overcharge
10.description: For 8 seconds, increase the size of Pylon power fields and allow them to attack enemy Heroes within it for 96 (+4% per level) damage per second. Pylons are Invulnerable for the duration.

10.name: Null Gate
10.description:
Vector Targeting
Project a barrier of negative energy in the target direction that lasts 4 seconds. Enemies who touch the barrier take 76 (+4% per level) damage per second and are Slowed by 80% for as long as they remain in contact with it.

13.name: Aggressive Matrix
13.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 35% increased Attack Damage.

13.name: Power Overflowing
13.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 10% increased Spell Power and 2 Mana per second.

13.name: Shield Battery
13.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 28 (+4% per level) Shields per second, up to 112 (+4% per level). Shields persist for 2 seconds after exiting a Pylon Power Field.

16.name: Quantum Entanglement
16.description: Enemies continue to be Slowed for 3 seconds after their last contact with a Warp Rift.

16.name: Gravity Well
16.description: Enemies are Slowed more the closer they are to the center of the Warp Rift, up to a maximum slow of 60%.

16.name: Interference
16.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Warp Rift explosions have their Spell Power reduced by 35% for 5 seconds. Additionally, enemies hit by Warp Rift explosions are knocked away from the center.

20.name: Construct Additional Pylons
20.description: Probius can now have up to 3 active Pylons, and increase the damage of Pylon Overcharge by 25%.

20.name: Gate Keeper
20.description: Null Gate lasts indefinitely if either end is within a Power Field.

20.name: Shoot 'Em Up
20.description:
Enemy Heroes hit by Disruption Pulse take a bonus 2.5% of their maximum Health as damage.

Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Disruption Pulse by 0.5 seconds.

20.name: Probius Loop
20.description: Whenever a Rift explosion hits 1 or more enemy Heroes, create a new Warp Rift in the same location.

ragnaros.name: Ragnaros
ragnaros.description: A Bruiser that can nullify enemy pushes against his Forts and Keeps.

abilities.name: Empower Sulfuras
abilities.description:
Ragnaros's next Basic Attack is instant, dealing 191 (+4% per level) Ability damage in an area, and heals for 20% of the damage dealt. Healing doubled versus Heroes.

Molten Core: Molten Swing
Stun and damage nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Living Meteor
abilities.description:
Vector Targeting
Summon a meteor at the target point that deals 68 (+4% per level) damage, then rolls in the target direction dealing 272 (+4% per level) damage per second for 1.75 seconds.

Molten Core: Meteor Shower
Drop a line of meteor impacts.

abilities.name: Blast Wave
abilities.description:
Ignite Ragnaros or an ally, granting 25% Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds before exploding dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

Molten Core: Explosive Rune
Cause a delayed explosion in a large area.

abilities.name: Sulfuras Smash
abilities.description:
Hurl Sulfuras at the target area, landing after 0.75 seconds, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies in the center take 594 (+4% per level) damage instead and are Stunned for 0.5 seconds.

Quest: Hit 8 enemy Heroes in the center.

Mythic Reward: Sulfuras Smash gains an additional charge.

abilities.name: Lava Wave
abilities.description: Release a wave of lava from Ragnaros's Core that travels down the targeted lane, dealing 240 (+4% per level) damage per second to non-Structure enemies in its path and instantly killing enemy Minions. Damage increased by 100% versus Heroes.

abilities.name: Molten Core
abilities.description:
Channel on an allied or destroyed Fort or Keep to replace it with Ragnaros's ultimate form, temporarily gaining new Abilities, having 5000 (+4% per level) Health that burns away over 23 seconds.  Ragnaros's ability ranges increase over the duration of Molten Core.

Ragnaros returns to his normal form but is Stunned for 1 second upon losing all Health in Molten Core.

1.name: Sulfuras Hungers
1.description:
Quest: Every time Empower Sulfuras kills a Minion, its damage is increased by 1, up to 25.

Reward: After killing 25 Minions, increase its damage by an additional 100.

1.name: Shifting Meteor
1.description:
Each time an enemy is hit by the same Living Meteor, they take 6% increased damage from it.

Quest: Hit 75 Heroes with Living Meteor.

Reward: After hitting 75 Heroes with Living Meteor, its duration is increased to 2.25 seconds, and it can be reactivated to change its direction once per use.

1.name: Engulfing Flame
1.description: Increase Blast Wave's damage by 50% and its radius by 15%.

4.name: Fire Ward
4.description:
When Living Meteor hits an enemy Hero, gain a charge of Spell Armor, reducing damage from the next enemy ability by 50%.

Stores up to 2 charges.

4.name: Slow Burn
4.description: Blast Wave Slows enemies hit by 40% for 2 seconds.

4.name: Catching Fire
4.description:
Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Ragnaros' Health Regeneration by 1.25 per second, up to 18.75.

Reward: After gathering 15 Regeneration Globes, activate Catching Fire to gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 25%.

7.name: Hand of Ragnaros
7.description: If Empower Sulfuras hits at least 2 enemy Heroes, refund 10 Mana and its cooldown recharges 100% faster for 4 seconds.

7.name: Molten Power
7.description: If Living Meteor hits enemy Heroes at least 5 times, reduce its cooldown by 7 seconds, and refund 30 Mana.

7.name: Blistering Attacks
7.description: Every 10 seconds, Ragnaros's next Basic Attack against a Hero deals 60% bonus damage. Hitting enemies with Basic Abilities reduces this cooldown by 1 second.

10.name: Sulfuras Smash
10.description:
Hurl Sulfuras at the target area, landing after 0.75 seconds, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies in the center take 594 (+4% per level) damage instead and are Stunned for 0.5 seconds.

Quest: Hit 8 enemy Heroes in the center.

Mythic Reward: Sulfuras Smash gains an additional charge.

10.name: Lava Wave
10.description: Release a wave of lava from Ragnaros's Core that travels down the targeted lane, dealing 240 (+4% per level) damage per second to non-Structure enemies in its path and instantly killing enemy Minions. Damage increased by 100% versus Heroes.

13.name: Cauterize Wounds
13.description: Empower Sulfuras heals for an additional 45% of damage dealt to Heroes over 2 seconds.

13.name: Tempered Flame
13.description: When Blast Wave damages an enemy Hero, gain a Shield equal to 100% of the damage dealt for 3 seconds.

13.name: Resilient Flame
13.description:
When Ragnaros is Stunned, he gains 40 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 40%. 

This effect has a 15 second cooldown.

16.name: Giant Scorcher
16.description: Empower Sulfuras burns enemy Heroes for 9% of their maximum Health over 3 seconds. This additional damage does not heal Ragnaros.

16.name: Meteor Bomb
16.description: Living Meteor explodes at the end of its path, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies at its center take 30% increased damage.

16.name: Blast Echo
16.description: After Blast Wave explodes, another Blast Wave is created on Ragnaros.

20.name: Flames of Sulfuron
20.description: Sulfuras Smash Slows enemies by 50% for 2.5 seconds, and the Stun duration of enemies hit in the center is increased by 1 second.

20.name: Lava Surge
20.description: Lava Wave gains an additional charge and causes allied Minions and non-Boss Mercenaries to be carried with it.

20.name: Heroic Difficulty
20.description: Molten Core's range is increased by 100% at the start of its duration.  In addition, the cooldown of Molten Core is reduced by 110 seconds when used on a destroyed Fort or Keep.

20.name: Submerge
20.description: Ragnaros submerges below, entering Stasis and healing for 600 (+4% per level) Health over 3 seconds.

raynor.name: Raynor
raynor.description: A Physical Damage Assassin that can keep enemies away.

abilities.name: Penetrating Round
abilities.description: Deal 205 (+4% per level) damage, knock back, and Slow enemies in a line by 20% for 2 seconds. Enemies close to Raynor are knocked back further.

abilities.name: Inspire
abilities.description:
Raynor and all nearby allied Minions and Mercenaries gain 30% Attack Speed and 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

Casting Inspire resets Raynor's Basic Attack cooldown.

abilities.name: Adrenaline Rush
abilities.description: Heal Raynor for 25% of his maximum Health over 1 second. Raynor's Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 0.5 seconds, increased to 1 second against Heroes.

abilities.name: Hyperion
abilities.description: Order the Hyperion to make a strafing run for 12 seconds, hitting up to 4 enemies for 66 (+4% per level) damage every second. Every 4 seconds, it can fire its Yamato Cannon at a Structure, dealing 794 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Raynor's Raider
abilities.description:
Summon a Banshee that assists Raynor. The Banshee deals 84 (+4% per level) damage per second and regenerates 75 (+4% per level) Health per second if it hasn't taken damage in the last 4 seconds. Can reactivate to retarget or move the Banshee.

The Banshee respawns automatically after 45 seconds.

abilities.name: Give 'Em Some Pepper
abilities.description: Every 4th Basic Attack splashes in a small area and deals 125% more damage to the main target.

1.name: Exterminator
1.description:
Basic Attacks deal 50% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters. This is increased to 125% while Inspire is active. 

Passive: Inspire does not expire on friendly Minions and Mercenaries.

1.name: Veteran Marksman
1.description:
Quest: Every time the primary target of Give 'Em Some Pepper is a Hero, permanently increase its damage bonus by 0.75%.

Gambit: Gain 60% bonus Give 'Em Some Pepper damage. Every death reduces this bonus by 15%.

1.name: Ace In The Hole
1.description:
Deal 12% more damage to Stunned or Slowed Heroes.

Enemy Heroes hit by Give 'Em Some Pepper are Slowed by 10% for 2.5 seconds.

4.name: Fight or Flight
4.description: Reduce Adrenaline Rush's cooldown by 10 seconds. Casting Adrenaline Rush grants 25 Armor for 3 seconds.

4.name: Sustaining Rounds
4.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper heals Raynor for 3% of his maximum Health, increased to 6% if the primary target is a Hero.

4.name: Behemoth Armor
4.description:
Gain 200 bonus maximum Health. 

 Quest: Every time Give 'Em Some Pepper's primary target is a Hero, gain an additional 8 maximum Health.

7.name: Heavy Slugs
7.description: Increase Penetrating Round's Slow by 15% and its duration by 2 seconds.

7.name: Fuel The Rush
7.description:
While Inspire is active, Adrenaline Rush's cooldown reduction from Basic Attacks is increased to 2.25 seconds against non-Heroes, and to 4.5 seconds against Heroes.

Passive: Reduce the Mana cost of Adrenaline Rush from 75 to 45.

7.name: Unstable Compound
7.description: Increase the radius of Give 'Em Some Pepper by 15%. Each enemy Hero hit by Give 'Em Some Pepper grants Raynor 10 Mana and reduces the cooldown of Penetrating Round by 1.5 seconds.

10.name: Hyperion
10.description: Order the Hyperion to make a strafing run for 12 seconds, hitting up to 4 enemies for 66 (+4% per level) damage every second. Every 4 seconds, it can fire its Yamato Cannon at a Structure, dealing 794 (+4% per level) damage.

10.name: Raynor's Raider
10.description:
Summon a Banshee that assists Raynor. The Banshee deals 84 (+4% per level) damage per second and regenerates 75 (+4% per level) Health per second if it hasn't taken damage in the last 4 seconds. Can reactivate to retarget or move the Banshee.

The Banshee respawns automatically after 45 seconds.

13.name: Line 'Em Up
13.description: Reduce the cooldown of Penetrating Round by 3 seconds. Penetrating Round hitting two or more enemy Heroes reduces its cooldown by an additional 3 seconds.

13.name: Giddy-Up
13.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed while mounted and unmounted. Inspire grants 10% more Movement Speed.

13.name: Give Me More!
13.description:
While Inspire is active, gain 1 Basic Attack range.

Passive: Increase Adrenaline Rush duration by 0.5 seconds, increasing the total amount healed by 12.5% of Raynor's maximum Health.

16.name: Paint Them Red
16.description: Increase the damage of Penetrating Round by 50% and heal for 90% of the damage Penetrating Round deals to Heroes.

16.name: Rallying Cry
16.description:
Increase the Attack Speed bonus of Inspire by 20%.

Passive: After every 12 Basic Attacks, cast Inspire for free.

16.name: Bounty Hunter
16.description:
If Give 'Em Some Pepper's target is a Hero, it deals an additional 3% of their maximum Health as damage and grants Raynor 10 Armor for 3 seconds. 

Activate Give 'Em Some Pepper to apply it to Raynor's next Basic Attack.

20.name: Cavalry's Arrived
20.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper lowers the cooldown of Hyperion by 5 seconds if the primary target is a Hero. These Heroes are targeted by the Hyperion for 100% increased damage for 6 seconds.

20.name: Dusk Wing
20.description: Increase the Health and leash range of Raynor's Raider by 100%. Its Basic Attack lowers enemy Hero Armor by 3 for 1 second, stacking up to 30.

20.name: Raiders Roll
20.description: Adrenaline Rush grants Unstoppable and continues healing for an additional 2 seconds. The additional duration ends upon reaching 70% Health.

20.name: Sergeant Pepper
20.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper now activates every 3 Basic Attacks.

20.name: Execute Orders
20.description:
When Raynor is killed, the Hyperion is cast towards the closest enemy Hero. It lasts 12 seconds, hitting up to 4 enemy Heroes of the lowest Health in the area for 66 (+4% per level) damage every second. Every 4 seconds, it will also fire its Yamato Cannon at the lowest Health enemy Hero, dealing 395 (+4% per level) damage.

Passive: Reduce Raynor's death timer by 35 seconds.

rehgar.name: Rehgar
rehgar.description: A well-rounded Healer that pairs well with Melee allies.

abilities.name: Chain Heal
abilities.description: Heal an ally with a wave of healing for 260 (+4% per level) Health. The wave then bounces 2 times to nearby allies within 7 range, restoring 260 (+4% per level) Health to them.

abilities.name: Lightning Shield
abilities.description: Imbue an ally with lightning dealing 64 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies. Each enemy hit restores 1 Mana to Rehgar. Lasts 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Earthbind Totem
abilities.description: Create a totem that Slows nearby enemies by 35%. The totem has 260 (+4% per level) Health and lasts for 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.description: Grant nearby allied Heroes 40% Attack Speed and 35% Movement Speed and causes them to heal for 30% of the Basic Attack damage to their primary target. Lasts for 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Ancestral Healing
abilities.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

abilities.name: Purge
abilities.description:
When used on an allied Hero, make them Unstoppable for 0.5 seconds. When used on an enemy Hero, Slow them by 80%, decaying over 2 seconds.

Cannot be cast on yourself.

abilities.name: Ghost Wolf
abilities.description: Instead of using a mount, Rehgar transforms into a Ghost Wolf with 20% increased Movement Speed. Basic Attacks in Ghost Wolf form cause him to lunge at his target and deal 60% bonus damage. Dealing damage, using Abilities, and channeling cancels Ghost Wolf form.

1.name: Stormcaller
1.description:
Increase the radius of Lightning Shield by 25%. 

Quest: Each time Lightning Shield damages an enemy Hero, permanently increase Rehgar's Health by 2 and Mana by 1, stacking up to 200 times.

1.name: Colossal Totem
1.description:
Reactivate Earthbind Totem to move an existing totem to a new location. This can be used once per cast.

Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's area and duration by 50%, and Health by 25%.

1.name: Feral Heart
1.description: Ghost Wolf's Movement Speed bonus is increased to 40% for the first second, then falls to 30%. Entering or exiting Ghost Wolf form grants 15 Armor for 1 second.

4.name: Earthliving Enchant
4.description: When Chain Heal heals a Hero below 50% Health, they are healed an additional 160 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds.

4.name: Electric Charge
4.description:
The bearer of Lightning Shield Heals for 20% of the damage it deals to enemy Heroes, doubled if the bearer is Rehgar.

While Lightning Shield is damaging an enemy, its bearer gains 10% increased Movement Speed.

4.name: Healing Totem
4.description: Activate to place a Totem that heals allied Heroes in an area for 2% of their maximum Health every second. This Totem has 125 (+4% per level) Health and lasts for 10 seconds.

7.name: Grounded Totem
7.description:
Enemy Heroes in Earthbind Totem's area also have their Attack Speed Slowed by 15% and their Spell Power reduced by 15%.

Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's cast range by 45%.

7.name: Purification
7.description:
If Purge removes a Slow, Stun, Root, or Silence effect from an ally, heal them for 220 (+4% per level).

Using Purge on an enemy Hero deals up to 330 (+4% per level) damage to Shields and reduces healing received by 40% for 2 seconds.

Passive: Reduce Purge's cooldown by 15 seconds.

7.name: Blood and Thunder
7.description: Ghost Wolf attacks reduce Basic Ability cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and restore 4% of Rehgar's maximum Mana.

10.name: Ancestral Healing
10.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

10.name: Bloodlust
10.description: Grant nearby allied Heroes 40% Attack Speed and 35% Movement Speed and causes them to heal for 30% of the Basic Attack damage to their primary target. Lasts for 6 seconds.

13.name: Tidal Waves
13.description: Reduces Chain Heal's cooldown by 1 second for each Hero healed, and reduces its Mana cost from 60 to 40.

13.name: Earth Shield
13.description: Lightning Shield gives Heroes a Shield that absorbs damage equal to 14% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds.

13.name: Wellspring
13.description: Every 2 seconds, Earthbind Totem will cast an untalented Chain Heal at the nearest allied Hero with the lowest Health. This Chain Heal heals for 35% of its normal amount.

16.name: Rising Storm
16.description:
Every time a Lightning Shield damages an enemy Hero, increase its damage by 10%. Stacks up to 15 times.

Passive: Increase the duration of Lightning Shield by 3 seconds.

16.name: Earthgrasp Totem
16.description: When Earthbind Totem is first cast, it deals 90 (+4% per level) damage and Slows nearby enemies by 90% for 1 second.

16.name: Hunger of the Wolf
16.description: Ghost Wolf attacks against Heroes deal an additional 6% of the target's maximum Health and heal Rehgar for 6% of his maximum Health.

20.name: Farseer's Blessing
20.description: After 1.5 seconds, Ancestral Healing is cast a second time on the same target. Allies near the target are healed for 590 (+4% per level).

20.name: Gladiator's War Shout
20.description: Increase the duration and range of Bloodlust by 100%.

20.name: Elemental Conduit
20.description:
Activate to gain Lightning Shield and grant all nearby allied Heroes a Shield equal to 10% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds. 

For up to 5 seconds after activating, hitting an enemy Hero with this effects' Lightning Shield gives nearby allies a Shield equal to 1.5% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds.

20.name: Pit Fighter
20.description:
Gain 10% increased Attack Damage and 3 Spell Power. Each nearby ally Hero grants an additional stack of this effect, up to 5 stacks. 

While at 2 or more stacks, Purge's cooldown refreshes 50% faster.

rexxar.name: Rexxar
rexxar.description: A Bruiser that with his bear, Misha, expertly controls areas of the battleground.

abilities.name: Spirit Swoop
abilities.description: Deal 141 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line, slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Misha, Charge!
abilities.description: Misha charges in a line, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and stunning enemies for 1.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Mend Pet
abilities.description: Heal Misha for 714 (+4% per level) Health over 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Unleash the Boars
abilities.description: Release a herd of boars that track down all enemy Heroes in a direction, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, and slowing enemies by 40% for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Bestial Wrath
abilities.description: Increases Misha's Basic Attack damage by 200% for 12 seconds.

abilities.name: Misha, Focus!
abilities.description:
Passive: Misha gains 15% move speed. 

Command Misha to attack a specific enemy or move to a point and wait.

Targeting Rexxar commands Misha to retreat to his position, gaining 30% move speed until she reaches Rexxar.

Targeting Misha commands her to hold her current position.

1.name: Bird of Prey
1.description: Increases Spirit Swoop's damage by 150% to Minions.

1.name: Easy Prey
1.description: Increases Misha's basic attack damage to Minions and Mercenaries by 150%, and Misha gains 50 Armor against Minions and Mercenaries, reducing damage taken by 50%.

1.name: Flare
1.description: Fire a flare at an area, revealing it for 20 seconds.

4.name: Hungry Bear
4.description: Misha's Basic Attacks heal her for 4.5% of her maximum Health.

4.name: Hunter-Gatherer
4.description:
Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Rexxar and Misha's Health Regeneration by 1 per second, up to 25 per second. 

Reward: After gathering 25 Globes, Rexxar and Misha gain 15 Armor.

4.name: Grizzled Fortitude
4.description:
Every 6 seconds, Rexxar and Misha gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

Stores up to 2 charges. Both Rexxar and Misha have their own charges.

4.name: Animal Husbandry
4.description: Rexxar and Misha gain 2 Maximum Health every second Rexxar remains alive. These bonuses are lost on Rexxar's death.

7.name: Crippling Talons
7.description: Increases Spirit Swoop's slow amount to 50% and its duration to 3.5 seconds.

7.name: Taking Flight
7.description: Increases Spirit Swoop's range by 20%. If Spirit Swoop hits an enemy Hero, the Mana cost is refunded and its cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

7.name: Aspect of the Beast
7.description: Misha's Basic Attacks lower the cooldown of Misha, Charge! by 1 second.

10.name: Bestial Wrath
10.description: Increases Misha's Basic Attack damage by 200% for 12 seconds.

10.name: Unleash the Boars
10.description: Release a herd of boars that track down all enemy Heroes in a direction, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, and slowing enemies by 40% for 5 seconds.

13.name: Aspect of the Hawk
13.description: When Spirit Swoop hits an enemy Hero, Rexxar gains 125% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Misha's Basic Attacks increase the duration of this buff by 0.75 seconds.

13.name: Dire Beast
13.description: Rexxar and Misha's Basic Attacks increase the damage of the next Misha, Charge! by 15%, stacking up to a 150% bonus.

13.name: Wildfire Bear
13.description: Misha deals 28 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

16.name: Thrill of the Hunt
16.description: Rexxar's Basic Attacks increase both his and Misha's Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds.

16.name: Primal Intimidation
16.description:
Activate to Slow the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of Heroes and Summons near Rexxar and Misha for 2.5 seconds.

Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack Rexxar or Misha have their Attack Speed slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

16.name: Feign Death
16.description: Rexxar fakes his death, becoming Invulnerable and untargetable for 5 seconds. During this time you control Misha.

20.name: Spirit Bond
20.description: Increases the duration of Bestial Wrath by 50% and Misha's Basic Attacks heal Rexxar for 50% of her damage dealt during Bestial Wrath.

20.name: Kill Command
20.description: Unleash the Boars deals 50% more damage and Roots for 1.5 seconds.

20.name: Frenzy of Kalimdor
20.description: Rexxar's Basic Attacks deal 10% more damage, and Misha's Basic Attacks slow the target by 20% for 1.25 seconds.

20.name: Hardened Skin
20.description: Rexxar and Misha gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds, reducing damage taken by 75%.

samuro.name: Samuro
samuro.description: A stealthed Assassin that's great at capturing Mercenary camps and is difficult to kill.

abilities.name: Mirror Image
abilities.description:
Teleport a short distance in the direction of the mouse cursor, creating 2 Mirror Image in the opposite direction with as much Health as Samuro, each dealing 11 (+4% per level) damage with their Basic Attacks. Whenever an Image takes damage, it deals that amount of damage to itself, effectively doubling the damage it takes.

Mirror Images last for 8 seconds, and up to 2 Mirror Images can be active at a time. Each time they or Samuro hit an enemy Hero with their Basic Attack, their duration is extended by 1 second. Using Mirror Image removes most negative effects from Samuro.

abilities.name: Critical Strike
abilities.description:
Activate to cause Samuro and his Mirror Images next Basic Attack within 8 seconds to be a Critical Strike, dealing 50% additional damage. Stealth is not broken when activated.

Passive: Samuro and his Images also deal a Critical Strike every 4th Basic Attack.

abilities.name: Wind Walk
abilities.description:
Grant Samuro Stealth for up to 10 seconds or until he attacks, uses an Ability, or takes damage.

While Stealthed, Samuro heals for 2% of his maximum Health every second, his Movement Speed is increased by 20% and he can pass through other units. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

Samuro is Unrevealable for the first 1 second of Wind Walk.

abilities.name: Bladestorm
abilities.description: Cause a Bladestorm of destructive force around Samuro for 3 seconds, granting him 25 Armor and dealing 180 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Illusion Master
abilities.description:
Mirror Images can be controlled individually or as a group and their damage is increased by 100%. 

Passive: Image Transmission's cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Image Transmission
abilities.description:
Activate to switch places with a target Mirror Image, removing most negative effects from Samuro and all Mirror Images.

Advancing Strikes

Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase Samuro's Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds.

1.name: Way of Illusion
1.description:
Quest: Every time a Mirror Image Critically Strikes a Hero, Samuro gains 0.25 Attack Damage, up to 10.

Reward: After hitting 40 Heroes, Samuro gains an additional 30 Attack Damage.

1.name: Way of the Blade
1.description:
Critical Strike now happens for Samuro and his Mirror Images every 3rd Basic Attack. 

Critical Strikes against enemy Heroes from Samuro or his Mirror Images reduces their Physical Armor by 5 for 2.25 seconds, up to a maximum reduction of 15 Physical Armor.

1.name: Way of the Wind
1.description:
After activating or exiting Wind Walk, Samuro gains 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

Activating Wind Walk instantly heals Samuro for 3% of his maximum Health.

4.name: Mirage
4.description: Mirror Image grants Samuro and his Images 40 Spell Armor against the next 2 sources of Spell Damage, reducing their damage by 40%.

4.name: One With The Wind
4.description: While Samuro has Wind Walk active and for 3 seconds after breaking it, both he and his Mirror Images gain 25 Armor, taking 25% reduced damage from all sources.

4.name: Deflection
4.description: Advancing Strikes grants Samuro and his Mirror Images 35 Physical Armor.

7.name: Burning Blade
7.description: Critical Strikes from Samuro or his Mirror Images deal bonus Spell Damage equal to 50% of their Basic Attack damage to the target and other nearby enemies.

7.name: Phantom Pain
7.description: Samuro's Critical Strikes against enemy Heroes reduce Image Transmission's cooldown by 1 second, and deal 35% more damage for each active Mirror Image.

7.name: Crushing Blows
7.description:
Samuro's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce Critical Strike's cooldown by 2 seconds.

Critical Strikes against enemy Heroes increase Samuro's Basic Attack damage by 10% for 4 seconds, up to 30%.

10.name: Bladestorm
10.description: Cause a Bladestorm of destructive force around Samuro for 3 seconds, granting him 25 Armor and dealing 180 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

10.name: Illusion Master
10.description:
Mirror Images can be controlled individually or as a group and their damage is increased by 100%. 

Passive: Image Transmission's cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds.

13.name: Mirrored Steel
13.description: Samuro's Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Mirror Image by 0.75 seconds.

13.name: Kawarimi
13.description: Wind Walk creates a Mirror Image at Samuro's location that will continue whatever he was doing.

13.name: Shukuchi
13.description: Wind Walk teleports Samuro a short distance in the direction he's currently facing.

16.name: Merciless Strikes
16.description: Samuro's Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed enemies are always Critical Strikes.

16.name: Harsh Winds
16.description: If Wind Walk is broken by Samuro attacking an enemy Hero, he deals 30% additional damage to that target for 3 seconds.

16.name: Press the Attack
16.description:
Basic Attacks from Samuro or his Mirror Images against enemy Heroes or while Advancing Strikes is active increases their Attack Speed by 10%, up to 40%.

These bonuses are lost when losing Advancing Strikes.

20.name: Dance Of Death
20.description: Mirror Images use Bladestorm when Samuro does, but for 45% damage. If Samuro hits at least 20 enemy Heroes with Bladestorm, then reset its cooldown.

20.name: Three Blade Style
20.description: Samuro's Mirror Images only deal half of the damage they take to themselves, effectively increasing their Health by 25%, and their duration is increased to 16 seconds.

20.name: Wind Strider
20.description: Wind Walk's cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds.

20.name: Blademaster’s Pursuit
20.description: Advancing Strikes grants an additional 15% Movement Speed for Samuro and his Mirror Images, and its duration is increased by 2 seconds.

sgthammer.name: Sgt. Hammer
sgthammer.description: A long-range, Physical Damage dealer that needs protection from allies.

abilities.name: Spider Mines
abilities.description:
Create 3 mines that arm after 1.25 seconds. Mines detonate when an enemy comes in range, dealing 96 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 25% for 1.5 seconds.

Siege Mode: Cast range increased by 100%.

abilities.name: Concussive Blast
abilities.description:
Deal 141 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in front of Sgt. Hammer and knock them back.

Siege Mode: Radius increased by 50%.

abilities.name: Neosteel Plating
abilities.description:
Gain 25 Armor for 2 seconds.

Siege Mode: Grants 100% more Armor.

abilities.name: Napalm Strike
abilities.description: Deals 164 (+4% per level) damage on impact, and leaves a napalm area that deals 50 (+4% per level) damage per second. Lasts for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Blunt Force Gun
abilities.description: Fire a missile across the battlefield, dealing 500 (+3% per level) damage to enemies in its path.  Deals 50% damage to Structures.

abilities.name: Siege Mode
abilities.description: Activate to enter Siege Mode. While in Siege Mode, Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage, have 100% increased range, and deal 25% of their damage as splash damage around the target.

abilities.name: Thrusters
abilities.description: Increase Movement Speed by 60% for 4 seconds. Thrusters are always active while at the Hall of Storms. Activating Thrusters cancels Siege Mode.

1.name: Ambush
1.description:
Gain Stealth when entering Siege Mode or after not taking or dealing damage for 3 seconds while in Siege Mode. Basic Attacks while Stealthed deal 125% more damage.

Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

1.name: Advanced Artillery
1.description: Increase Siege Mode's splash damage to 60% of Basic Attack damage, and increase its splash radius by 25%.

1.name: Maelstrom Rounds
1.description:
Activate to increase Basic Attack damage dealt by 40% for 5 seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes or Structures with Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode reduces the cooldown of Maelstrom Rounds by 5 seconds.

Stores up to 3 charges.

4.name: Barricade
4.description: Reduce Concussive Blast's cooldown by 4 seconds, its Mana cost by 40, and when cast create an impassable wall in front of Sgt. Hammer for 4 seconds.

4.name: Siege Tactics
4.description: Using Neosteel Plating while in Siege Mode grants Unstoppable for 2 seconds, as long as she remains in Siege Mode.

4.name: Regenerative Bio-Steel
4.description: Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode heal for 10% of the damage dealt.

7.name: Pulse Detonation Core
7.description: Spider Mines detonate 3 times over 3 seconds. All damage from Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant 5 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Spider Mines by 1.5 seconds. Increase this bonus to 2.5 seconds while in Siege Mode.

7.name: Hover Siege Mode
7.description: Sgt. Hammer can move at 50% Movement Speed while in Siege Mode.

7.name: Graduating Range
7.description: While in Siege Mode, Basic Attack range is increased by 1 every 1.5 seconds, up to 3.

10.name: Blunt Force Gun
10.description: Fire a missile across the battlefield, dealing 500 (+3% per level) damage to enemies in its path.  Deals 50% damage to Structures.

10.name: Napalm Strike
10.description: Deals 164 (+4% per level) damage on impact, and leaves a napalm area that deals 50 (+4% per level) damage per second. Lasts for 4 seconds.

13.name: Tactical Mine Deployment
13.description: Moving while Thrusters is active leaves a trail of up to 5 Spider Mines. Additionally, increase the Slow of Spider Mines by 15%.

13.name: Entrenched
13.description: While in Siege Mode, Concussive Blasts's damage and knockback distance are increased by 75%.

13.name: Hyper-Cooling Engines
13.description: While in Siege Mode, hitting Heroes or Structures with Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Thrusters by 5 seconds.

16.name: Mechanical Know-how
16.description: Neosteel Plating grants 20% maximum Health as a Shield for 2 seconds and increases Basic Attack damage by 30% for 5 seconds.

16.name: Executioner
16.description: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases your Basic Attack damage by 30% for 3 seconds.

16.name: Giant Killer
16.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

20.name: Orbital BFG
20.description: Blunt Force Gun's missile orbits the planet every 5 seconds. Only the last missile fired orbits.

20.name: Advanced Lava Strike
20.description: Increase the cast range of Napalm Strike by 75%, and its impact deals 65% more damage.

20.name: Shrapnel Mines
20.description: Upon detonating, Spider Mines reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 10, up to 50, for 4 seconds.

20.name: Ultra Capacitors
20.description: Hitting enemy Heroes or Structures with Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode grants 10% Attack Speed for 5 seconds, up to 60%.

stitches.name: Stitches
stitches.description: A Tank who wants to isolate distant enemies away from their team.

abilities.name: Hook
abilities.description:
Pull the first enemy hit towards Stitches and deal 91 (+4% per level) damage.

After reaching level 13, Hook's range is increased by 40%.

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.description: Deal 104 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within the target area. Enemies in the inner impact take 50% more damage and are Slowed by 45% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.description: Deal 319 (+4% per level) damage to non-Heroic units, or 114 (+4% per level) damage to Heroes. Restores 20% of Stitches's maximum Health.

abilities.name: Putrid Bile
abilities.description: Emit bile that deals 37 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies within, Slowing them by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Gain 20% Movement Speed while emitting bile. Lasts 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Gorge
abilities.description: Consume an enemy Hero, trapping them for 4 seconds. When Gorge ends, the enemy Hero takes 274 (+4% per level) damage. The trapped Hero cannot move or act and doesn't take damage from other sources.

abilities.name: Shambling Horror
abilities.description:
Activate to spread Vile Gas in a large area every second and prevent your Movement Speed from being reduced below 110% for 4 seconds.

Vile Gas
Hitting enemies with Basic Attacks or the inner area of Slam afflicts them with Vile Gas, dealing an additional 36 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. Deals 150% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

abilities.name: Helping Hand
abilities.description:
Activate to use Hook that can hit allied Heroes. Hitting an allied Hero this way reduces the cooldown of Hook by 8 seconds.

After reaching level 13, Helping Hand's range is increased by 40%.

1.name: Patchwork Creation
1.description:
Gain 3 Armor for every unit afflicted with Vile Gas, stacking up to 8 times. While Shambling Horror is active, this Armor amount is doubled.

Passive: Increase regeneration effects and all healing received by 15%.

1.name: Savor The Flavor
1.description: Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with Devour increases Stitches' Health Regeneration by 1.5 and the damage of Vile Gas by 2%, stacking up to 100 times.

1.name: Hungry for More
1.description:
Gain 5% Movement Speed.

Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Stitches's maximum Health by 25. 

Reward: Every 20 Globes gathered permanently increases Stitches' Movement Speed by an additional 5%.

4.name: Playtime!
4.description:
Basic Attacks restore 5 Mana and reduce Slam's cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

For each enemy Hero hit by Slam's inner area, restore 5 Mana and reduce its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

4.name: Vile Cleaver
4.description:
Basic Attacks against enemies with Vile Gas deal 35% more damage and spreads Vile Gas to nearby enemies. 

Passive: Slam applies Vile Gas to all targets hit.

4.name: Tenderizer
4.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes Slow by 20% for 1.5 seconds and restore 1.75% of Stitches' maximum Health.

7.name: Serrated Edge
7.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook deals bonus damage equal to 5% of their maximum Health, reduces Hook's cooldown by 4 seconds, and restores 35 Mana.

7.name: Second Helping
7.description:
Devour gains 1 additional charge with a 6 second cooldown between uses. 

Gambit: If Stitches is at max Health after using Devour, he gains a Shield equal to 15% of his maximum Health for 10 seconds. Every death, reduce this Shield by 3%.

7.name: Putrefaction
7.description:
While Shambling Horror is active, Vile Gas reduces healing received by 40%.

Passive: Vile Gas heals Stitches for 75% of the damage dealt.

10.name: Putrid Bile
10.description: Emit bile that deals 37 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies within, Slowing them by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Gain 20% Movement Speed while emitting bile. Lasts 8 seconds.

10.name: Gorge
10.description: Consume an enemy Hero, trapping them for 4 seconds. When Gorge ends, the enemy Hero takes 274 (+4% per level) damage. The trapped Hero cannot move or act and doesn't take damage from other sources.

13.name: Meat Hook
13.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook heals Stitches for 20% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. While active, Basic Attacks against the Hero hit refresh the duration of this effect.

13.name: Under Pressure
13.description:
Increase Slam's damage by 25.

Quest: After damaging Heroes with Vile Gas 6 times, permanently increase the damage of Slam by 1, to a maximum of 75 additional damage.

13.name: Chop Chop
13.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook or activating Shambling Horror grants 40% increased Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh the duration of this effect.

16.name: Pulverize
16.description: All enemies hit by Slam are Slowed by 70% for 0.75 seconds and Heroes have their Armor reduced by 10 for 3 seconds.

16.name: Digestive Juices
16.description: Devour deals an additional 140 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds. When used on a Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds and causes the Hero hit to deal 50% reduced damage for 4 seconds.

16.name: Flare Up
16.description: Deals 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook or activating Shambling Horror increases this damage by 150% for 4 seconds.

20.name: Gift From The Embalmer
20.description:
Putrid Bile deals 100% more damage to Heroes.

Quest: Each time Putrid Bile damages an enemy Hero, the duration of Stitches' next death timer is reduced by 2%, to a maximum of 80% total reduction. All stacks of this effect are lost upon death.

20.name: Hungry Hungry Stitches
20.description: For 4 seconds after using Gorge, Stitches can teleport a short distance to additional targets and Gorge them. Enemies are Slowed by 75% for 1 second after Gorge ends.

20.name: Master Hooker
20.description: Reduce the cooldown of Hook by 4 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit by Hook have 75% reduced healing for 2 seconds. Allies hit by Helping Hand are Unkillable for 2 seconds.

20.name: Gas Bag
20.description:
Activating Shambling Horror grants Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

Passive: Shambling Horror's cooldown is reduced by 20 seconds.

stukov.name: Stukov
stukov.description: A Healer that brings high amounts of disruption from long range.

abilities.name: Healing Pathogen
abilities.description:
Infest an allied Hero with a Healing Pathogen that heals the target for 222 (+4% per level) Health over 4.5 seconds. Healing Pathogens can spread to a nearby allied Hero every 0.75 seconds.

Each cast of Healing Pathogen can only spread to each allied Hero 1 time.

abilities.name: Weighted Pustule
abilities.description: Hurl a pustule that impacts all enemy Heroes in its path, dealing 20 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing by 5%, increasing to 50% over 3 seconds. Deals an additional 88 (+4% per level) damage upon expiring or being removed.

abilities.name: Lurking Arm
abilities.description:
Channel at a target location, creating an area that deals 136 (+4% per level) damage per second to non-Structure enemies and Silences them. Deals 50% reduced damage to non-Heroes.

Does not cost Mana while Channeling, and lasts until canceled or interrupted.

abilities.name: Massive Shove
abilities.description: Extend Stukov's arm. If it hits an enemy Hero, they are rapidly shoved until they collide with terrain, dealing 190 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Stukov gains 50 Armor while shoving an enemy.

abilities.name: Flailing Swipe
abilities.description: Swipe 3 times in front of Stukov over 1.75 seconds, dealing 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. Each swipe is larger than the previous.

abilities.name: Bio-Kill Switch
abilities.description:
Activate to detonate all of Stukov's Viruses. Each Healing Pathogen heals its target for 435 (+4% per level) Health, and each Weighted Pustule does 100 (+4% per level) damage and Slows its target by 70% for 2 seconds.

Can be cast while Channeling Lurking Arm.

1.name: Fetid Touch
1.description:
Basic Attacks become ranged and Slow enemies by 20% for 1.5 seconds, but deal 35% less damage. This effect can be toggled.

Quest: Hit Heroes with Weighted Pustule.

Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, reduce the cooldown of Weighted Pustule by 5 seconds and remove its Mana cost.

1.name: Low Blow
1.description: Lurking Arm deals 100% more damage to enemy Heroes below 50% Health and persists for 1 second after it is canceled.

1.name: Reactive Ballistospores
1.description:
Activate to instantly spread a Weighted Pustule to all nearby enemy Heroes and reset the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch.

Passive: While below 50% Health, the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch refreshes 100% faster.

4.name: One Good Spread...
4.description: After a Healing Pathogen infests 3 targets, restore 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Healing Pathogen by 2 seconds.

4.name: Biotic Armor
4.description: Healing Pathogen grants 10 Physical Armor to targets while active on them. Detonating Bio-Kill Switch increases this bonus to 50 for 2.5 seconds.

4.name: Vigorous Reuptake
4.description: Bio-Kill Switch heals for 30% more when detonating 3 or more Healing Pathogens.

7.name: The Long Pitch
7.description: Increase the range of Weighted Pustule by 50%. Detonating 2 or more Weighted Pustules causes Stukov's Bio-Kill Switch and Basic Ability cooldowns to recharge 100% faster for 4 seconds.

7.name: Growing Infestation
7.description: Lurking Arm's area expands by 50% over 2.5 seconds, but it cannot be Channeled for longer than 3 seconds.

7.name: Targeted Excision
7.description: Detonating exactly 1 Weighted Pustule (but any number of Healing Pathogens) with Bio-Kill Switch reduces the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch to 7 seconds and other Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds.

10.name: Flailing Swipe
10.description: Swipe 3 times in front of Stukov over 1.75 seconds, dealing 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. Each swipe is larger than the previous.

10.name: Massive Shove
10.description: Extend Stukov's arm. If it hits an enemy Hero, they are rapidly shoved until they collide with terrain, dealing 190 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Stukov gains 50 Armor while shoving an enemy.

13.name: It Hungers
13.description: Increase the range of Lurking Arm by 30%. If Lurking Arm damages enemy Heroes 8 times, its cooldown is reset and its Mana cost is refunded.

13.name: Virulent Reaction
13.description: Detonating a Weighted Pustule on an enemy who is inside of Lurking Arm Roots them for 1.5 seconds.

13.name: Poppin' Pustules
13.description: Detonating Weighted Pustule with Bio-Kill Switch within 1.5 seconds of its expiration increases its damage by 150% and applies its damage and Slow in an area. Enemy Heroes hit have a Weighted Pustule applied to them.

16.name: Superstrain
16.description: Whenever an ally with Healing Pathogen is Stunned or Rooted, they are instantly healed for 300 (+4% per level) Health.

16.name: Universal Carrier
16.description: Healing Pathogen can continually spread through Stukov, but its healing is reduced by 25%.

16.name: Pox Populi
16.description: Bio-Kill Switch no longer removes Healing Pathogen but instead sets its duration to 3 seconds.

20.name: Controlled Chaos
20.description: Flailing Swipe gains 2 additional charges, but each use only swings 1 time, at maximum range. Additionally, its cooldown is decreased to 25 seconds, and its Mana cost is reduced from 60 to 25.

20.name: Push Comes To Shove
20.description: Massive Shove Slows its target by 50% for 4 seconds upon colliding with terrain. If Massive Shove pushes a target for more than 1.25 seconds, its cooldown is reduced by 15 seconds.

20.name: Top Off
20.description: Healing Pathogen's heal over time is increased by 30% while its target is above 60% Health.

20.name: Bio-Explosion Switch
20.description: Bio-Kill Switch now also detonates Lurking Arm, dealing 230 (+4% per level) damage, applying a Weighted Pustule, and Silencing enemy Heroes inside for 2.5 seconds.

sylvanas.name: Sylvanas
sylvanas.description: An Assassin who can possess enemy minions

abilities.name: Withering Fire
abilities.description: Shoot the closest enemy up to 5 times over 1.5 seconds for 39 (+4% per level) damage, prioritizing Heroes. Cooldown is reset on getting a Takedown.

abilities.name: Shadow Dagger
abilities.description: Throw a dagger at a target enemy that deals 30 (+4% per level) damage and an additional 150 (+4% per level) damage over 2.5 seconds. Damage dealt by Sylvanas to the initial target spreads Shadow Dagger to all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Haunting Wave
abilities.description: Send forth a wave of banshees dealing 114 (+4% per level) damage to all targets. Reactivate to teleport to the banshees' location.

abilities.name: Wailing Arrow
abilities.description: Shoot an arrow that can be reactivated to deal 228 (+4% per level) damage and Silence enemies in an area for 2.5 seconds. The arrow detonates automatically if it reaches maximum range.

abilities.name: Mind Control
abilities.description: After 0.25 seconds, fire a missile that Mind Controls the first enemy Hero hit. Heroes hit are Silenced, Slowed by 30%, have 3 stacks of Black Arrows applied to them, and are forced to walk towards Sylvanas for 1.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Black Arrows
abilities.description:
Basic Attacks infect enemies with Black Arrows for 3 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. Sylvanas deals 15% more damage to enemies with 3 stacks.

Quest: Damage Heroes and Structures with 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

Reward: Upon damaging enemies 250 times, increase the damage bonus provided by Black Arrows to 50%.

Mythic Reward: Upon damaging enemies 400 times, Black Arrows now heals Sylvanas for 25% of damage dealt at 3 stacks, doubled against Heroes.

abilities.name: Possession
abilities.description: Activate to force an enemy Minion to fight for Sylvanas's team. Catapults require 3 charges. Stores up to 4 charges.

1.name: Might of the Banshee Queen
1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Withering Fire increases Sylvanas's Attack Speed and Spell Power by 5% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

1.name: Unrelenting Torment
1.description: Increase the damage of Shadow Dagger by 20% and increase its duration by 1 second.

1.name: Overwhelming Affliction
1.description: Enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows are Slowed by 15%. Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against Slowed enemy Heroes deal 1% of their maximum Health as damage.

4.name: Unstable Poison
4.description: Minions that die under the effects of Shadow Dagger or Sylvanas's Traits explode, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to nearby Minions, Mercenaries, and Summons.

4.name: Mercenary Queen
4.description:
Friendly non-Elite Mercenaries near Sylvanas deal 60% more damage. 

Sylvanas's Basic Attacks Stun and instantly apply 3 stacks of Black Arrows to neutral Mercenaries.  Sylvanas deals 30% additional damage to Mercenaries with 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

4.name: Haunting Arrows
4.description: Black Arrows can now be activated to cause all Basic Attacks and Abilities to Stun Minions and Structures for 3 seconds. Lasts for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks against Structures reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.

7.name: Barbed Shot
7.description: Hitting the same enemy with 5 shots of Withering Fire causes the 5th shot to deal 400% bonus damage.

7.name: Lost Soul
7.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes and Structures with 3 stacks of Black Arrows reduce the cooldown of Shadow Dagger by 0.75 seconds, doubled against Heroes.

7.name: Festering Wounds
7.description: Increase Haunting Wave's damage by 15%. Haunting Wave applies 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

10.name: Wailing Arrow
10.description: Shoot an arrow that can be reactivated to deal 228 (+4% per level) damage and Silence enemies in an area for 2.5 seconds. The arrow detonates automatically if it reaches maximum range.

10.name: Mind Control
10.description: After 0.25 seconds, fire a missile that Mind Controls the first enemy Hero hit. Heroes hit are Silenced, Slowed by 30%, have 3 stacks of Black Arrows applied to them, and are forced to walk towards Sylvanas for 1.75 seconds.

13.name: Cold Embrace
13.description: Shadow Dagger reduces the Armor of the initial target by 25 and any enemy it spreads to by 10 for 2.5 seconds.

13.name: Windrunner
13.description: Haunting Wave can be cast a second time for free within 4 seconds after teleporting. Teleporting with Haunting Wave resets the cooldown of Withering Fire.

13.name: Remorseless
13.description:
Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows shoot an untalented shot of Withering Fire. This shot of Withering Fire applies Black Arrows.

 Increase Sylvanas's Basic Attack range by 1.

16.name: Evasive Fire
16.description: Hitting an enemy with Withering Fire grants 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%. Basic Attacks refresh this duration.

16.name: Life Drain
16.description: Heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sylvanas to enemies with 3 stacks of Black Arrows. Healing is doubled against Heroes.

16.name: Will of the Forsaken
16.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

20.name: Deafening Blast
20.description: Enemies at the center of Wailing Arrow's explosion take 50% more damage and are Silenced for twice as long.

20.name: Dark Lady's Call
20.description: Heroes hit by Mind Control have their vision radius greatly reduced for 5 seconds. Mind Control's cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds.

20.name: Withering Barrage
20.description: Withering Fire applies Black Arrows, and Heroes hit by Withering Fire reduce its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

20.name: Bolt of the Storm
20.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.

tassadar.name: Tassadar
tassadar.description: A psychic Mage that can deliver area damage from long distances.

abilities.name: Shock Ray
abilities.description: Channel a beam of Psionic energy, dealing 280 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies in a line by 30% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Psionic Storm
abilities.description: Create a Psionic Storm at the targeted location for 3 seconds. While in a storm, enemies take 38 (+4% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds, increasing by 20% for each consecutive instance of damage, up to 100%.

abilities.name: Force Wall
abilities.description: After a 0.5 second delay, create a wall that blocks all units from moving through it for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Archon
abilities.description:
Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds.

Resonance Beam: Deals 140 (+4% per level) damage to the target and splashes 70 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Heroes hit have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 2 seconds. Resonance Beam is fully charged while Archon is active.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.description: After a 0.5 second cast, create a Black Hole that travels in a long line. Enemy Heroes within the Black Hole's area are quickly pulled towards its center. Touching the center deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns the target for 1.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Resonance Beam
abilities.description:
Tassadar's Basic Attack is a Channeled beam that Slows by 15%. While Channeling, your Basic Attack damage and Mana regeneration increases by 25% a second, to a maximum of 100%. While at full charge, gain an extra 3 Mana every second.

This bonus is lost after 6 seconds of not Channeling.

1.name: Static Charge
1.description:
Quest: Heroes hit by Shock Ray permanently increases its damage by 5 and grants 33% Resonance Beam charge. 

Maximum of 200 bonus damage.

1.name: Psi-Infusion
1.description:
Each non-Structure enemy hit by Psionic Storm restores 0.5 Mana, increased to 5 against Heroes.

Passive: Increase the cast range of Psionic Storm by 33%.

1.name: Khaydarin Amulet
1.description:
Quest: Resonance Beam charges 50% faster.

Reward: After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 80 seconds, it bounces to hit 1 additional target for 75% damage, prioritizing Heroes.

Reward: After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 160 seconds, it bounces to hit 2 additional targets for 75% damage, prioritizing Heroes.

4.name: Induction
4.description: Tassadar gains 10% increased Movement Speed. Casting Shock Ray increases this bonus to 30% for 3 seconds.

4.name: Electric Fence
4.description: Force Wall deals 92 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies and Slows them by 35%.

4.name: Plasma Shield
4.description: While Resonance Beam is fully charged, gain a Shield equal to 3% of max Health every second, stacking up to 12%.

7.name: Beam Alignment
7.description:
While Resonance Beam is fully charged, Shock Ray's cooldown refreshes 100% faster and its Slow duration is increased to 4 seconds.

Passive: Reduce the Mana cost of Shock Ray from 55 to 40.

7.name: Psionic Echo
7.description: Casting Psionic Storm causes your next Shock Ray within 3 seconds to only cost 30 Mana and create a Psionic Storm on the first enemy Hero hit.

7.name: Arc Discharge
7.description:
When Resonance Beam is fully charged, Tassadar's Basic Attack range is increased by 1 and its next instance of damage also creates a Psionic Storm on the target.

This effect has a 20 second cooldown that decays twice as fast while Resonance Beam is fully charged.

10.name: Archon
10.description:
Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds.

Resonance Beam: Deals 140 (+4% per level) damage to the target and splashes 70 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Heroes hit have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 2 seconds. Resonance Beam is fully charged while Archon is active.

10.name: Black Hole
10.description: After a 0.5 second cast, create a Black Hole that travels in a long line. Enemy Heroes within the Black Hole's area are quickly pulled towards its center. Touching the center deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns the target for 1.25 seconds.

13.name: Feedback
13.description: When an enemy Hero is affected by Psionic Storm, Resonance Beam's Slow is increased to 50% and it reduces Physical Armor by 25.

13.name: Shadow Walk
13.description:
Tassadar becomes Stealthed and Unrevealable, but cannot attack or use Abilities for 1.5 seconds. While this effect is active, gain 40% increased Movement Speed and 35 Armor.

Can be cast while Channeling Shock Ray.

13.name: Oracle
13.description:
Passive: While stationary, gain 30 Spell Armor for 0.75 seconds and restore 12 (+4% per level) Health a second.

Activate to Channel for up to 4 seconds, revealing a gradually increasing area anywhere on the map.

16.name: Thermal Lance
16.description: Shock Ray deals an additional 8% of maximum Health as damage to the first Hero it hits.

16.name: Psychic Shock
16.description: Psionic Storm deals damage 25% faster.

16.name: Executor's Will
16.description: Activate to gain full Resonance Beam charge, 20% Spell Power, and cause Basic and Heroic Ability cooldowns to regenerate 25% faster. This effect lasts as long as Resonance Beam remains at full charge.

20.name: Twilight Archon
20.description: Basic Attacks while in Archon form increase its duration by 2 seconds.

20.name: Kugelblitz
20.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Black Hole's center have their Armor reduced by 20 for 3 seconds and have a Psionic Storm created at their location.

20.name: Force Barrier
20.description: Increase the duration of Force Wall by 0.5 seconds, its cast range by 50%, and reduce its cooldown by 10 seconds.

20.name: Khala's Gift
20.description: Gain 4% Spell Power for yourself and each nearby ally Hero, up to 20% total Spell Power. Your total bonus is shared with all contributing allies.

thrall.name: Thrall
thrall.description: A Bruiser who can hold his own in a lane of battle.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: Shock an enemy with lightning, dealing 170 (+4% per level) damage. The lightning then bounces 3 times to nearby enemies, dealing 85 (+4% per level) damage to each enemy hit.

abilities.name: Feral Spirit
abilities.description: Unleash a Feral Spirit that deals 153 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in its path and Roots Heroes hit for 1 second. Each Hero hit increases the distance traveled by 25%.

abilities.name: Windfury
