abilities.description: Increase Thrall's Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds. His next 3 Basic Attacks occur 100% faster and generate stacks of Frostwolf Resilience.

abilities.name: Sundering
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290 (+4% per level) damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

abilities.name: Earthquake
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon a massive Earthquake that pulses every 4 seconds. Each pulse lasts 2 seconds, Slowing all enemies in the area by 50%, and deals 50 (+4% per level) damage to enemy Heroes. Does 3 pulses.

abilities.name: Frostwolf Resilience
abilities.description: Dealing damage with Abilities grants 1 stack of Frostwolf Resilience. At 5 stacks, Thrall is instantly healed for 240 (+4% per level) Health.

1.name: Echo of the Elements
1.description:
Quest: Kill Minions or Heroes within 2 seconds of hitting them with Chain Lightning.

Reward: After killing 20 enemies, reduce the Mana cost of Chain Lightning from 40 to 20.

Reward: After killing 50 enemies, Chain Lightning gains an extra charge.

Mythic Reward: After killing 125 enemies, Chain Lightning can now strike the same target multiple times, and also strikes 1 additional target per bounce.

1.name: Crash Lightning
1.description:
Quest: Hit at least 2 Heroes with a single use of Chain Lightning. Upon dying, lose 4 stacks. Gained rewards cannot be lost.

Reward: After hitting multiple Heroes 15 times, Chain Lightning deals 270 additional damage on its bounces after the initial strike.

Mythic Reward: After hitting multiple Heroes 30 times, Chain Lightning deals 325 additional damage on its bounces, and prioritizes bouncing to enemy Heroes.

1.name: Maelstrom Weapon
1.description:
Quest: Basic Attack Heroes while Windfury's Movement Speed bonus is active.

Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, increase the Movement Speed bonus of Windfury to 40% and Thrall's Basic Attacks deal 40 additional damage.

Reward: After hitting 55 Heroes, Thrall permanently gains 15% increased Movement Speed and his Basic Attacks gain an additional 75 damage.

Mythic Reward: After hitting 100 Heroes, Frostwolf Resilience healing restores 200% more Health.

4.name: Feral Resilience
4.description:
Heroes damaged by Feral Spirit grant 4 stacks of Frostwolf Resilience and 2 stacks of Feral Resilience, granting 75 Physical Armor against the next incoming Hero Basic Attack.

Stacks are consumed on the next cast of Feral Spirit.

4.name: Frostwolf Pack
4.description:
Quest: Hit 6 Heroes with Feral Spirit. Progress is lost on death and when Thrall fails to hit a Hero.

Reward: Reduce the cooldown and Mana cost of Feral Spirit by 50%.

4.name: Mana Tide
4.description: Frostwolf Resilience restores 15 Mana and reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

7.name: Rolling Thunder
7.description:
Passive: Chain Lightning bounces an additional time.

For 8 seconds after hitting an enemy with Chain Lightning, Thrall's next Basic Attack against them grants a stack of Frostwolf Resilience. If the target is an enemy Hero, then he also deals damage to them equal to 3% of their maximum Health and healing for the same amount.

7.name: Ancestral Wrath
7.description:
Activate to consume 8 stacks of Ancestral Wrath, damaging a target enemy Hero for 15% of their maximum Health over 3 seconds, and healing Thrall for 150% of the damage dealt.

Gain 1 stack of Ancestral Wrath every time Frostwolf Resilience activates.

7.name: Elemental Assault
7.description: After using an Ability, Thrall's next Basic Attack within 4 seconds deals 45% more damage.

10.name: Sundering
10.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290 (+4% per level) damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

10.name: Earthquake
10.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon a massive Earthquake that pulses every 4 seconds. Each pulse lasts 2 seconds, Slowing all enemies in the area by 50%, and deals 50 (+4% per level) damage to enemy Heroes. Does 3 pulses.

13.name: Grace Of Air
13.description: Windfury attacks grant twice as many stacks of Frostwolf Resilience.

13.name: Frostwolf's Grace
13.description: Frostwolf Resilience can be activated to instantly heal. This healing is increased by up to 100% based on Thrall's missing health.

13.name: Spirit Shield
13.description:
Every 45 seconds, gain 70 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 4 seconds. Frostwolf Resilience reduces this cooldown by 10 seconds.

Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

16.name: Tempest Fury
16.description: The final strike of Windfury hits 3 times for 75% normal damage. These hits do not provide quest progress.

16.name: Thunderstorm
16.description:
Chain Lightning Slows the primary target by 8% for 2 seconds when used on Heroes.

Quest: Targeting a Hero directly with Chain Lightning increases this Slow by 8%, up to an additional 40%.

Reward: While at a 40% bonus, Chain Lightning's damage is increased by 30%.

Bonuses are reset if Chain Lightning is used on the same Hero it was last used on, or if Thrall dies.

16.name: Alpha Wolf
16.description:
For 3 seconds after a Hero is hit by Feral Spirit, Thrall's Basic Attacks against them deal an additional 3% of the target's maximum Health as damage.

Passive: Increase the duration of Feral Spirit's Root to 1.5 seconds.

20.name: Worldbreaker
20.description: Lower the cooldown of Sundering by 40 seconds. After Sundering impacts, it leaves behind an impassable rift, blocking unit movement for 3 seconds.

20.name: Earthen Shields
20.description: Allies within the Earthquake area gain a Shield equal to 15% of their maximum Health each pulse. This shield lasts 4 seconds.

20.name: Elemental Momentum
20.description: Basic Attacks reduce Thrall's Basic and Heroic Ability cooldowns by 0.25 seconds, tripled against Heroes.

20.name: Nexus Blades
20.description: Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage and Slow enemy Movement Speed by 20% for 1 second.

20.name: Wind Rush
20.description: Activate to immediately teleport to a target location and gain Windfury.

gazlowe.name: Gazlowe
gazlowe.description: A Summoner that specializes in controlling key areas of the battleground.

abilities.name: Rock-It! Turret
abilities.description:
Create a turret that deals 43 (+4% per level) damage. Loses Health over 20 seconds. 

Turrets prioritize the nearest enemy Hero when first created.

abilities.name: Deth Lazor
abilities.description: After 0.65 seconds, deal 175 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line. Heal for 25% of the damage dealt, increased to 75% against enemy Heroes.

abilities.name: Xplodium Charge
abilities.description: Place a bomb that deals 142 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within the target area after 1.25 seconds. Enemies hit are also Stunned for 1 second.

abilities.name: Robo-Goblin
abilities.description:
Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds. 

Passive: Basic Attacks deal 100 (+4% per level) bonus damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

abilities.name: Grav-O-Bomb 3000
abilities.description: After a 1.5 second delay, pull enemies toward the center of an area, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Basic Abilities deal 30% more damage for 5 seconds after casting Grav-O-Bomb 3000.

abilities.name: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
abilities.description:
Regenerate 1 Scrap every 4 seconds. Destroyed Rock-It! Turrets drop 1 Scrap, which can be picked up.

Activate to destroy a target Rock-It! Turret.

abilities.name: Focus Turrets!
abilities.description: Orders any nearby Rock-It! Turrets to focus the target.

1.name: Rocket Boots
1.description: Increase the cast range of Xplodium Charge by 30% and its damage by 35%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

1.name: Big Game Hunter
1.description: Increase maximum Scrap by 2. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes, Mercenaries, or Monsters accelerates Reduce, Reuse, Recycle Scrap regeneration by 1.5 seconds.

1.name: One Man Wrecking Crew
1.description: Casting Basic Abilities cause Gazlowe's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds to deal 75% more damage. Stores up to 2 charges.

4.name: Rock It Sock It
4.description: Casting Rock-It! Turret grants Gazlowe a Shield that absorbs up to 200 (+4% per level) damage for 2.5 seconds.

4.name: Hyperfocus Coils
4.description: Heroes hit by Deth Lazor or Xplodium Charge take an additional 2% of their maximum Health in damage. Gazlowe is healed for 150% of the damage dealt.

4.name: EZ-PZ Dimensional Ripper
4.description: Activate to gain 40 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 40%, and reduce damage dealt by all nearby enemy Heroes and Summons by 50% for 3 seconds

7.name: Goblin Fusion
7.description: Generate 3 Scrap for each Hero hit by Deth Lazor.

7.name: Overload
7.description: Deth Lazor can now store up to 2 charges. Each enemy Hero hit by Deth Lazor reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

7.name: Master Blaster
7.description: Deth Lazor and Xplodium Charge Slow enemies hit by 35% for 3 seconds. Rock-It! Turret Basic Attacks against enemies Slowed in this way extend the Slow duration by 0.5 seconds.

10.name: Robo-Goblin
10.description:
Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds. 

Passive: Basic Attacks deal 100 (+4% per level) bonus damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

10.name: Grav-O-Bomb 3000
10.description: After a 1.5 second delay, pull enemies toward the center of an area, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Basic Abilities deal 30% more damage for 5 seconds after casting Grav-O-Bomb 3000.

13.name: Positive Reinforcement
13.description: Primary Rock-It! Turret attacks against Heroes increase Gazlowe's Attack Speed by 40% for 3 seconds.

13.name: Superior Schematics
13.description: Rock-It! Turrets attack up to 2 additional enemies for 60% damage and have 30% increased Basic Attack range.

13.name: Overcharged Capacitors
13.description: Gazlowe gains 5% Spell Power for each active Rock-It! Turret, up to a maximum of 15%. Dealing Basic Attack damage heals Rock-It! Turrets by 8% of their max health.

16.name: Firin' Mah Lazorz
16.description: Firing Deth Lazor causes all of Gazlowe's Rock-It! Turrets to fire a Deth Lazor of their own that deals 125 (+4% per level) damage.

16.name: Ark Reaktor
16.description:
Reduce the cooldown of Xplodium Charge by 2 seconds. Casting Xplodium Charge creates 3 miniature Rock-It! Turrets that last for 3 seconds.

These Turrets do not drop Scrap or benefit from other Talents.

16.name: Overklock
16.description:
Basic Attacks grant Gazlowe 15% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

Dealing Basic Attack damage to Heroes causes them to take an additional 2.5% of their maximum Health as damage.

20.name: Mecha-Lord
20.description: Basic Attacks increase Gazlowe's Armor by 10 for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 30, and deal 50% bonus damage to Stunned or Slowed enemies.

20.name: Miniature Black Hole
20.description: Increase Grav-O-Bomb 3000's radius by 25% and its damage by 50%. Each enemy Hero pulled reduces its cooldown by 12 seconds.

20.name: It's Raining Scrap
20.description: Reduce the Scrap cost of Rock-It! Turrets by 1. Regain 2 Scrap for each Scrap pickup.

20.name: Bomb Toss
20.description: Xplodium Charge gains a 2nd charge with a 3 second cooldown between uses and launches 2 more bombs when it detonates.

tracer.name: Tracer
tracer.description: A mobile Assassin who picks off straggling enemies, finishing them off.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.description:
Dash towards an area.

Stores up to 3 charges.

abilities.name: Melee
abilities.description: Deal 220 (+4% per level) damage to a nearby enemy, prioritizing Heroes. Gain 5% Pulse Bomb charge when using Melee against an enemy, and 10% against Heroes.

abilities.name: Recall
abilities.description: After 1.25 seconds, Tracer returns to the position she was at 2 seconds prior to casting, refilling her ammo, and removing all negative status effects from herself.

abilities.name: Pulse Bomb
abilities.description:
Fire a short range bomb that can attach to an enemy if it hits them. The bomb explodes after 2 seconds dealing 298 (+6% per level) damage to them and 149 (+6% per level) damage to other nearby enemies.

This ability is slowly charged over time by dealing damage to enemies with Basic Attacks and Melee.

abilities.name: Reload
abilities.description:
Tracer can Basic Attack while moving, and after attacking 10 times she needs to reload over 0.75 seconds. Tracer can manually reload early by activating Reload.

Basic Attacks heal Tracer for 10% of the damage dealt.

1.name: One-Two Punch
1.description: Reduce the cooldown of Melee by 1 second and it gains an additional charge.

1.name: Parting Gift
1.description: Recall leaves behind 6 bombs that deal 240 (+4% per level) damage each to different targets. Heroes hit with these bombs are Slowed by 50% for 0.75 seconds and grant 7% Pulse Bomb charge.

1.name: Tracer Rounds
1.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 10%. Basic Attacks against Heroes reveal a small area around them for 3 seconds.

4.name: Leeching Rounds
4.description: Increase the healing from Basic Attacks by up to 200%, based on the amount of health Tracer is missing.

4.name: Pulse Generator
4.description: Successfully sticking a Pulse Bomb to an enemy Hero heals Tracer for 12% of her maximum Health over 1.5 seconds and refunds a charge of Blink.

4.name: Is That a Health Pack?!
4.description:
Collecting a Regeneration Globe instantly heals Tracer for 15% of her maximum Health and reduces the cooldown of Healing Fountain by 15 seconds.

Drinking from a Healing Fountain instantly heals for 20% of Tracer's maximum Health.

7.name: Sleight of Hand
7.description: Reduces Reload time by 50%. This equals 20% more damage per second.

7.name: Focus Fire
7.description: If an entire ammo magazine is unloaded on an enemy within 2 seconds, the last bullet will deal 80 (+4% per level) bonus damage. This is equal to 35% of the total magazine.

7.name: Locked and Loaded
7.description: Reactivate Reload within the last 50% of its cast time to increase Tracer's Basic Attack damage by 40% for that magazine.

10.name: Sticky Bomb
10.description: Increases Pulse Bomb's radius by 50% and enemies hit are Slowed by 70% for 3 seconds.

10.name: Quantum Spike
10.description: Pulse Bomb deals an additional 6% of maximum Health as damage to Heroes.

10.name: Pulse Rounds
10.description: Increases Pulse Bomb's range and charge rate from Basic Attacks against Heroes by 100%.

13.name: Untouchable
13.description:
Passive: After Blinking, gain 20% Movement Speed for 1.25 seconds.

Quest: Takedowns increase Tracer's Basic Attack damage by 5%, up to 25%. These bonuses are lost on death.

13.name: Jumper
13.description:
Passive: When Blink has no charges remaining, its cooldown refreshes 100% faster.

Casting Blink grants Tracer a Shield equal to 6% of her maximum Health for 3 seconds. This Shield stacks up to 3 times.

13.name: Telefrag
13.description:
Passive: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Recall by 0.1875 seconds.

When Tracer arrives at her Recall location she becomes Unkillable for 1 second and nearby enemies take 175 (+4% per level) damage and are knocked back.

16.name: Bullet Spray
16.description: Increases the radius of Melee by 30%, and causes it to damage all enemies in range.

16.name: Heavy Handed
16.description: Heroes hit by Melee have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.

16.name: Ricochet
16.description: Tracer's Basic Attacks have a 60% chance to hit another nearby enemy, prioritizing Heroes.

20.name: Chrono Triggers
20.description: Casting Blink causes Basic Attacks to not consume ammo for 1 second.

20.name: Get Stuffed!
20.description: Increases Melee's Pulse Bomb charge against Heroes from 10% to 20%. Hitting an enemy with Melee who is stuck with a Pulse Bomb causes the bomb to instantly explode and knock the target away.

20.name: Total Recall
20.description: Recall heals Tracer equal to the amount of Health she lost during that time.

20.name: Composition B
20.description: Successfully sticking a Pulse Bomb to an enemy Hero also drops another one at their feet that deals 50% damage and explodes slightly earlier.

tychus.name: Tychus
tychus.description: An Assassin who shreds High Health enemies.

abilities.name: Overkill
abilities.description: Deal 552 (+4% per level) damage to the target and 276 (+4% per level) damage to nearby targets over 4 seconds. Reactivate to select a new target or direction. Can move and use Abilities while Channeling.

abilities.name: Frag Grenade
abilities.description: Lob a grenade that deals 256 (+4% per level) damage, knocking enemies away.

abilities.name: Run and Gun
abilities.description: Dash a short distance.

abilities.name: Drakken Laser Drill
abilities.description: Call down a Laser Drill to attack nearby enemies, dealing 142 (+4% per level) damage every second. Reactivate to assign a new target. Loses Health over 25 seconds.

abilities.name: Commandeer Odin
abilities.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

abilities.name: Minigun
abilities.description: Activate to have Basic Attacks against Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 2.5% of their maximum Health. Lasts 3 seconds.

1.name: Quarterback
1.description: Increases Frag Grenade's damage by 10% and its range by 45%.

1.name: Dash
1.description: Increase the range of Run and Gun by 50%. When cast, increase Tychus's Movement Speed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

1.name: Press the Advantage
1.description: Increase Tychus's Basic Attack range by 1.

4.name: In the Rhythm
4.description: Quest: While Minigun is active, Basic Attacks against Heroes permanently increase future Minigun durations by 0.03 seconds.

4.name: The Bigger They Are...
4.description: Increase the damage bonus to 4% while enemy Heroes are above 30% Health, but Minigun no longer has any effect on targets below 30%.

4.name: Master Assassin
4.description:
Passive: Increase Tychus's Attack Speed by 10%. 

Reward: After getting 15 Takedowns, Tychus's Attack Speed is increased by an additional 15%.

7.name: Melting Point
7.description: Enemies hit by Frag Grenade take an additional 75 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% against Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

7.name: Combat Tactician
7.description: Reduce the cooldown of Minigun by 4 seconds. Reduce the cooldown of Minigun by an additional 4 seconds after using Run and Gun.

7.name: Relentless Soldier
7.description: Being Stunned or Rooted grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 30%.

10.name: Commandeer Odin
10.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

10.name: Drakken Laser Drill
10.description: Call down a Laser Drill to attack nearby enemies, dealing 142 (+4% per level) damage every second. Reactivate to assign a new target. Loses Health over 25 seconds.

13.name: Spray 'n' Pray
13.description: Overkill Slows enemy Movement Speed by 25% and its range is increased by 25%.

13.name: That's the Stuff!
13.description: Minigun heals Tychus for 100% of the bonus damage dealt after it expires.

13.name: Neosteel Coating
13.description: Activate to gain 75 Spell Armor for 4 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.

16.name: Armor Piercing Rounds
16.description: Each time Overkill hits an enemy, its damage against them is increased by 15%, stacking up to 60% bonus damage.

16.name: Titan Grenade
16.description: Frag Grenade deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 5% of their maximum Health. Each enemy Hero hit by Frag Grenade reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

16.name: Sizzlin' Attacks
16.description: Basic Attacks deal bonus damage to Heroes equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Stacks with Minigun.

20.name: Big Red Button
20.description: Odin lasts 50% longer and Ragnarok Missiles also launches a Nuclear Missile which lands 2.5 seconds later, dealing 319 (+4% per level) damage in its area.

20.name: Focusing Diodes
20.description: Increases the range of the Drakken Laser Drill by 50%. Deals increasing damage the longer it remains on a single target, up to 100% additional damage.

20.name: Can Do This All Day
20.description: Reduce Overkill's cooldown by 5 seconds. While Channeling Overkill, Tychus gains 40 Armor.

20.name: Bob and Weave
20.description: Run and Gun and Odin's Thrusters gain 2 additional charges and reduces Run and Gun's Mana cost from 50 to 25. After using Run and Gun, increase Tychus's Basic Attack range by 1.5 for 4 seconds.

tyrael.name: Tyrael
tyrael.description: A Tank who pairs well with allies that like to dive into the enemy team.

abilities.name: El'druin's Might
abilities.description: Throw El'druin to the target area, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 30% for 2.5 seconds. It can be reactivated within 5 seconds to teleport Tyrael to El'druin and Slow nearby enemies again.

abilities.name: Righteousness
abilities.description: Shields Tyrael for 350 (+4% per level) damage and nearby allied Heroes and Minions for 40% as much for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Smite
abilities.description: Rake target area, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage. For the next 3 seconds, allies moving through the targeted area gain 25% increased Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Judgment
abilities.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge an enemy Hero, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds. Nearby enemies are knocked away and take 75 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Sanctification
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds create a field of holy energy that makes allied Heroes Invulnerable. Lasts 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Archangel's Wrath
abilities.description:
Upon dying, become Invulnerable and gain 20% Movement Speed for 4 seconds. Upon expiration, explode, dealing 450 (+4% per level) damage and reducing Tyrael's death timer by 10% per enemy Hero hit.

Archangel's Wrath reduces nearby enemy Heroes' damage by 50% while active and for 3 seconds when it expires.

1.name: Salvation
1.description: Increase the Shield amount Tyrael gains from Righteousness by 35% and heal Tyrael for 150 (+4% per level) Health if his Shield is destroyed. Does not increase the Shield amount gained by allies.

1.name: Justice for All
1.description: Increase the Shield applied to allies by Righteousness to 80% of the Shield gained by Tyrael.

1.name: Ardent Restoration
1.description:
Dealing damage to a Hero heals Tyrael for 20 (+4% per level) Health over 5 seconds. Dealing damage resets this timer, and the heal amount stacks up to 8 times.

Quest: Every Regeneration Globe gathered increases this heal amount by 1%.

4.name: Stalwart Angel
4.description: Gain 25 Armor while El'druin's Might is active, and for 3 seconds after teleporting.

4.name: Reciprocate
4.description:
When Tyrael's Shield from Righteousness expires or is destroyed, it deals 170 (+4% per level) damage to nearby Heroes and Summons.

For each enemy Hero damaged by Reciprocate or El'Druin's Might, Tyrael heals for 3% of his maximum Health.

4.name: Divine Vigor
4.description: If Smite hits an enemy, Tyrael's Basic Attacks within the next 4 seconds heal for 70% of the damage dealt.

7.name: Burning Halo
7.description: Both Tyrael and El'druin deal 12 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Teleporting increases this damage from Tyrael by 125% for 2 seconds.

7.name: Purge Evil
7.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Smite increases Tyrael's Basic Attack damage by 60% for 4 seconds.

7.name: Swift Retribution
7.description: Smite grants 20% more Movement Speed and also grants 25% Attack Speed for 2 seconds.

10.name: Judgment
10.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge an enemy Hero, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds. Nearby enemies are knocked away and take 75 (+4% per level) damage.

10.name: Sanctification
10.description: After 0.5 seconds create a field of holy energy that makes allied Heroes Invulnerable. Lasts 3 seconds.

13.name: Sword of Justice
13.description: Upon teleporting using El'druin's Might, El'druin swaps places with Tyrael, and El'druin's Might can be reactivated to teleport an additional time.

13.name: Holy Ground
13.description: Create a ring for 3 seconds that blocks enemies from entering the area teleported to using El'druin's Might.

13.name: Law and Order
13.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Smite reduces the cooldown of Righteousness by 1 second. Each allied Hero Shielded by Righteousness increases the damage of the next Smite by 35%.

16.name: Bound by Law
16.description: El'Druin's Might's Slow is increased to 65% for 1 second, decaying to 30% over the remaining duration.

16.name: Horadric Reforging
16.description: Tyrael's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of El'druin's Might by 2 seconds.

16.name: Smite the Wicked
16.description: While El'druin's Might is active, and for 2 seconds after teleporting, Smite's cooldown recharges 125% faster.

20.name: Angel of Justice
20.description: Increases the cast range of Judgment by 50%, and reduces the cooldown by 40 seconds.

20.name: Holy Arena
20.description: Increase the duration of Sanctification by 1 second and increase the damage of allies inside by 25%.

20.name: Seal of El'druin
20.description: Using a Basic Ability grants 50% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

20.name: Defense of the Angels
20.description:
Activate to gain 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

Each time Tyrael damages an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack or Basic Ability, increase the duration of this Armor bonus by 0.5 seconds.

20.name: Aspect of Justice
20.description: After 1.25 seconds, gain the effects of Archangel's Wrath without dying. Cooldown is reduced by 15% for each enemy Hero hit by the explosion.

tyrande.name: Tyrande
tyrande.description: A Healer who helps her allies lockdown and finish off enemies.

abilities.name: Light of Elune
abilities.description:
Heal an ally Hero for 270 (+4% per level). Light of Elune's cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds every time Tyrande hits an enemy with a Basic Attack or damages an enemy Hero.

Stores up to 2 charges. Cooldown replenishes all charges at the same time.

abilities.name: Sentinel
abilities.description: Send an Owl across the battleground revealing its path, dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage to the first Hero hit, and revealing them for 5 seconds. If a Hero revealed by Sentinel dies, refresh its cooldown.

abilities.name: Lunar Flare
abilities.description:
After 0.75 seconds, deal 150 (+4% per level) damage and Stun enemies in the target area for 0.75 seconds. Restores 25 Mana per enemy hit.

Quest: Hitting a Hero with Lunar Flare increases its damage by 3%, up to 120%. Double this bonus if the Hero dies within 3 seconds.

Reward: After hitting 10 Heroes, increase Lunar Flare's range by 30%.

Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, Sentinel now pierces the first Hero hit.

Mythic Reward: After hitting 40 Heroes, Every 8th Basic Attacks fires a Lunar Flare, prioritizing Heroes. Attack Range increased by 1.

abilities.name: Shadowstalk
abilities.description: Grant all allied Heroes Stealth for 10 seconds and heal them for 380 (+4% per level) Health over 10 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

abilities.name: Starfall
abilities.description: Deal 92 (+4% per level) damage per second and Slow enemies by 20% in an area. Lasts 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Hunter's Mark
abilities.description:
Reveal a non-Structure enemy and reduce their Armor by 15 for 4 seconds.

Passive: Tyrande's Basic Attacks heal her for 1% of her maximum Health, doubled against targets with Hunter's Mark.

1.name: Ranger
1.description: Sentinel width is increased by 25% and deals up to 250% more damage based on distance traveled.

1.name: Moonlit Arrows
1.description: Basic Attacks decrease the cooldown of Light of Elune by an additional 0.5 seconds.

1.name: Trueshot Aura
1.description: Activate to grant Tyrande and nearby allied Heroes 40% increased Attack Damage for 5 seconds, and to reset the cooldown of Hunter's Mark.

4.name: Everlasting Light
4.description: If Light of Elune's second charge is cast on a different target from the first, it heals for 80% more.

4.name: Mark of Mending
4.description: Tyrande's Basic Attacks against Marked targets heal other allied Heroes near the enemy for 4% of their maximum Health.

4.name: Elune's Chosen
4.description: Activate to make Tyrande's Basic Attacks heal target allied Hero for 175% of the damage dealt. Lasts for 8 seconds.

7.name: Elune's Gift
7.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Lunar Flare grants 20% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

7.name: Kaldorei Resistance
7.description: Light of Elune grants the target 10 Spell Armor for 2 seconds. This effect stacks up to 2 times.

7.name: Huntress' Fury
7.description:
Tyrande's Basic Attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark bounce to nearby enemy Heroes.

Passive: Increase Hunter's Mark duration by 1 second, and its cast range by 25%.

10.name: Shadowstalk
10.description: Grant all allied Heroes Stealth for 10 seconds and heal them for 380 (+4% per level) Health over 10 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

10.name: Starfall
10.description: Deal 92 (+4% per level) damage per second and Slow enemies by 20% in an area. Lasts 6 seconds.

13.name: Quickening Blessing
13.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Light of Elune increases the target's Movement Speed by 25% for 3 seconds.

13.name: Harsh Moonlight
13.description: Sentinel Slows enemies hit by 35% and reduces their damage dealt by 35% for 3 seconds.

13.name: Ranger's Mark
13.description: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Hunter's Mark by 2 second. Basic Attacks against marked targets reduce the cooldown of Lunar Flare by 4 seconds.

16.name: Celestial Attunement
16.description: Light of Elune removes Stuns, Silences, and Slows from its target.

16.name: Empower
16.description: Reduce Sentinel's cooldown by 3 seconds. Heroes hit by Sentinel takes bonus damage equal to 6% of their maximum Health.

16.name: Darnassian Archery
16.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant a stacking 12% increased Attack Damage bonus for 4 seconds.

20.name: Eyes of the Huntress
20.description: Shadowstalk reveals all enemy Heroes for 10 seconds and heals for 100% more.

20.name: Celestial Wrath
20.description: Increase the Slow of Starfall to 60% and cause it to apply Hunter's Mark to enemy Heroes while inside of its area of effect.

20.name: Commander of Sentinels
20.description: Sentinel gains a 2nd charge.

20.name: Iceblade Arrows
20.description: Increase Attack Speed by 20%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce their damage dealt by 8% for 2 seconds. This effect stacks up to 5 times.

uther.name: Uther
uther.description: A Healer that can negate high bursts of damage.

abilities.name: Holy Light
abilities.description: Heal target allied Hero for 362 (+4% per level) Health. When used on a target other than Uther, also heal Uther for 181 (+4% per level) Health.

abilities.name: Holy Radiance
abilities.description: Heal all allied Heroes and Minions in a line for 194 (+4% per level) Health, dealing 177 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Hammer of Justice
abilities.description: Deal 109 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the target for 1 second.

abilities.name: Divine Shield
abilities.description: Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Divine Storm
abilities.description: Deal 170 (+4% per level) damage and Stun nearby enemies for 1.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Devotion
abilities.description:
Uther's Basic Abilities grant 25 Armor to allied Heroes, and 15 to Uther, for 2 seconds.

Eternal Vanguard

Upon dying, Uther becomes an Invulnerable spirit for up to 8 seconds. While in spirit form, Uther can heal allies with Flash of Light for 230 (+4% per level).

1.name: Silver Touch
1.description:
Quest: Reduce damage from Heroic sources with Devotion.

Reward: After reducing damage 40 times, Holy Light's Mana cost is reduced from 80 to 60.

Reward: After reducing damage 80 times, Holy Light's Mana cost is reduced to 40, and its range is increased by 50%.

1.name: Wave of Light
1.description:
Quest: Damage or heal Heroes 60 times with Holy Radiance.

Reward: Increase the duration of Devotion by 0.5 seconds.

Passive: Damaging or healing Heroes with Holy Radiance refunds 5 Mana and reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

1.name: Hammer of the Lightbringer
1.description:
Quest: Basic Attack enemies 75 times.

Reward: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Hammer of Justice by 1.5 seconds.

Passive: Basic Attacks restore 1.5% of Uther's maximum Mana.

4.name: Holy Shock
4.description: Activate to deal 145 (+4% per level) damage to the target enemy, and gain the self-healing benefits of Holy Light. Shares a cooldown with Holy Light.

4.name: Pursuit of Justice
4.description: Hammer of Justice increases Uther's Movement Speed by 25% for 3 seconds.

4.name: Holy Fire
4.description: Deal 13 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase this damage by 20% for 3 seconds. This can stack up to 3 times.

7.name: Armor of Faith
7.description: Being Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants Uther 90 Mana and causes Holy Light's cooldown to recharge 200% faster for 6 seconds. This effect has a 20 second cooldown.

7.name: Guardian of Ancient Kings
7.description: Healing a Hero with a Basic Ability that is Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants them 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

7.name: Hand of Protection
7.description: Activate to make target ally Unstoppable for 1 second. Cannot be cast on Uther. Basic Attacks reduce Hand of Protection's cooldown by 5 seconds.

10.name: Divine Shield
10.description: Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

10.name: Divine Storm
10.description: Deal 170 (+4% per level) damage and Stun nearby enemies for 1.75 seconds.

13.name: Blessed Champion
13.description: For the next 5 seconds after using Holy Light, Uther's Basic Attacks heal him and nearby allied Heroes for 15% of the total amount healed by Holy Light.

13.name: Well Met
13.description: When used against Heroes, Hammer of Justice reduces the target's Movement Speed and damage dealt by 25% for 3 seconds.

13.name: Spell Shield
13.description:
Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

16.name: Beacon of Light
16.description: Uther receives 125% bonus self-healing when targeting others with Holy Light. This bonus is increased to 250% while he is below 50% Health.

16.name: Tyr's Deliverance
16.description: Increase the damage and healing of Holy Radiance by 10%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes cause Uther's next cast of Holy Radiance to have its damage and healing increased by an additional 10%, stacking up to 7 times.

16.name: Benediction
16.description: Activate to reduce the Mana cost of Uther's next Basic Ability by 50 and its cooldown by 10 seconds.

20.name: Bulwark of Light
20.description: Divine Shield is also applied to all nearby allied Heroes and lasts 1 second longer.

20.name: Divine Hurricane
20.description: Divine Storm's radius is increased by 50% and its cooldown is reduced by 40 seconds.

20.name: Redemption
20.description:
After Eternal Vanguard ends, Uther revives at the spirit's location with 50% of his maximum Health.

This effect has a 180 second cooldown.

20.name: Divine Protection
20.description: Increase Devotion Armor to 50 and its duration by 0.5 seconds.

valeera.name: Valeera
valeera.description: A stealthed Assassin who specializes in shutting down her opponents.

abilities.name: Sinister Strike
abilities.description:
Dash forward, hitting all enemies in a line for 110 (+4% per level) damage. If Sinister Strike hits a Hero, Valeera stops dashing immediately and the cooldown is reduced to 1 second.

Awards 1 Combo Point.

Stealth: Ambush
Heavily damage an enemy and reduce their Armor.

abilities.name: Blade Flurry
abilities.description:
Deal 130 (+4% per level) damage in an area around Valeera. 

Awards 1 Combo Point per enemy Hero hit.

Stealth: Cheap Shot
Stun, Blind, and damage an enemy.

abilities.name: Eviscerate
abilities.description:
Eviscerate an enemy, dealing damage per Combo Point. 

1 Point: 85 (+4% per level)
2 Points: 170 (+4% per level)
3 Points: 255 (+4% per level)

Stealth: Garrote
Silence and damage an enemy over time.

abilities.name: Cloak of Shadows
abilities.description:
Valeera is enveloped in a Cloak of Shadows, which immediately removes all damage over time effects from her. For 1.5 seconds, she becomes Unstoppable and gains 75 Spell Armor, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.

Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.description:
Create a cloud of smoke. While in the smoke, Valeera is Unrevealable, can pass through other units, and gains 60 Armor, reducing damage taken by 60%. Valeera can continue to attack and use abilities without being revealed. Lasts 5 seconds.

Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.description:
Vanish from sight, becoming Stealthed, gaining 20% Movement Speed and access to new Abilities. For the first second, Valeera is Unrevealable and can pass through other units. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

After being Stealthed for 3 seconds, the cast range of Ambush, Cheap Shot, and Garrote is increased from 2.5 to 5, and they cause Valeera to teleport to the target when used.

1.name: Vigor
1.description:
Valeera regenerates an additional 3 Energy per second.

Reward: After Gathering 20 Regen Globes, increase Valeera's maximum Energy to 120.

1.name: Subtlety
1.description: After teleporting with Ambush, Cheap Shot, or Garrote, regenerate 10 Energy per second for 5 seconds.

1.name: Combat Readiness
1.description: Each Combo Point spent grants 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing its damage by 75%. Stores up to 3 charges.

1.name: Crippling Poison
1.description:
Activate to make Valeera's next damaging Ability and subsequent Abilities within 4 seconds Slow targets by 20% for 4 seconds.

Activating Crippling Poison does not break Stealth.

4.name: Relentless Strikes
4.description: Reduces the Energy cost of Sinister Strike by 10.

4.name: Hemorrhage
4.description: Valeera's Basic Attacks deal 40% additional damage to enemies affected by Garrote.

4.name: Initiative
4.description: Ambush, Cheap Shot, and Garrote grant 15% Movement Speed for 3 seconds and award 2 Combo Points.

4.name: Wound Poison
4.description:
Activate to make Valeera's next damaging Ability and subsequent Abilities within 4 seconds reduce enemy healing received by 50% for 4 seconds.

Activating Wound Poison does not break Stealth.

7.name: Mutilate
7.description: Sinister Strike now hits with both blades, dealing 125% additional damage, but its range is reduced by 1.

7.name: Fatal Finesse
7.description:
Quest: Each time Blade Flurry damages an enemy Hero, its damage increases by 6, up to 90.

Reward: After damaging 15 Heroes with Blade Flurry, permanently reduce its Energy cost by 20.

7.name: Slice and Dice
7.description:
Eviscerating an enemy with 3 Combo Points grants 400% Attack Speed. Lasts 3 seconds or 3 Basic Attacks.

Passive: Basic Attacks restore 2 Energy.

10.name: Smoke Bomb
10.description:
Create a cloud of smoke. While in the smoke, Valeera is Unrevealable, can pass through other units, and gains 60 Armor, reducing damage taken by 60%. Valeera can continue to attack and use abilities without being revealed. Lasts 5 seconds.

Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

10.name: Cloak of Shadows
10.description:
Valeera is enveloped in a Cloak of Shadows, which immediately removes all damage over time effects from her. For 1.5 seconds, she becomes Unstoppable and gains 75 Spell Armor, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.

Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

13.name: Death From Above
13.description: Teleporting with Ambush reduces the cooldown of Vanish by 4 seconds.

13.name: Blind
13.description: Increase the duration of Cheap Shot's Blind by 2.5 seconds.

13.name: Strangle
13.description: Using Garrote on a Hero reduces their Spell Power by 40% for 6 seconds.

16.name: Seal Fate
16.description: Sinister Strike deals 50% additional damage and generates an additional Combo Point when used against Silenced, Rooted, or Stunned enemy Heroes.

16.name: Assassinate
16.description: Ambush deals 50% additional damage and reduces the target's Armor by an additional 10 if no other enemy Heroes are within 4 range of the victim.

16.name: Thistle Tea
16.description:
Activate to instantly restore 100 Energy.

Activating Thistle Tea does not break Stealth.

20.name: Adrenaline Rush
20.description: While in the Smoke Bomb, Valeera regenerates an additional 40 Energy per second.

20.name: Enveloping Shadows
20.description: Whenever Valeera uses Vanish, she also gains Cloak of Shadows.

20.name: Rupture
20.description: Increase Garrote's damage over time by 100%. Valeera's Basic Attacks refresh the duration of Garrote.

20.name: Elusiveness
20.description: Increases Valeera's Movement Speed while Vanished by an additional 20%.

varian.name: Varian
varian.description: A Bruiser that can flex into dealing damage or protecting his team.

abilities.name: Lion's Fang
abilities.description: Create a shockwave that travels in a straight line, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Each enemy hit heals Varian for 35 (+4% per level), increased to 140 (+4% per level) against Heroes.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.description:
Parry all incoming Basic Attacks for 1.25 seconds, reducing their damage by 100%.

Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Charge to the target enemy, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing them by 75% for 1 second.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description:
Silence a target Hero and force them to attack Varian for 1.25 seconds.

Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration increased by 40%.

abilities.name: Colossus Smash
abilities.description:
Smash a target enemy, dealing 185 (+4% per level) damage and lowering their Armor by 25 for 3 seconds, causing them to take 25% increased damage.

Passive: Base Attack Damage increased by 100%.
Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration reduced by 10%.

abilities.name: Twin Blades of Fury
abilities.description:
Basic Attacks reduce Heroic Strike's cooldown by an additional 7 seconds, and increase Varian's Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.

Passive: Attack Speed increased by 100%.
Passive: Base Attack Damage reduced by 25%.

abilities.name: Heroic Strike
abilities.description: Every 18 seconds, Varian's next Basic Attack deals 125 (+4% per level) bonus Spell Damage. Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.

1.name: Lion's Maw
1.description:
Quest: Every time Lion's Fang hits a Hero, increase its damage by 7, up to 175.

Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, the Slow is increased to 50% and its duration is increased to 2 seconds.

1.name: Overpower
1.description: When Parry blocks a Hero's Basic Attack, Heroic Strike's cooldown is refreshed and the next one does 40% more damage.

1.name: High King's Quest
1.description:
Quest: Hit 50 Heroes with Basic Attacks.
Quest: Participate in 5 Hero Takedowns.
Quest: Gather 15 Regeneration Globes.

Reward: Completing a Quest grants 10 Base Attack Damage. Completing all 3 Quests grants an additional 30 Base Attack Damage.

4.name: Taunt
4.description:
Silence a target Hero and force them to attack Varian for 1.25 seconds.

Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration increased by 40%.

4.name: Colossus Smash
4.description:
Smash a target enemy, dealing 185 (+4% per level) damage and lowering their Armor by 25 for 3 seconds, causing them to take 25% increased damage.

Passive: Base Attack Damage increased by 100%.
Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration reduced by 10%.

4.name: Twin Blades of Fury
4.description:
Basic Attacks reduce Heroic Strike's cooldown by an additional 7 seconds, and increase Varian's Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.

Passive: Attack Speed increased by 100%.
Passive: Base Attack Damage reduced by 25%.

7.name: Lionheart
7.description: Increase Lion's Fang's healing from Heroes by 75%.

7.name: Second Wind
7.description: Basic Attacks heal Varian for 1% of his maximum Health. While below 50% Health, they also heal him for 50% of the damage dealt.

7.name: Victory Rush
7.description: Every 30 seconds, Varian's next Basic Attack will heal him for 350 (+4% per level) Health. When a nearby enemy Minion or Monster dies, the cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

10.name: Shield Wall
10.description: Parry grants Protected, preventing all incoming damage while active. Additionally, Parry's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds, but it loses 1 charge.

10.name: Warbringer
10.description: Reduce Charge's cooldown by 8 seconds and Mana cost from 45 to 25. Additionally, Charge can be cast on allied Heroes.

13.name: Juggernaut
13.description: Charge deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 4% of their maximum Health.

13.name: Mortal Strike
13.description: Heroes hit by Heroic Strike receive 40% reduced healing for 4 seconds.

13.name: Shattering Throw
13.description:
Activate to throw a sword at a target Hero that deals 50 (+4% per level) damage, and up to 1400 (+4% per level) bonus damage to their Shields.

Passive: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal up to 200% bonus Physical Damage to Shields.

16.name: Banner of Stormwind
16.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 25% increased Movement Speed to nearby allied Heroes. Lasts 12 seconds.

16.name: Banner of Ironforge
16.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 20 Armor to nearby allied Heroes, reducing damage taken by 20%. Lasts 12 seconds.

16.name: Banner of Dalaran
16.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 20% increased Spell Power to nearby allied Heroes. Lasts 12 seconds.

20.name: Vigilance
20.description: Being hit by a Hero Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Taunt by 1 second.

20.name: Master at Arms
20.description: Colossus Smash affects all enemies near the target, and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

20.name: Frenzy
20.description: Twin Blades of Fury increases Heroic Strike damage by an additional 25%, and Basic Attacks increase his Movement Speed by an additional 10%.

20.name: Glory to the Alliance
20.description: Banner now also increases health regeneration and all healing received for nearby allied Heroes by 50%, and the cooldown is reduced by 50%.

20.name: Demoralizing Shout
20.description:
Activate to demoralize nearby enemy Heroes, reducing damage they deal by 40% for 5 seconds.

Each time an enemy Hero affected by Demoralizing Shout deals damage to a Hero, reduce its cooldown and Parry's cooldown by 5%.

whitemane.name: Whitemane
whitemane.description: A versatile Healer who heals her allies by smiting her foes.

abilities.name: Desperate Plea
abilities.description:
Heal an allied Hero for 140 (+4% per level) and gain Desperation for 4 seconds.

Desperation increases Desperate Plea's Mana cost by 40, and stacks up to 3 times.

Current Mana Cost: 45

abilities.name: Inquisition
abilities.description:
Channel on an enemy Hero for up to 3 seconds, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds and Slowing them by 30%. Removes a stack of Desperation.

Shares a cooldown with Clemency.

abilities.name: Searing Lash
abilities.description:
After 0.5 seconds, smite enemies in a straight line for 82 (+4% per level) damage.

If the first strike hits an enemy Hero, a second strike will occur after a short delay.

Repeatable Quest: Hit Heroes with Searing Lash.
Repeatable Quest: Hit 3 Heroes with Basic Attacks.

Reward: Permanently increase Whitemane's maximum Health by 3 and Mana by 2. Heroes hit with the second strike of Searing Lash count as 2 hits.

abilities.name: Scarlet Aegis
abilities.description: Bolster the spirits of nearby allied Heroes, healing them for 300 (+4% per level) and granting them 40 Armor for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Divine Reckoning
abilities.description: After 1 second, consecrate an area for 4 seconds, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies inside. 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes is returned as Mana.

abilities.name: Zeal
abilities.description:
Whitemane's healing Abilities apply Zeal for 8 seconds. Allies with Zeal are healed for 100% of the damage Whitemane deals to Heroes.

Activate to gain 25% Spell Power and lose 15 Armor for 5 seconds. Can be cast while channeling abilities.

abilities.name: Clemency
abilities.description:
Activate to cast Inquisition on an allied Hero, healing them for up to 329 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds while Channeling. Removes a stack of Desperation

Shares a cooldown with Inquisition.

1.name: Pity the Frail
1.description: For every Hero hit with Searing Lash, lower the cooldown of Inquisition by 1 seconds. Allies below 30% Health receive 25% more healing from Whitemane.

1.name: Righteous Flame
1.description: Searing Lash deals 25% more damage to enemies. If the second strike hits an enemy Hero, they take an additional 25% damage and Whitemane gains 40% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

1.name: Inquisitor's Prayer
1.description: Searing Lash restores 25 Mana for each Hero it hits, and Zeal lasts 2 additional seconds.

4.name: Unwavering Faith
4.description: Increase Whitemane's Basic Attack range by 1.1. Whitemane gains 20% increased Basic Attack damage for each active Zeal buff.

4.name: Martyrdom
4.description: Desperate Plea's healing is increased by 30%. Increase this by an additional 10% for each active Zeal.

4.name: Indulgence
4.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Increase this by an additional 5% for each active Zeal.

7.name: Zealous Spirit
7.description: Upon reaching 2 stacks of Desperation, Whitemane gains Zeal.

7.name: Saintly Greatstaff
7.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Searing Lash are marked for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks against them deal an additional 55 (+4% per level) Spell damage and remove the mark.

7.name: Intercession
7.description: Activate to make an ally Unstoppable for 1 second.

10.name: Scarlet Aegis
10.description: Bolster the spirits of nearby allied Heroes, healing them for 300 (+4% per level) and granting them 40 Armor for 4 seconds.

10.name: Divine Reckoning
10.description: After 1 second, consecrate an area for 4 seconds, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies inside. 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes is returned as Mana.

13.name: Subjugation
13.description: Inquisition reduces all damage the target deals by 50%.

13.name: Lashing Out
13.description: If Searing Lash's second strike hits an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown to 1 second.

13.name: Scarlet Wrath
13.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes increase the duration of all active Zeals by 0.75 seconds, restore 1% Mana to all Zeal targets, and lower the cooldown of Zeals activation by 4 seconds.

16.name: Radiance
16.description: Reaching 3 stacks of Desperation heals for 190 (+4% per level) and reapplies Zeal to allies with Zeal.

16.name: Shared Punishment
16.description: Upon casting, Inquisition can chain to an additional enemy Hero near its target, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds. Affected enemies lose 10 Armor.

16.name: Harsh Discipline
16.description:
Hitting a Hero with Searing Lash while they are being targeted by Inquisition Roots them for 1.5 seconds.

Passive: Reduce Inquisition's cooldown by 2 seconds.

20.name: Scarlet Crusade
20.description: Scarlet Aegis heals for 50% more and makes affected allies Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

20.name: Judgment Day
20.description: Divine Reckoning deals 50% more damage and pulls enemies to its center the first time it hits them.

20.name: Guiding Light
20.description:
Activate to cast a permanent Zeal on an allied Hero that costs no Mana and doesn't grant Desperation. Only one can be active at a time and has global cast range.

Increases the Spell Power bonus provided by Whitemane's trait by 15%.

20.name: Purge the Wicked
20.description: Activate to blast an enemy Hero with holy fire, reducing their Armor by 25 and dealing 300 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds.

nazeebo.name: Nazeebo
nazeebo.description: A sustained damage Mage who gains power when killing enemy minions.

abilities.name: Corpse Spiders
abilities.description: Hurl a jar of spiders that deals 50 (+4% per level) damage. If it hits at least one enemy, create 3 Corpse Spiders that attack for 38 (+4% per level) damage. Spiders last for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Zombie Wall
abilities.description: After 1 second, create a ring of Zombies surrounding the target area that deal 28 (+4% per level) damage and last for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Plague of Toads
abilities.description:
Create a wave of 3 Toads that explode on contact, dealing 126 (+4% per level) damage over 6 seconds. This effect stacks.

Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Gargantuan
abilities.description: Summon a Gargantuan to guard an area, losing Health over 29 seconds. Deals 100 (+4% per level) damage when summoned, attacks for 140 (+4% per level) damage, and can be ordered to stomp nearby enemies. The Gargantuan's Stomp deals 240 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Ravenous Spirit
abilities.description: Channel a Ravenous Spirit that deals 230 (+4% per level) damage per second. Cannot move while channeling. Lasts for 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Voodoo Ritual
abilities.description:
Nazeebo's Basic Attacks and Abilities poison Non-Heroic enemies, causing them to take 66 (+4% per level) additional damage over 6 seconds. 

Quest: If a Minion dies while poisoned by Voodoo Ritual, Nazeebo permanently gains 6 Health and 1 Mana.

1.name: Widowmakers
1.description:
Enemies hit by Corpse Spiders' jar are Slowed by 25% for 1 second.

Reward: After Corpse Spiders attack Heroes 100 times, their attack damage is increased by 25% and their duration is increased by 1 second.

1.name: Pandemic
1.description:
Quest: Hit Heroes with Plague of Toads.

Reward: After hitting 35 Heroes with Plague of Toads, it spawns 2 additional toads.

Reward: After hitting 70 Heroes with Plague of Toads, it reduces the damage Heroes deal by 5%, stacking up to 25%.

1.name: Thing of the Deep
1.description:
Increase the range of Nazeebo's Basic Abilities by 20%.

Reward: After gaining 50 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, gain 5% Spell Power.

Reward: After gaining 100 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, gain an additional 5% Spell Power.

4.name: Hexed Crawlers
4.description: Corpse Spiders restore 1% of Nazeebo's maximum Health and Mana when they attack an enemy Hero.

4.name: Big Voodoo
4.description: Increases the Health and Mana bonuses from Voodoo Ritual by 100%.

4.name: Blood Ritual
4.description:
If an enemy dies while poisoned by Voodoo Ritual, restore 2% of Nazeebo's maximum Health and Mana.

Passive: Takedowns grant 3 stacks of Voodoo Ritual.

7.name: Spirit of Arachyr
7.description: The number of Corpse Spiders spawned is increased from 3 to 4. If Corpse Spiders' jar hits only one enemy, it creates an additional spider.

7.name: Dead Rush
7.description: Zombie Wall deals 100% more damage. When it expires up to 5 remaining Zombies uproot and attack nearby enemies, losing Health over 3 seconds.

7.name: Toads of Hugeness
7.description: Increase the damage and explosion radius of Plague of Toads by 25% after each hop, up to a maximum of 100%.

10.name: Gargantuan
10.description: Summon a Gargantuan to guard an area, losing Health over 29 seconds. Deals 100 (+4% per level) damage when summoned, attacks for 140 (+4% per level) damage, and can be ordered to stomp nearby enemies. The Gargantuan's Stomp deals 240 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

10.name: Ravenous Spirit
10.description: Channel a Ravenous Spirit that deals 230 (+4% per level) damage per second. Cannot move while channeling. Lasts for 8 seconds.

13.name: Guardian Toads
13.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Plague of Toads grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, stacking up to 6 seconds.

13.name: Superstition
13.description: Gain 40 Spell Armor. Heroic Basic Attacks against Nazeebo remove this bonus for 3 seconds and spawn a Corpse Spider to attack the Hero.

13.name: Ice Block
13.description: Activate to place yourself in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 3 seconds.

16.name: Spider Colony
16.description: Corpse Spider Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Nazeebo's Basic Abilities by 0.125 seconds.

16.name: Ring of Poison
16.description: Zombie Wall lasts 1 second longer, and the center is filled with poison that deals a total of 319 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. This damage starts small and increases over the duration.

16.name: Soul Harvest
16.description: Activate to increase Nazeebo's Health and Spell Power by 7% for each nearby enemy, up to a maximum of 35%. Lasts 15 seconds.

20.name: Humongoid
20.description:
Gargantuan Stomp's area is increased by 25% and its Slow amount is increased to 50%.

Passive: Reduce Gargantuan's cooldown by 40 seconds and its Mana cost by 50%.

20.name: Annihilating Spirit
20.description:
When Ravenous Spirit damages an enemy Hero, reduce their healing received by 50% for 1 second and increase Ravenous Spirit's damage by 5% for the rest of its duration.

Passive: Increases the range of Ravenous Spirit by 50%.

20.name: Vile Infection
20.description:
Quest: Reach 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual.

Reward: After reaching 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, it can also be applied to Heroes and its damage is increased from 66 (+4% per level) to 165 (+4% per level) over 6 seconds.

20.name: Bad Medicine
20.description: Consume 5 stacks of Voodoo Ritual to become Unstoppable, gain 20% increased Movement Speed, and 50 Armor for 2 seconds.

liming.name: Li-Ming
liming.description: A high burst damage Mage who can reset her Abilities upon getting a takedown.

abilities.name: Magic Missiles
abilities.description: Fire three missiles toward an area, each dealing 147 (+3.5% per level) damage to the first enemy hit. These missiles do 50% damage to Structures.

abilities.name: Arcane Orb
abilities.description: Fire an Orb that powers up as it travels, dealing 135 (+3% per level) damage to the first enemy hit. Damage is increased the further it travels, up to 270 (+3% per level) more damage.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.description: Teleport a short distance instantly.

abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Channel a powerful beam, dealing 480 (+5% per level) damage over 2.6 seconds to enemies while they are in it. The direction of the beam changes with your mouse cursor position.

abilities.name: Wave of Force
abilities.description: Knock away all enemies from an area and deal 160 (+5% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Critical Mass
abilities.description: Getting a Takedown will refresh the cooldown on all of Li-Ming's Abilities.

1.name: Force Armor
1.description:
When Magic Missiles damages an enemy Hero, gain 50 Spell Armor, reducing the damage taken by the next Ability by 50%. Gain 1 charge per cast and store up to 4 charges.

Passive: Li-Ming's Mana regeneration is increased by 100% while below 35% Mana.

1.name: Aether Walker
1.description: Teleport costs no Mana. If Li-Ming hasn't taken damage in the last 3 seconds, Teleport's cooldown is decreased by 2 seconds. Casting Teleport causes Li-Ming's next cast of Magic Missiles to deal 10% bonus damage.

1.name: Power Hungry
1.description: Regeneration Globes restore 100% more Mana and grant 10% Spell Power for 20 seconds.

4.name: Charged Blast
4.description: Basic Attacking a target recently hit by a Magic Missile does an extra 87 (+4% per level) damage.

4.name: Triumvirate
4.description: If Arcane Orb hits an enemy Hero after traveling at least 50% of its base range, the cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and 40 Mana is refunded.

4.name: Dominance
4.description: Takedowns restore 30% of Li-Ming's missing Health.

7.name: Seeker
7.description: If three Magic Missiles hit the same target, the third one deals an additional 140 (+4% per level) damage.

7.name: Zei's Vengeance
7.description: Increase Arcane Orb's damage increase for distance traveled by 30%. Additionally, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.

7.name: Calamity
7.description: Teleport does 300 (+3% per level) damage to enemy Heroes near the destination.

10.name: Disintegrate
10.description: Channel a powerful beam, dealing 480 (+5% per level) damage over 2.6 seconds to enemies while they are in it. The direction of the beam changes with your mouse cursor position.

10.name: Wave of Force
10.description: Knock away all enemies from an area and deal 160 (+5% per level) damage.

13.name: Illusionist
13.description:
If Li-Ming loses more than 20% of her Health at once, its cooldown is instantly refreshed. 

This effect has a 4 second cooldown.

Passive: Increases Teleport range by 50%

13.name: Cannoneer
13.description: When Li-Ming uses an Ability, her next Basic Attack's damage is increased by 75% and deals Spell damage instead of Physical. Stacks up to 3 times.

13.name: Glass Cannon
13.description: Increase Li-Ming's Spell Power by 20%, but decrease her maximum Health by 15%.

16.name: Fireflies
16.description: Drastically increases Magic Missiles speed. Its cooldown is reduced by 1 second, and its Mana cost is reduced by 5.

16.name: Mirrorball
16.description: Magic Missiles fires an additional 2 missiles, but its Mana cost is increased by 5.

16.name: Arcane Orbit
16.description: Arcane Orb travels 25% farther, increasing its maximum distance damage bonus from 270 (+3% per level) to 371 (+3% per level).

16.name: Diamond Skin
16.description: Teleport grants a Shield equal to 25% of Li-Ming's maximum Health for 4 seconds.

20.name: Temporal Flux
20.description: Disintegrate gradually Slows enemies caught in its beam, to a maximum of 60%.

20.name: Repulsion
20.description: Increases Wave of Force knockback distance by 175% and increases its cast range by 95%.

20.name: Tal Rasha's Elements
20.description: Casting Abilities increases the damage of the next Ability by 5%, up to 20%. This bonus is reset when the same Ability is used within a chain.

20.name: Archon: Pure Power
20.description: Activate to enter Archon form, allowing Li-Ming to repeatedly use Disintegrate, but be unable to cast other Abilities.

xalatath.name: Xal'atath
xalatath.description: A ranged Assassin who manipulates void energy to overwhelm enemies and control the battlefield.

abilities.name: Shadow Mark
abilities.description:
Shoot a Void Orb that deals 60 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit, and an additional 120 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the center.

If an enemy Hero or Structure is hit by the center, they are marked for 4 seconds.

Targets afflicted by Shadow Mark are Revealed and draw the Dark Heart and Void Minions towards them.

abilities.name: Dark Heart Ritual
abilities.description:
Summon the Dark Heart, which pulses for 50 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies and lasts 8 seconds.

The Dark Heart moves to Shadow Mark's impact location.

The Dark Heart will pursue targets afflicted by Shadow Mark and detonate on impact, dealing 245 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and 61 (+4% per level) more damage to the Marked target.

abilities.name: Void Step
abilities.description:
Cast to teleport Xal'atath 3 times in a triangular pattern.

Each time Xal'atath teleports, her Basic Attacks deal 10% more damage while the Ability is active.

Reactivate to end Void Step early and remain at your current location.

abilities.name: Void Eruption
abilities.description:
Channel a powerful Void Orb that grows over time until reaching maximum size after 2 seconds. Recast to launch the Orb early.

Enemies that come into contact with the Orb take 90 (+4% per level) damage and are Blinded for 1 second.

When the Orb reaches the end of its path, it detonates in a large explosion, dealing 400 (+4% per level) damage.

Charging up this Ability increases its contact damage up to 166 (+4% per level) and its explosion damage up to 700 (+4% per level).

Contact damage is dealt every 0.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Void Convergence
abilities.description:
After channeling for 2 seconds, summon a Void Portal that spawns up to 3 Void Minions to attack nearby enemies.

You can have up to 1 active Void Portal.

Enemies near the Void Portal are Slowed by 25%.

Void Minions are attracted to targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.

The Portal expires after 20 seconds.
Void Minions automatically choose a nearby lane to push.
Void Minion Basic Attacks deal 50 (+4% per level) damage per hit.
Void Minions lose Health over 12 seconds.

abilities.name: Void Volley
abilities.description:
Every basic attack against heroes, and every 2 basic attacks against non-heroes generate charge. Once fully charged Xal'atath can activate Void Volley to unleash a barrage of 6 Void Orbs at a target location, each dealing 72 (+4% per level) damage on impact.

Charge fully decays if Xal’atath does not hit an enemy with a Basic Attack after 6 seconds.

Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Void Volley to grant 1 stack per hit and increases Void Volley's damage by 1%. Lose all stacks upon dying.

Reward (20 Stacks):
   +2 Void Volley Range
   Stack loss on death lowered to 6.

Reward (60 Stacks):
   -1 Basic Attack required to charge Void Volley.

Mythic Reward (100 Stacks):
   +50% Basic Attack and Void Volley Damage.
   Void Volley projectiles Pierce all targets.

Stack loss will never cause the Hero to fall below a quest reward threshold.

1.name: Void Adept
1.description:
Quest: Detonate the Dark Heart on targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.

Each successful detonation permanently increases Shadow Mark and the Dark Heart Ritual Detonation damage by 20, up to 10 times.

1.name: Anchored Core
1.description:
Dark Heart Ritual:
+25% Radius
+25% Duration

Dark Heart's damage bounces 2 times from the primary target to nearby enemies, dealing 25 (+4% per level) damage.

1.name: Cloak of Shadows
1.description: Activating Void Step grants 50% Movement Speed and 25 Spell Armor for 2 seconds. This bonus refreshes each time Xal'atath teleports.

4.name: Cold Feet
4.description:
+1s Shadow Mark Duration

Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark have their Movement Speed reduced by 25%.

4.name: Dark Barrier
4.description: Each time the Dark Heart damages an enemy Hero, Xal'atath gains a Shield equal to 2% of her maximum Health, up to 10%.

4.name: Void Acolyte
4.description:
Completing Void Step fully charges Void Volley.

The next Void Volley deals 25% increased damage and costs no Mana.

7.name: Toxic Mark
7.description:
+1s Shadow Mark Duration

Heroes affliced with Shadow Mark have their Armor reduced by 10 and take damage equal to 1% of their maximum Health every second.

7.name: Silence of the Lamb
7.description: Activating Void Step summons a seal of void magic on the ground. When the seal completes, it deals 250 (+4% per level) damage to enemies inside and Silences them for 2 seconds.

7.name: Void Summoner
7.description:
Activating Void Step summons a single Void Minion in Xal'atath's original postion. Void Minions are attracted to targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.

Void Minions automatically choose a nearby lane to push.
Void Minion Basic Attacks deal 50 (+4% per level) damage per hit.
Void Minion loses Health over 12 seconds.

10.name: Void Eruption
10.description:
Channel a powerful Void Orb that grows over time until reaching maximum size after 2 seconds. Recast to launch the Orb early.

Enemies that come into contact with the Orb take 90 (+4% per level) damage and are Blinded for 1 second.

When the Orb reaches the end of its path, it detonates in a large explosion, dealing 400 (+4% per level) damage.

Charging up this Ability increases its contact damage up to 166 (+4% per level) and its explosion damage up to 700 (+4% per level).

Contact damage is dealt every 0.25 seconds.

10.name: Void Convergence
10.description:
After channeling for 2 seconds, summon a Void Portal that spawns up to 3 Void Minions to attack nearby enemies.

You can have up to 1 active Void Portal.

Enemies near the Void Portal are Slowed by 25%.

Void Minions are attracted to targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.

The Portal expires after 20 seconds.
Void Minions automatically choose a nearby lane to push.
Void Minion Basic Attacks deal 50 (+4% per level) damage per hit.
Void Minions lose Health over 12 seconds.

13.name: Pull of the Dark Heart
13.description: Enemies damaged by the Dark Heart Ritual are Slowed by 10% for each pulse, stacking up to 5 times and decaying over 2 seconds.

13.name: Dark Heart's Protection
13.description:
Detonating the Dark Heart now Silences enemies inside its radius for 1 second.

Xal'atath and allied Heroes gain 30 Spell Armor while inside the Dark Heart's radius.

13.name: Crushing Cascade
13.description: Enemies hit by Void Volley are Slowed by 6% for 2 seconds per projectile, up to 50%.

16.name: Marked Resilience
16.description:
Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark grant a 160 (+4% per level) point Shield that rapidly decays.

Shield starts decaying after 1 second, decays over 2 seconds.

16.name: Relentless Whispers
16.description: While Void Step is active, Xal'atath's Basic Attack Speed is increased by 150%.

16.name: Fractured Reality
16.description:
+25% Void Volley Projectile Damage

Void Volley's projectiles leave behind a trail of fire for 3 seconds, constantly dealing 9 (+4% per level) damage to enemies. Damage is increased the longer a target stands in the flames.

Damage is dealt every 0.1875 seconds.
Damage increases up to 300%.
Damage increase from multiple fires stack.

20.name: Harbinger's Consumption
20.description: Void Eruption splits into 3 orbiting Void Orbs. Each enemy Hero hit by their explosions reduces Void Eruption's cooldown by 14 seconds.

20.name: Rift Invasion
20.description: Void Convergence's Void Portal self decay is no longer lethal, raises the active Void Portal limit to 2, and can spawn and sustain up to 4 Void Minions.

20.name: Dueling Orbs
20.description:
+1 Shadow Mark Charge

Shadow Mark has a 3 second cooldown between uses.

20.name: Unstable Core
20.description:
When the Dark Heart expires or detonates on a target afflicted by Shadow Mark, it leaves behind a pool of void flames for 5 seconds. Enemies in the flames take 45 (+4% per level) damage over time.

The flames deal damage every 1 second.

20.name: Paradox Loop
20.description:
After completing Void Step, Xal'atath immediately performs a second Void Step in the opposite direction. Added effects are triggered again.

Bonus Basic Attack damage stacks up to 3 times

yrel.name: Yrel
yrel.description: A deliberate melee Bruiser whose heavyweight abilities reward investment and careful timing.

abilities.name: Vindication
abilities.description:
Unleash holy energy around Yrel, dealing 48 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and healing her for 111 (+4% per level).

Charging up this Ability increases its damage up to 160 (+4% per level), and healing up to 370 (+4% per level).

abilities.name: Righteous Hammer
abilities.description:
Swing Yrel's hammer, dealing 42 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in front of her and knocking them away.

Charging up this Ability increases its knockback distance, and damage up to 140 (+4% per level). Enemies hit at maximum charge are Stunned for 1 seconds.

abilities.name: Avenging Wrath
abilities.description:
Leap to a location, dealing 260 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in an area and Slowing them by 60% for 1 second.

Charging up this Ability increases its range.

abilities.name: Ardent Defender
abilities.description: Surround Yrel in a barrier for 3 seconds, absorbing all damage taken and healing her for 50% of the damage received.

abilities.name: Sacred Ground
abilities.description: Yrel sanctifies the ground around her, gaining 50 Armor until she leaves the area.

abilities.name: Divine Purpose
abilities.description:
Activate to instantly charge Yrel's next Basic Ability at no mana cost. Divine Purpose's cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds if Stunned or Silenced while charging her skills.

Passive: Yrel's Basic Abilities charge up over 1.5 seconds, increasing in effectiveness, but reducing Yrel's Movement Speed by 25%.

1.name: Light of Karabor
1.description: Increase Vindication's radius by 15%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Vindication's healing by 40%. If more than one Hero is hit, the bonus is increased to 80%.

1.name: Dauntless
1.description: Casting a Basic Ability grants Yrel 35 Physical Armor for 2.5 seconds.

1.name: Maraad's Insight
1.description: After damaging an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability, Yrel's next Basic Attack heals her for 160 (+4% per level).

4.name: Aegis of Light
4.description: Upon landing, Avenging Wrath grants other nearby allied Heroes 40 Armor for 5 seconds.

4.name: Gift of the Naaru
4.description: Divine Purpose heals the lowest Health nearby allied Hero other than Yrel for 275 (+4% per level).

4.name: Hand of Freedom
4.description: Grant an allied Hero 25% Movement Speed for 3 seconds and remove all Slows and Roots from them.

7.name: Righteous Momentum
7.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Yrel is no longer Slowed while Channeling Righteous Hammer, and instead this bonus is quadrupled.

7.name: Holy Avenger
7.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Avenging Wrath at maximum charge deals 25% more damage and reduces its cooldown to 1 second.

7.name: Divine Steed
7.description: Mounting is instant and grants 60% Movement Speed that decays over 3 seconds.

10.name: Ardent Defender
10.description: Surround Yrel in a barrier for 3 seconds, absorbing all damage taken and healing her for 50% of the damage received.

10.name: Sacred Ground
10.description: Yrel sanctifies the ground around her, gaining 50 Armor until she leaves the area.

13.name: Aldor Peacekeeper
13.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Vindication at maximum charge deal 50% less damage for 4 seconds.

13.name: Repentance
13.description: Increase Avenging Wrath's Slow by 25% and duration by 0.75 seconds.

13.name: Velen's Chosen
13.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability at maximum charge grants 7.5% Spell Power for 10 seconds, up to 30%.

16.name: Templar's Verdict
16.description: Righteous Hammer reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 15 for 4 seconds and deals bonus damage equal to 6% of their maximum Health.

16.name: Divine Favor
16.description: Casting a Basic Ability reduces the cooldown of Divine Purpose by 2.5 seconds.

16.name: Holy Wrath
16.description: After casting a Basic Ability, Yrel's next Basic Attack splashes for 35% increased damage around the target.

20.name: Word of Glory
20.description: Increase the amount that Yrel heals from damage received from 50% to 75%. Ardent Defender heals nearby allied Heroes for 100% of the healing received by Yrel.

20.name: Hallowed Ground
20.description: Casting Avenging Wrath while inside Sacred Ground moves Sacred Ground to Yrel's location upon landing.

20.name: Bubble Hearth
20.description: After 1 second, Yrel becomes Invulnerable and casts Hearthstone. Cannot be canceled.

20.name: Seraphim
20.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

zagara.name: Zagara
zagara.description: A Summoner who provides lots of vision of the battleground.

abilities.name: Baneling Barrage
abilities.description:
Launch 2 Banelings that deal 80 (+4% per level) damage to enemies they hit.

Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Hunter Killer
abilities.description: Summon a Hydralisk to attack a single target, dealing 71 (+5% per level) damage per second. The Hydralisk loses Health over 10 seconds, and has 500 (+4.5% per level) Health.

abilities.name: Infested Drop
abilities.description:
Bombard target area with a Zerg Drop Pod for 140 (+4% per level) damage. 

The pod spawns 2 Roachlings that deal 30 (+4% per level) damage per second and lose Health over 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Nydus Network
abilities.description:
Summon a Nydus Worm on Creep anywhere that Zagara has vision. Zagara can enter a Nydus Worm and travel to any other Nydus Worm by right-clicking near it. While inside a Nydus Worm, Zagara regenerates 10% Health and Mana per second.

Stores up to 2 charges. Maximum of 4 Nydus Worms at a time.

Passive: Creep spreads 15% farther. 
Passive: While on Creep, each Basic Attack reduces all of Zagara's cooldowns by 0.4 seconds.

abilities.name: Devouring Maw
abilities.description:
Summon a Devouring Maw that devours enemies for 4 seconds. Devoured enemies cannot fight and take 94 (+4% per level) damage per second.

Usable on Unstoppable enemies.

abilities.name: Creep Tumor
abilities.description:
Lay a Creep Tumor that generates Creep. While on Creep, Zagara moves 20% faster and her summons move 30% faster. Tumors lose Health over 250 seconds and reveal the surrounding area while active.

Stores up to 3 charges.

1.name: Volatile Acid
1.description: Banelings can travel 50% further before exploding.

1.name: Corpse Feeders
1.description: Reduces the cooldown of Infested Drop by 3 seconds and Roachlings have 30% more Health.

1.name: Infest
1.description:
Nearby Ranged Minions deal an additional 100% damage. Can be toggled on or off.

Repeatable Quest: Every 1000 Siege damage dealt increases this bonus by 1%.

4.name: Envenomed Spines
4.description: Activate to have Zagara's next Basic Attack apply 230 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds.

4.name: Medusa Blades
4.description: Basic Attacks deal 33% damage to three nearby targets.

4.name: Serrated Spines
4.description: Quest: Each Basic Attack against a Hero increases Zagara's Attack Damage by 0.2%.

7.name: Baneling Massacre
7.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Banelings Barrage, but increase its cooldown by 2 seconds.

7.name: Viscous Acid
7.description: Banelings Slow enemies by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

7.name: Bile Drop
7.description:
Quest: Passively increases the radius of Infested Drop by 20%.

Reward: After hitting 12 Heroes with Infested Drop, it spawns an additional Roachling.

10.name: Devouring Maw
10.description:
Summon a Devouring Maw that devours enemies for 4 seconds. Devoured enemies cannot fight and take 94 (+4% per level) damage per second.

Usable on Unstoppable enemies.

10.name: Nydus Network
10.description:
Summon a Nydus Worm on Creep anywhere that Zagara has vision. Zagara can enter a Nydus Worm and travel to any other Nydus Worm by right-clicking near it. While inside a Nydus Worm, Zagara regenerates 10% Health and Mana per second.

Stores up to 2 charges. Maximum of 4 Nydus Worms at a time.

Passive: Creep spreads 15% farther. 
Passive: While on Creep, each Basic Attack reduces all of Zagara's cooldowns by 0.4 seconds.

13.name: Hydralisk Transfusion
13.description: Zagara is healed for 60% of the damage dealt by Hunter Killers' Basic Attacks to Heroes.

13.name: Protective Coating
